verses.translation: He came into the world to obtain the four great blessings.
He came to dwell in the home of the Shiva and Shakti, energy and matter.

verses.original: ਏਕੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੇ ਤਾ ਪਿੜ ਹਾਰੇ ਅੰਧੁਲੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: ek visaare taa piR haare a(n)dhulai naam visaaraa he ||6||
verses.translation: But he forgot the One Lord, and he has lost the game. The blind person forgets the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||6||
The child dies in his childish games.
They cry and mourn, saying that he was such a playful child.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਾ ਸੋ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਲੀਆ ਭੂਲਾ ਰੋਵਣਹਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: jis kaa saa so tin hee leeaa bhoolaa rovanahaaraa he ||7||
verses.translation: The Lord who owns him has taken him back. Those who weep and mourn are mistaken. ||7||

verses.original: ਭਰਿ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਕਿ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: bhar joban mar jaeh k keejai ||
verses.translation: What can they do, if he dies in his youth?
They cry out, ""His is mine, he is mine!""

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਰੋਇ ਵਿਗੂਚਹਿ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: maiaa kaaran roi vigoocheh dhirag jeevan sa(n)saaraa he ||8||
verses.translation: They cry for the sake of Maya, and are ruined; their lives in this world are cursed. ||8||
Their black hair eventually turns grey.
Without the Name, they lose their wealth, and then leave.

verses.original: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਅੰਧੁਲਾ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਬਿਨਾਸੈ ਮੂਠੇ ਰੋਇ ਪੂਕਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: dhuramat a(n)dhulaa binas binaasai mooThe roi pookaaraa he ||9||
verses.translation: They are evil-minded and blind - they are totally ruined; they are plundered, and cry out in pain. ||9||
One who understands himself, does not cry.
When he meets the True Guru, then he understands.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ਨ ਖੂਲਹਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: bin gur bajar kapaaT na khooleh sabadh milai nisataaraa he ||10||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, the heavy, hard doors are not opened. Obtaining the Word of the Shabad, one is emancipated. ||10||
The body grows old, and is beaten out of shape.
But he does not meditate on the Lord, His only friend, even at the end.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਚਲੈ ਮੁਹਿ ਕਾਲੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਝੂਠੁ ਖੁਆਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: naam visaar chalai muh kaalai dharageh jhooTh khuaaraa he ||11||
verses.translation: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he departs with his face blackened. The false are humiliated in the Court of the Lord. ||11||
Forgetting the Naam, the false ones depart.
Coming and going, dust falls on their heads.

verses.original: ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਮਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: saahuraRai ghar vaas na paae peieeaRai sir maaraa he ||12||
verses.translation: The soul-bride finds no home in her in-laws' home, the world hereafter; she suffers in agony in this world of her parents' home. ||12||
She eats, dresses and plays joyfully,
but without loving devotional worship of the Lord, she dies uselessly.

verses.original: ਸਰ ਅਪਸਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਚਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: sar apasar kee saar na jaanai jam maare kiaa chaaraa he ||13||
verses.translation: One who does not distinguish between good and evil, is beaten by the Messenger of Death; how can anyone escape this? ||13||
One who realizes what he has to possess, and what he has to abandon,

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਘਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sa(n)g sabadh ghar jaanai ||
verses.translation: associating with the Guru, comes to know the Word of the Shabad, within the home of his own self.

verses.original: ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਮੰਦਾ ਆਖਿ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਸਚਿ ਖਰਾ ਸਚਿਆਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: kis hee ma(n)dhaa aakh na chalai sach kharaa sachiaaraa he ||14||
verses.translation: Do not call anyone else bad; follow this way of life. Those who are true are judged to be genuine by the True Lord. ||14||

verses.original: ਸਾਚ ਬਿਨਾ ਦਰਿ ਸਿਝੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: saach binaa dhar sijhai na koiee ||
verses.translation: Without Truth, no one succeeds in the Court of the Lord.
Through the True Shabad, one is robed in honor.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: aape bakhas le tis bhaavai haumai garab nivaaraa he ||15||
verses.translation: He forgives those with whom He is pleased; they silence their egotism and pride. ||15||
One who realizes the Hukam of God's Command, by the Grace of the Guru,
comes to know the lifestyle of the ages.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਤਰੁ ਤਾਰੀ ਸਚੁ ਤਾਰੇ ਤਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੧॥੭॥
verses.translit: naanak naam japahu tar taaree sach taare taaranahaaraa he ||16||1||7||
verses.translation: O Nanak, chant the Naam, and cross over to the other side. The True Lord will carry you across. ||16||1||7||
Maaroo, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: har saa meet naahee mai koiee ||
verses.translation: I have no other friend like the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਆ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jin tan man dheeaa surat samoiee ||
verses.translation: He gave me body and mind, and infused consciousness into my being.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਿ ਸਮਾਲੇ ਸੋ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਦਾਨਾ ਬੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sarab jeeaa pratipaal samaale so a(n)tar dhaanaa beenaa he ||1||
verses.translation: He cherishes and cares for all beings; He is deep within, the wise, all-knowing Lord. ||1||
The Guru is the sacred pool, and I am His beloved swan.

verses.original: ਸਾਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਰਤਨ ਲਾਲ ਬਹੁ ਸਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: saagar meh ratan laal bahu saare ||
verses.translation: In the ocean, there are so many jewels and rubies.

verses.original: ਮੋਤੀ ਮਾਣਕ ਹੀਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਤ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਭੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: motee maanak heeraa har jas gaavat man tan bheenaa he ||2||
verses.translation: The Lord's Praises are pearls, gems and diamonds. Singing His Praises, my mind and body are drenched with His Love. ||2||
The Lord is inaccessible, inscrutable, unfathomable and unattached.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: har a(n)t na paieeaai gur gopaalaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord's limits cannot be found; the Guru is the Lord of the World.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਤਿ ਤਾਰੇ ਤਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਰੰਗਿ ਲੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: satigur mat taare taaranahaaraa mel le ra(n)g leenaa he ||3||
verses.translation: Through the Teachings of the True Guru, the Lord carries us across to the other side. He unites in His Union those who are colored by His Love. ||3||
Without the True Guru, how can anyone be liberated?
He has been the Friend of the Lord, from the very beginning of time, and all throughout the ages.

verses.original: ਦਰਗਹ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਬਖਸੇ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਕੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: dharageh mukat kare kar kirapaa bakhase avagun keenaa he ||4||
verses.translation: By His Grace, He grants liberation in His Court; He forgives them for their sins. ||4||
The True Guru, the Giver, grants liberation;

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਰੋਗ ਗਵਾਏ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sabh rog gavaae a(n)mirat ras paae ||
verses.translation: all diseases are eradicated, and one is blessed with the Ambrosial Nectar.

verses.original: ਜਮੁ ਜਾਗਾਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਰੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਠਰੁ ਸੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: jam jaagaat naahee kar laagai jis agan bujhee Thar seenaa he ||5||
verses.translation: Death, the tax collector, does not impose any tax on one whose inner fire has been put out, whose heart is cool and tranquil. ||5||
The body has developed a great love for the soul-swan.

verses.original: ਓਹੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਓਹ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: oh jogee purakh oh su(n)dhar naaree ||
verses.translation: He is a Yogi, and she is a beautiful woman.

verses.original: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਭੋਗੈ ਚੋਜ ਬਿਨੋਦੀ ਉਠਿ ਚਲਤੈ ਮਤਾ ਨ ਕੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: ahinis bhogai choj binodhee uTh chalatai mataa na keenaa he ||6||
verses.translation: Day and night, he enjoys her with delight, and then he arises and departs without consulting her. ||6||
Creating the Universe, God remains diffused throughout it.
In the wind, water and fire, He vibrates and resounds.

verses.original: ਮਨੂਆ ਡੋਲੈ ਦੂਤ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: manooaa ddolai dhoot sa(n)gat mil so paae jo kichh keenaa he ||7||
verses.translation: The mind wavers, keeping company with evil passions; one obtains the rewards of his own actions. ||7||
Forgetting the Naam, one suffers the misery of his evil ways.
When the order to depart is issued, how can he remain here?

verses.original: ਨਰਕ ਕੂਪ ਮਹਿ ਗੋਤੇ ਖਾਵੈ ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਮੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: narak koop meh gote khaavai jiau jal te baahar meenaa he ||8||
verses.translation: He falls into the pit of hell, and suffers like a fish out of water. ||8||
The faithless cynic has to endure 8.4 million hellish incarnations.
As he acts, so does he suffer.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਬਾਧਾ ਗ੍ਰਸਿ ਦੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: satigur baajhahu mukat na hoiee kirat baadhaa gras dheenaa he ||9||
verses.translation: Without the True Guru, there is no liberation. Bound and gagged by his own actions, he is helpless. ||9||
This path is very narrow, like the sharp edge of a sword.
When his account is read, he shall be crushed like the sesame seed in the mill.

verses.original: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਸੁਤ ਬੇਲੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਕੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: maat pitaa kalatr sut belee naahee bin har ras mukat na keenaa he ||10||
verses.translation: Mother, father, spouse and child - none is anyone's friend in the end. Without the Lord's Love, no one is liberated. ||10||
You may have many friends and companions in the world,
but without the Guru, the Transcendent Lord Incarnate, there is no one at all.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਰਾਇਣਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਕੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: gur kee sevaa mukat parain anadhin keeratan keenaa he ||11||
verses.translation: Service to the Guru is the way to liberation. Night and day, sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. ||11||
Abandon falsehood, and pursue the Truth,
and you shall obtain the fruits of your desires.

verses.original: ਸਾਚ ਵਖਰ ਕੇ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ਸਉਦਾ ਕੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: saach vakhar ke vaapaaree virale lai laahaa saudhaa keenaa he ||12||
verses.translation: Very few are those who trade in the merchandise of Truth. Those who deal in it, obtain the true profit. ||12||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਲੈ ਚਲਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam vakhar lai chalahu ||
verses.translation: Depart with the merchandise of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har,
and you shall intuitively obtain the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, in the Mansion of His Presence.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖੋਜਿ ਲਹਹਿ ਜਨ ਪੂਰੇ ਇਉ ਸਮਦਰਸੀ ਚੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: gurmukh khoj laheh jan poore iau samadharasee cheenaa he ||13||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs search for Him and find Him; they are the perfect humble beings. In this way, they see Him, who looks upon all alike. ||13||
God is endless; following the Guru's Teachings, some find Him.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਸਮਝਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh man kau samajhaaveh ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they instruct their minds.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਹੁ ਇਉ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੈ ਲੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: satigur kee baanee sat sat kar maanahu iau aatam raamai leenaa he ||14||
verses.translation: Accept as True, Perfectly True, the Word of the True Guru's Bani. In this way, you shall merge in the Lord, the Supreme Soul. ||14||
Naarad and Saraswati are Your servants.
Your servants are the greatest of the great, throughout the three worlds.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਤੂ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: sabh teree kudharat too sir sir dhaataa sabh tero kaaran keenaa he ||15||
verses.translation: Your creative power permeates all; You are the Great Giver of all. You created the whole creation. ||15||
Some serve at Your Door, and their sufferings are dispelled.
They are robed with honor in the Court of the Lord, and emancipated by the True Guru.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਬੰਧਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਤੋੜੇ ਚਿਤੁ ਚੰਚਲੁ ਚਲਣਿ ਨ ਦੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: haumai ba(n)dhan satigur toRe chit cha(n)chal chalan na dheenaa he ||16||
verses.translation: The True Guru breaks the bonds of egotism, and restrains the fickle consciousness. ||16||
Meet the True Guru, and search for the way,

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jit prabh paavahu ganat na kaiee ||
verses.translation: by which you may find God, and not have to answer for your account.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਭੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੭॥੨॥੮॥
verses.translit: haumai maar karahu gur sevaa jan naanak har ra(n)g bheenaa he ||17||2||8||
verses.translation: Subdue your egotism, and serve the Guru; O servant Nanak, you shall be drenched with the Lord's Love. ||17||2||8||
Maaroo, First Mehla:
My Lord is the Destroyer of demons.
My Beloved Lord is pervading each and every heart.

verses.original: ਨਾਲੇ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖੀਐ ਮੂਲੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਿਖੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naale alakh na lakheeaai moole gurmukh likh veechaaraa he ||1||
verses.translation: The unseen Lord is always with us, but He is not seen at all. The Gurmukh contemplates the record. ||1||
The Holy Gurmukh seeks Your Sanctuary.
God grants His Grace, and carries him across to the other side.

verses.original: ਅਗਨਿ ਪਾਣੀ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਅਤਿ ਗਹਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: agan paanee saagar at gaharaa gur satigur paar utaaraa he ||2||
verses.translation: The ocean is very deep, filled with fiery water; the Guru, the True Guru, carries us across to the other side. ||2||
The blind, self-willed manmukh does not understand.
He comes and goes in reincarnation, dying, and dying again.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲੇਖੁ ਨ ਮਿਟਈ ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਅੰਧੁ ਖੁਆਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: poorab likhiaa lekh na miTiee jam dhar a(n)dh khuaaraa he ||3||
verses.translation: The primal inscription of destiny cannot be erased. The spiritually blind suffer terribly at Death's door. ||3||

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: eik aaveh jaaveh ghar vaas na paaveh ||
verses.translation: Some come and go, and do not find a home in their own heart.
Bound by their past actions, they commit sins.

verses.original: ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਲੋਭੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhule sojhee boojh na kaiee lobh buraa aha(n)kaaraa he ||4||
verses.translation: The blind ones have no understanding, no wisdom; they are trapped and ruined by greed and egotism. ||4||

verses.original: ਪਿਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਧਨ ਸੀਗਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: pir bin kiaa tis dhan seegaaraa ||
verses.translation: Without her Husband Lord, what good are the soul-bride's decorations?
She has forgotten her Lord and Master, and is infatuated with another's husband.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਬੇਸੁਆ ਪੂਤ ਬਾਪੁ ਕੋ ਕਹੀਐ ਤਿਉ ਫੋਕਟ ਕਾਰ ਵਿਕਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: jiau besuaa poot baap ko kaheeaai tiau fokaT kaar vikaaraa he ||5||
verses.translation: Just as no one knows who is the father of the prostitute's son, such are the worthless, useless deeds that are done. ||5||
The ghost, in the body-cage, suffers all sorts of afflictions.
Those who are blind to spiritual wisdom, putrefy in hell.

verses.original: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕੀ ਬਾਕੀ ਲੀਜੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: dharam rai kee baakee leejai jin har kaa naam visaaraa he ||6||
verses.translation: The Righteous Judge of Dharma collects the balance due on the account, of those who forget the Name of the Lord. ||6||
The scorching sun blazes with flames of poison.
The self-willed manmukh is dishonored, a beast, a demon.

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਰੋਗੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਬੁਰਿਆਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: aasaa manasaa kooR kamaaveh rog buraa buriaaraa he ||7||
verses.translation: Trapped by hope and desire, he practices falsehood, and is afflicted by the terrible disease of corruption. ||7||
He carries the heavy load of sins on his forehead and head.
How can he cross the terrifying world-ocean?

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: satigur bohith aadh jugaadhee raam naam nisataaraa he ||8||
verses.translation: From the very beginning of time, and throughout the ages, the True Guru has been the boat; through the Lord's Name, He carries us across. ||8||
The love of one's children and spouse is so sweet in this world.
The expansive expanse of the Universe is attachment to Maya.

verses.original: ਜਮ ਕੇ ਫਾਹੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਤੋੜੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: jam ke faahe satigur toRe gurmukh tat beechaaraa he ||9||
verses.translation: The True Guru snaps the noose of Death, for that Gurmukh who contemplates the essence of reality. ||9||
Cheated by falsehood, the self-willed manmukh walks along many paths;
he may be highly educated, but he burns in the fire.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਵਡ ਦਾਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat naam guroo vadd dhaanaa naam japahu sukh saaraa he ||10||
verses.translation: The Guru is the Great Giver of the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord. Chanting the Naam, sublime peace is obtained. ||10||
The True Guru, in His Mercy, implants Truth within.
All suffering is eradicated, and one is placed on the Path.

verses.original: ਕੰਡਾ ਪਾਇ ਨ ਗਡਈ ਮੂਲੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਰਾਖਣਹਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: ka(n)ddaa pai na gaddiee moole jis satigur raakhanahaaraa he ||11||
verses.translation: Not even a thorn ever pierces the foot of one who has the True Guru as his Protector. ||11||
Dust mixes with dust, when the body wastes away.
The self-willed manmukh is like a stone slab, which is impervious to water.

verses.original: ਕਰਣ ਪਲਾਵ ਕਰੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ਨਰਕਿ ਸੁਰਗਿ ਅਵਤਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: karan palaav kare bahutere narak surag avataaraa he ||12||
verses.translation: He cries out and weeps and wails; he is reincarnated into heaven and then hell. ||12||
They live with the poisonous snake of Maya.
This duality has ruined so many homes.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਉਪਜੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਤੇ ਪਤੀਆਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: satigur baajhahu preet na upajai bhagat rate pateeaaraa he ||13||
verses.translation: Without the True Guru, love does not well up. Imbued with devotional worship, the soul is satisfied. ||13||
The faithless cynics chase after Maya.
Forgetting the Naam, how can they find peace?

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਖਪਹਿ ਖਪਾਵਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: tirahu gun a(n)tar khapeh khapaaveh naahee paar utaaraa he ||14||
verses.translation: In the three qualities, they are destroyed; they cannot cross over to the other side. ||14||
The false are called pigs and dogs.

verses.original: ਭਉਕਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਭਉ ਭਉ ਭਉ ਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: bhauk mareh bhau bhau bhau haaraa ||
verses.translation: They bark themselves to death; they bark and bark and howl in fear.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਝੂਠੇ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਹਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: man tan jhooThe kooR kamaaveh dhuramat dharageh haaraa he ||15||
verses.translation: False in mind and body, they practice falsehood; through their evil-mindedness, they lose out in the Court of the Lord. ||15||
Meeting the True Guru, the mind is stabilized.
One who seeks His Sanctuary is blessed with the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: har dhan naam amolak dhevai har jas dharageh piaaraa he ||16||
verses.translation: They are given the priceless wealth of the Lord's Name; singing His Praises, they are His beloveds in His court. ||16||
In the Sanctuary of the Holy, chant the Lord's Name.
Through the True Guru's Teachings, one comes to know His state and extent.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਮੇਲਣਹਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੭॥੩॥੯॥
verses.translit: naanak har jap har man mere har mele melanahaaraa he ||17||3||9||
verses.translation: Nanak: chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my mind; the Lord, the Uniter, shall unite you with Himself. ||17||3||9||
Maaroo, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਘਰਿ ਰਹੁ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੁਗਧ ਇਆਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: ghar rahu re man mugadh iaane ||
verses.translation: Remain in your own home, O my foolish and ignorant mind.
Meditate on the Lord - concentrate deep within your being and meditate on Him.

verses.original: ਲਾਲਚ ਛੋਡਿ ਰਚਹੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰਿ ਇਉ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: laalach chhodd rachahu apara(n)par iau paavahu mukat dhuaaraa he ||1||
verses.translation: Renounce your greed, and merge with the infinite Lord. In this way, you shall find the door of liberation. ||1||
If you forget Him, the Messenger of Death will catch sight of you.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਜਾਹਿ ਦੁਖਾ ਫੁਨਿ ਆਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: sabh sukh jaeh dhukhaa fun aagai ||
verses.translation: All peace will be gone, and you will suffer in pain in the world hereafter.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੀਅੜੇ ਏਹੁ ਪਰਮ ਤਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: raam naam jap gurmukh jeeaRe eh param tat veechaaraa he ||2||
verses.translation: Chant the Name of the Lord as Gurmukh, O my soul; this is the supreme essence of contemplation. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam japahu ras meeThaa ||
verses.translation: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the sweetest essence.
As Gurmukh, see the essence of the Lord deep within.

verses.original: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਹਹੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਏਹੁ ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ahinis raam rahahu ra(n)g raate eh jap tap sa(n)jam saaraa he ||3||
verses.translation: Day and night, remain imbued with the Lord's Love. This is the essence of all chanting, deep meditation and self-discipline. ||3||
Speak the Guru's Word, and the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਮਹਿ ਇਹੁ ਰਸੁ ਟੋਲਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t sabhaa meh ih ras Tolahu ||
verses.translation: In the Society of the Saints, search for this essence.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਖੋਜਿ ਲਹਹੁ ਘਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਗਰਭ ਮਝਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: gurmat khoj lahahu ghar apanaa bahuR na garabh majhaaraa he ||4||
verses.translation: Follow the Guru's Teachings - seek and find the home of your own self, and you shall never be consigned to the womb of reincarnation again. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: sach teerath naavahu har gun gaavahu ||
verses.translation: Bathe at the sacred shrine of Truth, and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
Reflect upon the essence of reality, and lovingly focus your consciousness on the Lord.

verses.original: ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ ਜਮੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: a(n)t kaal jam joh na saakai har bolahu raam piaaraa he ||5||
verses.translation: At the very last moment, the Messenger of Death will not be able to touch you, if you chant the Name of the Beloved Lord. ||5||
The True Guru, the Primal Being, the Great Giver, is all-knowing.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਸੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis a(n)tar saachu su sabadh samaanaa ||
verses.translation: Whoever has Truth within himself, merges in the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਚੂਕਾ ਜਮ ਭੈ ਭਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: jis kau satigur mel milaae tis chookaa jam bhai bhaaraa he ||6||
verses.translation: One whom the True Guru unites in Union, is rid of the overpowering fear of death. ||6||
The body is formed from the union of the five elements.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਲੈ ਚੀਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: tis meh raam ratan lai cheenee ||
verses.translation: Know that the Lord's jewel is within it.

verses.original: ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਆਤਮ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: aatam raam raam hai aatam har paieeaai sabadh veechaaraa he ||7||
verses.translation: The soul is the Lord, and the Lord is the soul; contemplating the Shabad, the Lord is found. ||7||
Abide in truth and contentment, O humble Siblings of Destiny.
Hold tight to compassion and the Sanctuary of the True Guru.

verses.original: ਆਤਮੁ ਚੀਨਿ ਪਰਾਤਮੁ ਚੀਨਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਇਹੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: aatam cheen paraatam cheenahu gur sa(n)gat ih nisataaraa he ||8||
verses.translation: Know your soul, and know the Supreme Soul; associating with the Guru, you shall be emancipated. ||8||
The faithless cynics are stuck in falsehood and deceit.
Day and night, they slander many others.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਗ੍ਰਭ ਜੋਨੀ ਨਰਕ ਮਝਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: bin simaran aaveh fun jaaveh grabh jonee narak majhaaraa he ||9||
verses.translation: Without meditative remembrance, they come and then go, and are cast into the hellish womb of reincarnation. ||9||

verses.original: ਸਾਕਤ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਕਾਣਿ ਨ ਚੂਕੈ ॥
verses.translit: saakat jam kee kaan na chookai ||
verses.translation: The faithless cynic is not rid of his fear of death.

verses.original: ਜਮ ਕਾ ਡੰਡੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਮੂਕੈ ॥
verses.translit: jam kaa dda(n)dd na kabahoo mookai ||
verses.translation: The Messenger of Death's club is never taken away.

verses.original: ਬਾਕੀ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕੀ ਲੀਜੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਅਫਰਿਓ ਭਾਰੁ ਅਫਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: baakee dharam rai kee leejai sir afario bhaar afaaraa he ||10||
verses.translation: He has to answer to the Righteous Judge of Dharma for the account of his actions; the egotistical being carries the unbearable load. ||10||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਕਤੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਕੋ ਤਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: bin gur saakat kahahu ko tariaa ||
verses.translation: Tell me: without the Guru, what faithless cynic has been saved?
Acting egotistically, he falls into the terrifying world-ocean.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਈ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: bin gur paar na paavai koiee har japeeaai paar utaaraa he ||11||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, no one is saved; meditating on the Lord, they are carried across to the other side. ||11||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: gur kee dhaat na meTai koiee ||
verses.translation: No one can erase the Guru's blessings.
The Lord carries across those whom He forgives.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਮਨਿ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: janam maran dhukh neR na aavai man so prabh apar apaaraa he ||12||
verses.translation: The pains of birth and death do not even approach those whose minds are filled with God, the infinite and endless. ||12||
Those who forget the Guru come and go in reincarnation.
They are born, only to die again, and continue committing sins.

verses.original: ਸਾਕਤ ਮੂੜ ਅਚੇਤ ਨ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਤਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਪੁਕਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: saakat mooR achet na cheteh dhukh laagai taa raam pukaaraa he ||13||
verses.translation: The unconscious, foolish, faithless cynic does not remember the Lord; but when he is stricken with pain, then he cries out for the Lord. ||13||

verses.original: ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪੁਰਬ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕੀਏ ॥
verses.translit: sukh dhukh purab janam ke ke'ee ||
verses.translation: Pleasure and pain are the consequences of the actions of past lives.
The Giver, who blesses us with these - He alone knows.

verses.original: ਕਿਸ ਕਉ ਦੋਸੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਤੂ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਸਹੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: kis kau dhos dheh too praanee sahu apanaa keeaa karaaraa he ||14||
verses.translation: So who can you blame, O mortal being? The hardships you suffer are from your own actions. ||14||
Practicing egotism and possessiveness, you have come into the world.
Hope and desire bind you and lead you on.

verses.original: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਤ ਕਿਆ ਲੇ ਚਾਲੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਲਾਦੇ ਛਾਰ ਬਿਕਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: meree meree karat kiaa le chaale bikh laadhe chhaar bikaaraa he ||15||
verses.translation: Indulging in egotism and self-conceit, what will you be able to carry with you, except the load of ashes from poison and corruption? ||15||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਜਨ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: har kee bhagat karahu jan bhaiee ||
verses.translation: Worship the Lord in devotion, O humble Siblings of Destiny.
Speak the Unspoken Speech, and the mind will merge back into the Mind.

verses.original: ਉਠਿ ਚਲਤਾ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਖਹੁ ਘਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਾਟੇ ਕਾਟਣਹਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: auTh chalataa Thaak rakhahu ghar apunai dhukh kaaTe kaaTanahaaraa he ||16||
verses.translation: Restrain your restless mind within its own home, and the Lord, the Destroyer, shall destroy your pain. ||16||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਪਰਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: har gur poore kee oT paraatee ||
verses.translation: I seek the support of the Perfect Guru, the Lord.
The Gurmukh loves the Lord; the Gurmukh realizes the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਹਰਿ ਬਖਸੇ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੭॥੪॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: naanak raam naam mat uootam har bakhase paar utaaraa he ||17||4||10||
verses.translation: O Nanak, through the Lord's Name, the intellect is exalted; granting His forgiveness, the Lord carries him across to the other side. ||17||4||10||
Maaroo, First Mehla:
O Divine Guru, I have entered Your Sanctuary.
You are the Almighty Lord, the Merciful Lord.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੇ ਚੋਜ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਈ ਤੂ ਪੂਰਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tere choj na jaanai koiee too pooraa purakh bidhaataa he ||1||
verses.translation: No one knows Your wondrous plays; You are the perfect Architect of Destiny. ||1||
From the very beginning of time, and throughout the ages, You cherish and sustain Your beings.
You are in each and every heart, O Merciful Lord of incomparable beauty.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਵਹਿ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਕੀਆ ਕਮਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jiau tudh bhaavai tivai chalaaveh sabh tero keeaa kamaataa he ||2||
verses.translation: As You will, You cause all to walk; everyone acts according to Your Command. ||2||
Deep within the nucleus of all, is the Light of the Life of the World.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਘਟ ਭੋਗੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਨ ॥
verses.translit: sabh ghaT bhogai har ras peevan ||
verses.translation: The Lord enjoys the hearts of all, and drinks in their essence.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਲੇਵੈ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਈ ਜਗਤ ਪਿਤ ਦਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aape levai aape dhevai tih loiee jagat pit dhaataa he ||3||
verses.translation: He Himself gives, and He himself takes; He is the generous father of the beings of the three worlds. ||3||
Creating the world, He has set His play into motion.
He placed the soul in the body of air, water and fire.

verses.original: ਦੇਹੀ ਨਗਰੀ ਨਉ ਦਰਵਾਜੇ ਸੋ ਦਸਵਾ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਰਹਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: dhehee nagaree nau dharavaaje so dhasavaa gupat rahaataa he ||4||
verses.translation: The body-village has nine gates; the Tenth Gate remains hidden. ||4||
There are four horrible rivers of fire.
How rare is that Gurmukh who understands this, and through the Word of the Shabad, remains unattached.

verses.original: ਸਾਕਤ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਡੂਬਹਿ ਦਾਝਹਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਰਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: saakat dhuramat ddoobeh dhaajheh gur raakhe har liv raataa he ||5||
verses.translation: The faithless cynics are drowned and burnt through their evil-mindedness. The Guru saves those who are imbued with the Love of the Lord. ||5||
Water, fire, air, earth and ether

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: tin meh pa(n)ch tat ghar vaasaa ||
verses.translation: in that house of the five elements, they dwell.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਤਜਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਭ੍ਰਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: satigur sabadh raheh ra(n)g raataa taj maiaa haumai bhraataa he ||6||
verses.translation: Those who remain imbued with the Word of the True Guru's Shabad, renounce Maya, egotism and doubt. ||6||
This mind is drenched with the Shabad, and satisfied.
Without the Name, what support can anyone have?

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਚੋਰੁ ਮੁਹੈ ਘਰੁ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਇਨਿ ਸਾਕਤਿ ਦੂਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar chor muhai ghar ma(n)dhar in saakat dhoot na jaataa he ||7||
verses.translation: The temple of the body is being plundered by the thieves within, but this faithless cynic does not even recognize these demons. ||7||
They are argumentative demons, terrifying goblins.
These demons stir up conflict and strife.

verses.original: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਵੈ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: sabadh surat bin aavai jaavai pat khoiee aavat jaataa he ||8||
verses.translation: Without awareness of the Shabad, one comes and goes in reincarnation; he loses his honor in this coming and going. ||8||
The body of the false person is just a pile of barren dirt.
Without the Name, what honor can you have?

verses.original: ਬਾਧੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਜਮਕੰਕਰਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਪਰਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: baadhe mukat naahee jug chaare jamaka(n)kar kaal paraataa he ||9||
verses.translation: Bound and gagged throughout the four ages, there is no liberation; the Messenger of Death keeps such a person under his gaze. ||9||
At Death's door, he is tied up and punished;
such a sinner does not obtain salvation.

verses.original: ਕਰਣ ਪਲਾਵ ਕਰੇ ਬਿਲਲਾਵੈ ਜਿਉ ਕੁੰਡੀ ਮੀਨੁ ਪਰਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: karan palaav kare bilalaavai jiau ku(n)ddee meen paraataa he ||10||
verses.translation: He cries out in pain, like the fish pierced by the hook. ||10||
The faithless cynic is caught in the noose all alone.
The miserable spiritually blind person is caught in the power of Death.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਆਜੁ ਕਾਲਿ ਪਚਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: raam naam bin mukat na soojhai aaj kaal pach jaataa he ||11||
verses.translation: Without the Lord's Name, liberation is not known. He shall waste away, today or tomorrow. ||11||
Other than the True Guru, no one is your friend.
Here and hereafter, God is the Savior.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਇਉ ਸਲਲੈ ਸਲਲ ਮਿਲਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: raam naam dhevai kar kirapaa iau salalai salal milaataa he ||12||
verses.translation: He grants His Grace, and bestows the Lord's Name. He merges with Him, like water with water. ||12||
The Guru instructs His wandering Sikhs;
if they go astray, He sets them on the right path.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਖਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: tis gur sev sadhaa dhin raatee dhukh bha(n)jan sa(n)g sakhaataa he ||13||
verses.translation: So serve the Guru, forever, day and night; He is the Destroyer of pain - He is with you as your companion. ||13||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: gur kee bhagat kareh kiaa praanee ||
verses.translation: O mortal being, what devotional worship have you performed to the Guru?
Even Brahma, Indra and Shiva do not know it.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਉ ਲਖੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਖਸੇ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: satigur alakh kahahu kiau lakheeaai jis bakhase tiseh pachhaataa he ||14||
verses.translation: Tell me, how can the unknowable True Guru be known? He alone attains this realization, whom the Lord forgives. ||14||
One who has love within, obtains the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.
One who enshrines love for the Word of the Guru's Bani, meets with Him.

verses.original: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਬਾਈ ਘਟਿ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: ahinis niramal jot sabaiee ghaT dheepak gurmukh jaataa he ||15||
verses.translation: Day and night, the Gurmukh sees the immaculate Divine Light everywhere; this lamp illuminates his heart. ||15||
The food of spiritual wisdom is the supremely sweet essence.
Whoever tastes it, sees the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.

verses.original: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਨਸਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: dharasan dhekh mile bairaagee man manasaa maar samaataa he ||16||
verses.translation: Beholding His Darshan, the unattached one meets the Lord; subduing the mind's desires, he merges into the Lord. ||16||
Those who serve the True Guru are supreme and famous.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: tin ghaT ghaT a(n)tar braham pachhaanaa ||
verses.translation: Deep within each and every heart, they recognize God.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੭॥੫॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: naanak har jas har jan kee sa(n)gat dheejai jin satigur har prabh jaataa he ||17||5||11||
verses.translation: Please bless Nanak with the Lord's Praises, and the Sangat, the Congregation of the Lord's humble servants; through the True Guru, they know their Lord God. ||17||5||11||
Maaroo, First Mehla:
The True Lord is the Creator of the Universe.
He established and contemplates the worldly sphere.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aape karataa kar kar vekhai saachaa veparavaahaa he ||1||
verses.translation: He Himself created the creation, and beholds it; He is True and independent. ||1||
He created the beings of different kinds.
The two travellers have set out in two directions.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਵਿਣੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur poore vin mukat na hoiee sach naam jap laahaa he ||2||
verses.translation: Without the Perfect Guru, no one is liberated. Chanting the True Name, one profits. ||2||

verses.original: ਪੜਹਿ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਪਰੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: paReh manmukh par bidh nahee jaanaa ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs read and study, but they do not know the way.
They do not understand the Naam, the Name of the Lord; they wander, deluded by doubt.

verses.original: ਲੈ ਕੈ ਵਢੀ ਦੇਨਿ ਉਗਾਹੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਾ ਗਲਿ ਫਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: lai kai vaddee dhen ugaahee dhuramat kaa gal faahaa he ||3||
verses.translation: They take bribes, and give false testimony; the noose of evil-mindedness is around their necks. ||3||
They read the Simritees, the Shaastras and the Puraanas;
they argue and debate, but do not know the essence of reality.

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚ ਸੂਚੇ ਸਚੁ ਰਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: vin gur poore tat na paieeaai sach sooche sach raahaa he ||4||
verses.translation: Without the Perfect Guru, the essence of reality is not obtained. The true and pure beings walk the Path of Truth. ||4||
All praise God and listen, and listen and speak.
He Himself is wise, and He Himself judges the Truth.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: jin kau nadhar kare prabh apanee gurmukh sabadh salaahaa he ||5||
verses.translation: Those whom God blesses with His Glance of Grace become Gurmukh, and praise the Word of the Shabad. ||5||
Many listen and listen, and speak the Guru's Bani.

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਕਹੀਐ ਕੋ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: sun kaheeaai ko a(n)t na jaanee ||
verses.translation: Listening and speaking, no one knows His limits.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਬੁਧਿ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: jaa kau alakh lakhaae aape akath kathaa budh taahaa he ||6||
verses.translation: He alone is wise, unto whom the unseen Lord reveals Himself; he speaks the Unspoken Speech. ||6||
At birth, the congratulations pour in;
the ignorant sing songs of joy.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜਨਮੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਪਰ ਮਰਣਾ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਪਇਆ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: jo janamai tis sarapar maranaa kirat piaa sir saahaa he ||7||
verses.translation: Whoever is born, is sure to die, according to the destiny of past deeds inscribed upon his head by the Sovereign Lord King. ||7||
Union and separation were created by my God.
Creating the Universe, He gave it pain and pleasure.

verses.original: ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਭਏ ਨਿਰਾਲੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੀਲੁ ਸਨਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: dhukh sukh hee te bhe niraale gurmukh seel sanaahaa he ||8||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs remain unaffected by pain and pleasure; they wear the armor of humility. ||8||
The noble people are traders in Truth.
They purchase the true merchandise, contemplating the Guru.

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਵਖਰੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੈ ਓਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: sachaa vakhar jis dhan palai sabadh sachai omaahaa he ||9||
verses.translation: One who has the wealth of the true commodity in his lap, is blessed with the rapture of the True Shabad. ||9||
The false dealings lead only to loss.
The trades of the Gurmukh are pleasing to God.

verses.original: ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸਾਬਤੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ ਚੂਕਾ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਫਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: poo(n)jee saabat raas salaamat chookaa jam kaa faahaa he ||10||
verses.translation: His stock is safe, and his capital is safe and sound. The noose of Death is cut away from around his neck. ||10||
Everyone speaks as they please.
The self-willed manmukh, in duality, does not know how to speak.

verses.original: ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਅੰਧਲੀ ਬੋਲੀ ਆਇ ਗਇਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhule kee mat a(n)dhalee bolee aai giaa dhukh taahaa he ||11||
verses.translation: The blind person has a blind and deaf intellect; coming and going in reincarnation, he suffers in pain. ||11||

verses.original: ਦੁਖ ਮਹਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਦੁਖ ਮਹਿ ਮਰਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh meh janamai dhukh meh maranaa ||
verses.translation: In pain he is born, and in pain he dies.

verses.original: ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਮਿਟੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhookh na miTai bin gur kee saranaa ||
verses.translation: His pain is not relieved, without seeking the Sanctuary of the Guru.

verses.original: ਦੂਖੀ ਉਪਜੈ ਦੂਖੀ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਕਿਆ ਲੈ ਆਇਆ ਕਿਆ ਲੈ ਜਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: dhookhee upajai dhookhee binasai kiaa lai aaiaa kiaa lai jaahaa he ||12||
verses.translation: In pain he is created, and in pain he perishes. What has he brought with himself? And what will he take away? ||12||
True are the actions of those who are under the Guru's influence.
They do not come and go in reincarnation, and they are not subject to the laws of Death.

verses.original: ਡਾਲ ਛੋਡਿ ਤਤੁ ਮੂਲੁ ਪਰਾਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਓਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: ddaal chhodd tat mool paraataa man saachaa omaahaa he ||13||
verses.translation: Whoever abandons the branches, and clings to the true root, enjoys true ecstasy within his mind. ||13||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਲੋਗ ਨਹੀ ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: har ke log nahee jam maarai ||
verses.translation: Death cannot strike down the people of the Lord.
They do not see pain on the most difficult path.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਕਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: raam naam ghaT a(n)tar poojaa avar na dhoojaa kaahaa he ||14||
verses.translation: Deep within the nucleus of their hearts, they worship and adore the Lord's Name; there is nothing else at all for them. ||14||
There is no end to the Lord's sermon and Praise.
As it pleases You, I remain under Your Will.

verses.original: ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਧੇ ਜਾਨਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਚੇ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: dharageh paidhe jaan suhele hukam sache paatisaahaa he ||15||
verses.translation: I am embellished with robes of honor in the Court of the Lord, by the Order of the True King. ||15||
How can I chant Your uncounted glories?
Even the greatest of the great do not know Your limits.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਤੂ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੬॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: naanak saach milai pat raakhahu too sir saahaa paatisaahaa he ||16||6||12||
verses.translation: Please bless Nanak with the Truth, and preserve his honor; You are the supreme emperor above the heads of kings. ||16||6||12||
Maaroo, First Mehla, Dakhanee:
Deep within the body-village is the fortress.
The dwelling of the True Lord is within the city of the Tenth Gate.

verses.original: ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਮਾਇਲੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੁ ਉਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: asathir thaan sadhaa niramail aape aap upaidhaa ||1||
verses.translation: This place is permanent and forever immaculate. He Himself created it. ||1||
Within the fortress are balconies and bazaars.
He Himself takes care of His merchandise.

verses.original: ਬਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ਜੜੇ ਜੜਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਖੋਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bajar kapaaT jaRe jaR jaanai gur sabadhee kholaidhaa ||2||
verses.translation: The hard and heavy doors of the Tenth Gate are closed and locked. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they are thrown open. ||2||
Within the fortress is the cave, the home of the self.
He established the nine gates of this house, by His Command and His Will.

verses.original: ਦਸਵੈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਲੇਖੁ ਅਪਾਰੀ ਆਪੇ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dhasavai purakh alekh apaaree aape alakh lakhaidhaa ||3||
verses.translation: In the Tenth Gate, the Primal Lord, the unknowable and infinite dwells; the unseen Lord reveals Himself. ||3||
Within the body of air, water and fire, the One Lord dwells.
He Himself stages His wondrous dramas and plays.

verses.original: ਬਲਦੀ ਜਲਿ ਨਿਵਰੈ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਆਪੇ ਜਲ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: baladhee jal nivarai kirapaa te aape jal nidh paidhaa ||4||
verses.translation: By His Grace, water puts out the burning fire; He Himself stores it up in the watery ocean. ||4||
Creating the earth, He established it as the home of Dharma.
Creating and destroying, He remains unattached.

verses.original: ਪਵਣੈ ਖੇਲੁ ਕੀਆ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ਕਲਾ ਖਿੰਚਿ ਢਾਹਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: pavanai khel keeaa sabh thaiee kalaa khi(n)ch ddaahaidhaa ||5||
verses.translation: He stages the play of the breath everywhere. Withdrawing His power, He lets the beings crumble. ||5||
Your gardener is the vast vegetation of nature.
The wind blowing around is the chauree, the fly-brush, waving over You.

verses.original: ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਦੁਇ ਦੀਪਕ ਰਾਖੇ ਸਸਿ ਘਰਿ ਸੂਰੁ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: cha(n)dh sooraj dhui dheepak raakhe sas ghar soor samaidhaa ||6||
verses.translation: The Lord placed the two lamps, the sun and the moon; the sun merges in the house of the moon. ||6||
The five birds do not fly wild.
The tree of life is fruitful, bearing the fruit of Ambrosial Nectar.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਰਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚੋਗ ਚੁਗਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sahaj ravai gun gaavai har ras chog chugaidhaa ||7||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh intuitively sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord; he eats the food of the Lord's sublime essence. ||7||
The dazzling light glitters, although neither the moon nor the stars are shining;
neither the sun's rays nor the lightning flashes across the sky.

verses.original: ਅਕਥੀ ਕਥਉ ਚਿਹਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: akathee kathau chihan nahee koiee poor rahiaa man bhaidhaa ||8||
verses.translation: I describe the indescribable state, which has no sign, where the all-pervading Lord is still pleasing to the mind. ||8||
The rays of Divine Light have spread out their brilliant radiance.
Having created the creation, the Merciful Lord Himself gazes upon it.

verses.original: ਅਨਹਦ ਰੁਣ ਝੁਣਕਾਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਧੁਨਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: anahadh run jhunakaar sadhaa dhun nirabhau kai ghar vaidhaa ||9||
verses.translation: The sweet, melodious, unstruck sound current vibrates continuously in the home of the fearless Lord. ||9||
When the unstruck sound current resounds, doubt and fear run away.
God is all-pervading, giving shade to all.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਹੈ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: sabh teree too gurmukh jaataa dhar sohai gun gaidhaa ||10||
verses.translation: All belong to You; to the Gurmukhs, You are known. Singing Your Praises, they look beautiful in Your Court. ||10||
He is the Primal Lord, immaculate and pure.
I know of no other at all.

verses.original: ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਗਵਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: eka(n)kaar vasai man bhaavai haumai garab gavaidhaa ||11||
verses.translation: The One Universal Creator Lord dwells within, and is pleasing to the mind of those who banishe egotism and pride. ||11||
I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar, given by the True Guru.
I do not know any other second or third.

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਸੁ ਅਪਰ ਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਪਰਖਿ ਖਜਾਨੈ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: eko eku su apar para(n)par parakh khajaanai paidhaa ||12||
verses.translation: He is the One, Unique, Infinite and Endless Lord; He evaluates all beings and places some in His treasury. ||12||
Spiritual wisdom and meditation on the True Lord are deep and profound.
No one knows Your expanse.

verses.original: ਜੇਤੀ ਹੈ ਤੇਤੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੋ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: jetee hai tetee tudh jaachai karam milai so paidhaa ||13||
verses.translation: All that are, beg from You; You are attained only by Your Grace. ||13||
You hold karma and Dharma in Your hands, O True Lord.
O Independent Lord, Your treasures are inexhaustible.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: too dhiaal kirapaal sadhaa prabh aape mel milaidhaa ||14||
verses.translation: You are forever kind and compassionate, God. You unite in Your Union. ||14||
You Yourself see, and cause Yourself to be seen.
You Yourself establish, and You Yourself disestablish.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਜੋੜਿ ਵਿਛੋੜੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: aape joR vichhoRe karataa aape maar jeevaidhaa ||15||
verses.translation: The Creator Himself unites and separates; He Himself kills and rejuvenates. ||15||
As much as there is, is contained within You.
You gaze upon Your creation, sitting within Your royal palace.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੧॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: naanak saach kahai bena(n)tee har dharasan sukh paidhaa ||16||1||13||
verses.translation: Nanak offers this true prayer; gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, I have found peace. ||16||1||13||
Maaroo, First Mehla:
If I am pleasing to You, Lord, then I obtain the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.
In loving devotional worship, O True Lord, I sing Your Glorious Praises.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਣੇ ਤੂ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਆਪੇ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tudh bhaane too bhaaveh karate aape rasan rasaidhaa ||1||
verses.translation: By Your Will, O Creator Lord, You have become pleasing to me, and so sweet to my tongue. ||1||
The devotees look beautiful in the Darbaar, the Court of God.
Your slaves, Lord, are liberated.

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਤੇਰੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aap gavai terai ra(n)g raate anadhin naam dhiaaidhaa ||2||
verses.translation: Eradicating self-conceit, they are attuned to Your Love; night and day, they meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||
Shiva, Brahma, gods and goddesses,
Indra, ascetics and silent sages serve You.

verses.original: ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਕੇਤੇ ਬਨਵਾਸੀ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jatee satee kete banavaasee a(n)t na koiee paidhaa ||3||
verses.translation: Celibates, givers of charity and the many forest-dwellers have not found the Lord's limits. ||3||
No one knows You, unless You let them know You.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਆਪਣ ਭਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: jo kichh kare su aapan bhaanai ||
verses.translation: Whatever is done, is by Your Will.

verses.original: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਜੀਅ ਉਪਾਏ ਭਾਣੈ ਸਾਹ ਲਵਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: lakh chauraaseeh jeea upaae bhaanai saeh lavaidhaa ||4||
verses.translation: You created the 8.4 million species of beings; by Your Will, they draw their breath. ||4||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਨਿਹਚਉ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jo tis bhaavai so nihachau hovai ||
verses.translation: Whatever is pleasing to Your Will, undoubtedly comes to pass.
The self-willed manmukh shows off, and comes to grief.

verses.original: ਨਾਵਹੁ ਭੁਲਾ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਆਇ ਜਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: naavahu bhulaa Thaur na paae aai jai dhukh paidhaa ||5||
verses.translation: Forgetting the Name, he finds no place of rest; coming and going in reincarnation, he suffers in pain. ||5||
Pure is the body, and immaculate is the swan-soul;
within it is the immaculate essence of the Naam.

verses.original: ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਪੀਵੈ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: sagale dhookh a(n)mrit kar peevai baahuR dhookh na paidhaa ||6||
verses.translation: Such a being drinks in all his pains like Ambrosial Nectar; he never suffers sorrow again. ||6||
For his excessive indulgences, he receives only pain;
from his enjoyments, he contracts diseases, and in the end, he wastes away.

verses.original: ਹਰਖਹੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਨ ਮਿਟਈ ਕਬਹੂ ਵਿਣੁ ਭਾਣੇ ਭਰਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: harakhahu sog na miTiee kabahoo vin bhaane bharamaidhaa ||7||
verses.translation: His pleasure can never erase his pain; without accepting the Lord's Will, he wanders lost and confused. ||7||
Without spiritual wisdom, they all just wander around.
The True Lord is pervading and permeating everywhere, lovingly engaged.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: nirabhau sabadh guroo sach jaataa jotee jot milaidhaa ||8||
verses.translation: The Fearless Lord is known through the Shabad, the Word of the True Guru; one's light merges into the Light. ||8||
He is the eternal, unchanging, immeasurable Lord.
In an instant, He destroys, ang then reconstructs.

verses.original: ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖਿਆ ਮਿਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਭੇਦਿ ਪਤੀਆਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: roop na rekhiaa mit nahee keemat sabadh bhedh pateeaaidhaa ||9||
verses.translation: He has no form or shape, no limit or value. Pierced by the Shabad, one is satisfied. ||9||
I am the slave of Your slaves, O my Beloved.
The seekers of Truth and goodness contemplate You.

verses.original: ਮੰਨੇ ਨਾਉ ਸੋਈ ਜਿਣਿ ਜਾਸੀ ਆਪੇ ਸਾਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: ma(n)ne naau soiee jin jaasee aape saach dhiraRaidhaa ||10||
verses.translation: Whoever believes in the Name, wins; He Himself implants Truth within. ||10||
The Truest of the True has the Truth is His lap.
The True Lord is pleased with those who love the Shabad.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਲਾ ਧਰਿ ਥਾਪੀ ਸਾਚੇ ਹੀ ਪਤੀਆਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: tirabhavan saach kalaa dhar thaapee saache hee pateeaaidhaa ||11||
verses.translation: Exerting His power, the Lord has established Truth throughout the three worlds; with Truth He is pleased. ||11||
Everyone calls Him the greatest of the great.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੋਝੀ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: gur bin sojhee kinai na hoiee ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, no one understands Him.

verses.original: ਸਾਚਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੋ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਏ ਨਾ ਵੀਛੁੜਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: saach milai so saache bhaae naa veechhuR dhukh paidhaa ||12||
verses.translation: The True Lord is pleased with those who merge in Truth; they are not separated again, and they do not suffer. ||12||
Separated from the Primal Lord, they loudly weep and wail.
They die and die, only to be reborn, when their time has passed.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਬਖਸੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਮੇਲਿ ਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: jis bakhase tis dhe vaddiaaiee mel na pachhotaidhaa ||13||
verses.translation: He blesses those whom He forgives with glorious greatness; united with Him, they do not regret or repent. ||13 |
| He Himself is the Creator, and He Himself is the Enjoyer.
He Himself is satisfied, and He Himself is liberated.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਮੁਕਤੀਸਰੁ ਮਮਤਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: aape mukat dhaan mukateesar mamataa moh chukaidhaa ||14||
verses.translation: The Lord of liberation Himself grants liberation; He eradicates possessiveness and attachment. ||14||
I consider Your gifts to be the most wonderful gifts.
You are the Cause of causes, Almighty Infinite Lord.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਕੀਤਾ ਅਪਣਾ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: kar kar vekhai keetaa apanaa karanee kaar karaidhaa ||15||
verses.translation: Creating the creation, You gaze upon what You have created; You cause all to do their deeds. ||15||
They alone sing Your Glorious Praises, who are pleasing to You, O True Lord.

verses.original: ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਉਪਜਹਿ ਤੁਝ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: tujh te upajeh tujh maeh samaaveh ||
verses.translation: They issue forth from You, and merge again into You.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੨॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: naanak saach kahai bena(n)tee mil saache sukh paidhaa ||16||2||14||
verses.translation: Nanak offers this true prayer; meeting with the True Lord, peace is obtained. ||16||2||14||
Maaroo, First Mehla:
For endless eons, there was only utter darkness.
There was no earth or sky; there was only the infinite Command of His Hukam.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਨ ਚੰਦੁ ਨ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naa dhin rain na cha(n)dh na sooraj su(n)n samaadh lagaidhaa ||1||
verses.translation: There was no day or night, no moon or sun; God sat in primal, profound Samaadhi. ||1||

verses.original: ਖਾਣੀ ਨ ਬਾਣੀ ਪਉਣ ਨ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: khaanee na baanee paun na paanee ||
verses.translation: There were no sources of creation or powers of speech, no air or water.
There was no creation or destruction, no coming or going.

verses.original: ਖੰਡ ਪਤਾਲ ਸਪਤ ਨਹੀ ਸਾਗਰ ਨਦੀ ਨ ਨੀਰੁ ਵਹਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kha(n)dd pataal sapat nahee saagar nadhee na neer vahaidhaa ||2||
verses.translation: There were no continents, nether regions, seven seas, rivers or flowing water. ||2||
There were no heavenly realms, earth or nether regions of the underworld.
There was no heaven or hell, no death or time.

verses.original: ਨਰਕੁ ਸੁਰਗੁ ਨਹੀ ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਆਇ ਨ ਜਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: narak surag nahee ja(n)man maranaa naa ko aai na jaidhaa ||3||
verses.translation: There was no hell or heaven, no birth or death, no coming or going in reincarnation. ||3||
There was no Brahma, Vishnu or Shiva.
No one was seen, except the One Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਜਨਮਾ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: naar purakh nahee jaat na janamaa naa ko dhukh sukh paidhaa ||4||
verses.translation: There was no female or male, no social class or caste of birth; no one experienced pain or pleasure. ||4||
There were no people of celibacy or charity; no one lived in the forests.
There were no Siddhas or seekers, no one living in peace.

verses.original: ਜੋਗੀ ਜੰਗਮ ਭੇਖੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਥੁ ਕਹਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: jogee ja(n)gam bhekh na koiee naa ko naath kahaidhaa ||5||
verses.translation: There were no Yogis, no wandering pilgrims, no religious robes; no one called himself the master. ||5||

verses.original: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਨਾ ਬ੍ਰਤ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
verses.translit: jap tap sa(n)jam naa brat poojaa ||
verses.translation: There was no chanting or meditation, no self-discipline, fasting or worship.
No one spoke or talked in duality.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਆਪੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: aape aap upai vigasai aape keemat paidhaa ||6||
verses.translation: He created Himself, and rejoiced; He evaluates Himself. ||6||
There was no purification, no self-restraint, no malas of basil seeds.
There were no Gopis, no Krishna, no cows or cowherds.

verses.original: ਤੰਤੁ ਮੰਤੁ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਵੰਸੁ ਵਜਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: ta(n)t ma(n)t paakha(n)dd na koiee naa ko va(n)s vajaidhaa ||7||
verses.translation: There were no tantras, no mantras and no hypocrisy; no one played the flute. ||7||
There was no karma, no Dharma, no buzzing fly of Maya.
Social class and birth were not seen with any eyes.

verses.original: ਮਮਤਾ ਜਾਲੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਮਾਥੈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਕਿਸੈ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: mamataa jaal kaal nahee maathai naa ko kisai dhiaaidhaa ||8||
verses.translation: There was no noose of attachment, no death inscribed upon the forehead; no one meditated on anything. ||8||

verses.original: ਨਿੰਦੁ ਬਿੰਦੁ ਨਹੀ ਜੀਉ ਨ ਜਿੰਦੋ ॥
verses.translit: ni(n)dh bi(n)dh nahee jeeau na ji(n)dho ||
verses.translation: There was no slander, no seed, no soul and no life.
There was no Gorakh and no Maachhindra.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਤਦਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਕੁਲ ਓਪਤਿ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਗਣਤ ਗਣਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: naa tadh giaan dhiaan kul opat naa ko ganat ganaidhaa ||9||
verses.translation: There was no spiritual wisdom or meditation, no ancestry or creation, no reckoning of accounts. ||9||
There were no castes or social classes, no religious robes, no Brahmin or Kh'shaatriya.
There were no demi-gods or temples, no cows or Gaayatri prayer.

verses.original: ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਨਹੀ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਵਣੁ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਪੂਜਾ ਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: hom jag nahee teerath naavan naa ko poojaa laidhaa ||10||
verses.translation: There were no burnt offerings, no ceremonial feasts, no cleansing rituals at sacred shrines of pilgrimage; no one worshipped in adoration. ||10||

verses.original: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਮੁਲਾ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਕਾਜੀ ॥
verses.translit: naa ko mulaa naa ko kaajee ||
verses.translation: There was no Mullah, there was no Qazi.
There was no Shaykh, or pilgrims to Mecca.

verses.original: ਰਈਅਤਿ ਰਾਉ ਨ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਕਹਣੁ ਕਹਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: rieeat raau na haumai dhuneeaa naa ko kahan kahaidhaa ||11||
verses.translation: There was no king or subjects, and no worldly egotism; no one spoke of himself. ||11||

verses.original: ਭਾਉ ਨ ਭਗਤੀ ਨਾ ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: bhaau na bhagatee naa siv sakatee ||
verses.translation: There was no love or devotion, no Shiva or Shakti - no energy or matter.
There were no friends or companions, no semen or blood.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਹੁ ਆਪੇ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ਸਾਚੇ ਏਹੋ ਭਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: aape saahu aape vanajaaraa saache eho bhaidhaa ||12||
verses.translation: He Himself is the banker, and He Himself is the merchant. Such is the Pleasure of the Will of the True Lord. ||12||
There were no Vedas, Korans or Bibles, no Simritees or Shaastras.
There was no recitation of the Puraanas, no sunrise or sunset.

verses.original: ਕਹਤਾ ਬਕਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: kahataa bakataa aap agochar aape alakh lakhaidhaa ||13||
verses.translation: The Unfathomable Lord Himself was the speaker and the preacher; the unseen Lord Himself saw everything. ||13||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਤਾ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jaa tis bhaanaa taa jagat upaiaa ||
verses.translation: When He so willed, He created the world.
Without any supporting power, He sustained the universe.

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ ਉਪਾਏ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਧਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: brahamaa bisan mahes upaae maiaa moh vadhaidhaa ||14||
verses.translation: He created Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva; He fostered enticement and attachment to Maya. ||14||
How rare is that person who listens to the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
He created the creation, and watches over it; the Hukam of His Command is over all.

verses.original: ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਪਾਤਾਲ ਅਰੰਭੇ ਗੁਪਤਹੁ ਪਰਗਟੀ ਆਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: kha(n)dd brahama(n)dd paataal ara(n)bhe gupatahu paragaTee aaidhaa ||15||
verses.translation: He formed the planets, solar systems and nether regions, and brought what was hidden to manifestation. ||15||

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: taa kaa a(n)t na jaanai koiee ||
verses.translation: No one knows His limits.
This understanding comes from the Perfect Guru.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੀ ਬਿਸਮ ਭਏ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੩॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: naanak saach rate bisamaadhee bisam bhe gun gaidhaa ||16||3||15||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Truth are wonderstruck; singing His Glorious Praises, they are filled with wonder. ||16||3||15||
Maaroo, First Mehla:
He Himself created the creation, remaining unattached.
The Merciful Lord has established His True Home.

verses.original: ਪਉਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਅਗਨੀ ਕਾ ਬੰਧਨੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਕੋਟੁ ਰਚਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: paun paanee aganee kaa ba(n)dhan kaiaa koT rachaidhaa ||1||
verses.translation: Binding together air, water and fire, He created the fortress of the body. ||1||
The Creator established the nine gates.
In the Tenth Gate, is the dwelling of the infinite, unseen Lord.

verses.original: ਸਾਇਰ ਸਪਤ ਭਰੇ ਜਲਿ ਨਿਰਮਲਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sair sapat bhare jal niramal gurmukh mail na laidhaa ||2||
verses.translation: The seven seas are overflowing with the Ambrosial Water; the Gurmukhs are not stained with filth. ||2||
The lamps of the sun and the moon fill all with light.
Creating them, He beholds His own glorious greatness.

verses.original: ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰੂਪ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸਚੇ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jot saroop sadhaa sukhadhaataa sache sobhaa paidhaa ||3||
verses.translation: The Giver of peace is forever the embodiment of Light; from the True Lord, glory is obtained. ||3||
Within the fortress are the stores and markets; the business is transacted there.
The Supreme Merchant weighs with the perfect weights.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਰਤਨੁ ਵਿਸਾਹੇ ਲੇਵੈ ਆਪੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: aape ratan visaahe levai aape keemat paidhaa ||4||
verses.translation: He Himself buys the jewel, and He Himself appraises its value. ||4||
The Appraiser appraises its value.
The Independent Lord is overflowing with His treasures.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਲੇ ਆਪੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਿਸੈ ਬੁਝਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: sarab kalaa le aape rahiaa gurmukh kisai bujhaidhaa ||5||
verses.translation: He holds all powers, He is all-pervading; how few are those who, as Gurmukh, understand this. ||5||
When He bestows His Glance of Grace, one meets the Perfect Guru.
The tyrannical Messenger of Death cannot strike him then.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਬਿਗਾਸੀ ਆਪੇ ਬਿਗਸਿ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: jiau jal a(n)tar kamal bigaasee aape bigas dhiaaidhaa ||6||
verses.translation: He blossoms forth like the lotus flower in the water; he blossoms forth in joyful meditation. ||6||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਵਰਖੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਧਾਰਾ ॥ ਰਤਨ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਲਾਲ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: aape varakhai a(n)mirat dhaaraa || ratan javehar laal apaaraa ||
verses.translation: He Himself rains down the Ambrosial Stream of jewels, diamonds, and rubies of priceless value.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: satigur milai ta pooraa paieeaai prem padhaarath paidhaa ||7||
verses.translation: When they meet the True Guru, then they find the Perfect Lord; they obtain the treasure of Love. ||7||
Whoever receives the priceless treasure of Love

verses.original: ਕਬ ਹੀ ਨ ਘਾਟਸਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਤੋਲੋ ॥
verses.translit: kab hee na ghaaTas pooraa tolo ||
verses.translation: - his weight never decreases; he has perfect weight.

verses.original: ਸਚੇ ਕਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਚੋ ਸਉਦਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: sache kaa vaapaaree hovai sacho saudhaa paidhaa ||8||
verses.translation: The trader of Truth becomes true, and obtains the merchandise. ||8||
How rare are those who obtain the true merchandise.
Meeting the Perfect True Guru, one meets with the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਮਾਨੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: gurmukh hoi su hukam pachhaanai maanai hukam samaidhaa ||9||
verses.translation: One who becomes Gurmukh realizes the Hukam of His command; surrendering to His Command, one merges in the Lord. ||9||
By His Command we come, and by His command we merge into Him again.
By His Command, the world was formed.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਸੁਰਗੁ ਮਛੁ ਪਇਆਲਾ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਕਲਾ ਰਹਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: hukame surag machh piaalaa hukame kalaa rahaidhaa ||10||
verses.translation: By His Command, the heavens, this world and the nether regions were created; by His Command, His Power supports them. ||10||
The Hukam of His Command is the mythical bull which supports the burden of the earth on its head.
By His Hukam, air, water and fire came into being.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਖੇਲ ਖੇਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: hukame siv sakatee ghar vaasaa hukame khel khelaidhaa ||11||
verses.translation: By His Hukam, one dwells in the house of matter and energy - Shiva and Shakti. By His Hukam, He plays His plays. ||11||
By the Hukam of His command, the sky is spread above.
By His Hukam, His creatures dwell in the water, on the land and throughout the three worlds.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਸਾਸ ਗਿਰਾਸ ਸਦਾ ਫੁਨਿ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: hukame saas giraas sadhaa fun hukame dhekh dhikhaidhaa ||12||
verses.translation: By His Hukam, we draw our breath and receive our food; by His Hukam, He watches over us, and inspires us to see. ||12||
By His Hukam, He created His ten incarnations,
and the uncounted and infinite gods and devils.

verses.original: ਮਾਨੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਝੈ ਸਾਚਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: maanai hukamu su dharageh paijhai saach milai samaidhaa ||13||
verses.translation: Whoever obeys the Hukam of His Command, is robed with honor in the Court of the Lord; united with the Truth, He merges in the Lord. ||13||
By the Hukam of His Command, the thirty-six ages passed.
By His Hukam, the Siddhas and seekers contemplate Him.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਨਾਥੁ ਨਥਂੀ ਸਭ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਬਖਸੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: aap naath natha(n)ee sabh jaa kee bakhase mukat karaidhaa ||14||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself has brought all under His control. Whoever He forgives, is liberated. ||14||

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੋਟੁ ਗੜੈ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਜਾ ॥ ਨੇਬ ਖਵਾਸ ਭਲਾ ਦਰਵਾਜਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaiaa koT gaRai meh raajaa || neb khavaas bhalaa dharavaajaa ||
verses.translation: In the strong fortress of the body with its beautiful doors, is the king, with his special assistants and ministers.

verses.original: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਲੋਭੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਲਬਿ ਪਾਪਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: mithiaa lobh naahee ghar vaasaa lab paap pachhutaidhaa ||15||
verses.translation: Those gripped by falsehood and greed do not dwell in the celestial home; engrossed in greed and sin, they come to regret and repent. ||15||
Truth and contentment govern this body-village.
Chastity, truth and self-control are in the Sanctuary of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੪॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: naanak sahaj milai jagajeevan gur sabadhee pat paidhaa ||16||4||16||
verses.translation: O Nanak, one intuitively meets the Lord, the Life of the World; the Word of the Guru's Shabad brings honor. ||16||4||16||
Maaroo, First Mehla:
In the Primal Void, the Infinite Lord assumed His Power.
He Himself is unattached, infinite and incomparable.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਸੁੰਨਹੁ ਸੁੰਨੁ ਉਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aape kudharat kar kar dhekhai su(n)nahu su(n)n upaidhaa ||1||
verses.translation: He Himself exercised His Creative Power, and He gazes upon His creation; from the Primal Void, He formed the Void. ||1||
From this Primal Void, He fashioned air and water.
He created the universe, and the king in the fortress of the body.

verses.original: ਅਗਨਿ ਪਾਣੀ ਜੀਉ ਜੋਤਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਸੁੰਨੇ ਕਲਾ ਰਹਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: agan paanee jeeau jot tumaaree su(n)ne kalaa rahaidhaa ||2||
verses.translation: Your Light pervades fire, water and souls; Your Power rests in the Primal Void. ||2||
From this Primal Void, Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva issued forth.
This Primal Void is pervasive throughout all the ages.

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਪਦ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: eis padh veechaare so jan pooraa tis mileeaai bharam chukaidhaa ||3||
verses.translation: That humble being who contemplates this state is perfect; meeting with him, doubt is dispelled. ||3||
From this Primal Void, the seven seas were established.
The One who created them, Himself contemplates them.

verses.original: ਤਿਤੁ ਸਤ ਸਰਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: tit sat sar manooaa gurmukh naavai fir baahuR jon na paidhaa ||4||
verses.translation: That human being who becomes Gurmukh, who bathes in the pool of Truth, is not cast into the womb of reincarnation again. ||4||
From this Primal Void, came the moon, the sun and the earth.
His Light pervades all the three worlds.

verses.original: ਸੁੰਨੇ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਸੁੰਨੇ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: su(n)ne alakh apaar niraalam su(n)ne taaRee laidhaa ||5||
verses.translation: The Lord of this Primal Void is unseen, infinite and immaculate; He is absorbed in the Primal Trance of Deep Meditation. ||5||
From this Primal Void, the earth and the Akaashic Ethers were created.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਥੰਮਾ ਰਾਖੇ ਸਚੁ ਕਲ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: bin tha(n)maa raakhe sach kal paae ||
verses.translation: He supports them without any visible support, by exercising His True Power.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸਾਜਿ ਮੇਖੁਲੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਖਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: tirabhavan saaj mekhulee maiaa aap upai khapaidhaa ||6||
verses.translation: He fashioned the three worlds, and the rope of Maya; He Himself creates and destroys. ||6||
From this Primal Void, came the four sources of creation, and the power of speech.
They were created from the Void, and they will merge into the Void.

verses.original: ਉਤਭੁਜੁ ਚਲਤੁ ਕੀਆ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਦੇਖਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: autabhuj chalat keeaa sir karatai bisamaadh sabadh dhekhaidhaa ||7||
verses.translation: The Supreme Creator created the play of Nature; through the Word of His Shabad, He stages His Wondrous Show. ||7||
From this Primal Void, He made both night and day;
creation and destruction, pleasure and pain.

verses.original: ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਅਮਰੁ ਅਤੀਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਜ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: sukh dhukh hee te amar ateetaa gurmukh nij ghar paidhaa ||8||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh is immortal, untouched by pleasure and pain. He obtains the home of his own inner being. ||8||
The Saam Veda, the Rig Veda, the Jujar Veda and the At'harva Veda

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਹੈ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ॥
verses.translit: brahame mukh maiaa hai trai gun ||
verses.translation: form the mouth of Brahma; they speak of the three gunas, the three qualities of Maya.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋ ਤਿਉ ਬੋਲੇ ਜਿਉ ਬੋਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: taa kee keemat keh na sakai ko tiau bole jiau bolaidhaa ||9||
verses.translation: None of them can describe His worth. We speak as He inspires us to speak. ||9||
From the Primal Void, He created the seven nether regions.
From the Primal Void, He established this world to lovingly dwell upon Him.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕੀਆ ਅਪਰੰਪਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਕੀਆ ਕਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: aape kaaran keeaa apara(n)par sabh tero keeaa kamaidhaa ||10||
verses.translation: The Infinite Lord Himself created the creation. Everyone acts as You make them act, Lord. ||10||

verses.original: ਰਜ ਤਮ ਸਤ ਕਲ ਤੇਰੀ ਛਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: raj tam sat kal teree chhaiaa ||
verses.translation: Your Power is diffused through the three gunas: raajas, taamas and satva.
Through egotism, they suffer the pains of birth and death.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਣਿ ਚਉਥੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: jis no kirapaa kare har gurmukh gun chauthai mukat karaidhaa ||11||
verses.translation: Those blessed by His Grace become Gurmukh; they attain the fourth state, and are liberated. ||11||
From the Primal Void, the ten incarnations welled up.
Creating the Universe, He made the expanse.

verses.original: ਦੇਵ ਦਾਨਵ ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬ ਸਾਜੇ ਸਭਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: dhev dhaanav gan ga(n)dharab saaje sabh likhiaa karam kamaidhaa ||12||
verses.translation: He fashioned the demi-gods and demons, the heavenly heralds and celestial musicians; everyone acts according to their past karma. ||12||
The Gurmukh understands, and does not suffer the disease.

verses.original: ਇਹ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪਉੜੀ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: eeh gur kee pauRee jaanai jan koiee ||
verses.translation: How rare are those who understand this ladder of the Guru.

verses.original: ਜੁਗਹ ਜੁਗੰਤਰਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਰਾਇਣ ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਇਆ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: jugeh juga(n)tar mukat parain so mukat bhiaa pat paidhaa ||13||
verses.translation: Throughout the ages, they are dedicated to liberation, and so they become liberated; thus they are honored. ||13||
From the Primal Void, the five elements became manifest.
They joined to form the body, which engages in actions.

verses.original: ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਦੁਇ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੀਖੇ ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਬੀਜਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: buraa bhalaa dhui masatak leekhe paap pu(n)n beejaidhaa ||14||
verses.translation: Both bad and good are written on the forehead, the seeds of vice and virtue. ||14||
The True Guru, the Primal Being, is sublime and detached.
Attuned to the Word of the Shabad, He is intoxicated with the sublime essence of the Lord.

verses.original: ਰਿਧਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: ridh budh sidh giaan guroo te paieeaai poorai bhaag milaidhaa ||15||
verses.translation: Riches, intellect, miraculous spiritual powers and spiritual wisdom are obtained from the Guru; through perfect destiny, they are received. ||15||

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਉ ਨੇਹੁ ਘਨੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: eis man maiaa kau neh ghaneraa ||
verses.translation: This mind is so in love with Maya.
Only a few are spiritually wise enough to understand and know this.

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਹਸਾ ਨਰੁ ਲੋਭੀ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: aasaa manasaa haumai sahasaa nar lobhee kooR kamaidhaa ||16||
verses.translation: In hope and desire, egotism and skepticism, the greedy man acts falsely. ||16||
From the True Guru, contemplative meditation is obtained.
And then, one dwells with the True Lord in His celestial home, the Primal State of Absorption in Deepest Samaadhi.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਦੁ ਸਬਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਸਚੁ ਰਾਮੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੭॥੫॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: naanak niramal naadh sabadh dhun sach raamai naam samaidhaa ||17||5||17||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the immaculate sound current of the Naad, and the Music of the Shabad resound; one merges into the True Name of the Lord. ||17||5||17||
Maaroo, First Mehla:
Wherever I look, I see the Lord, merciful to the meek.
God is compassionate; He does not come or go in reincarnation.

verses.original: ਜੀਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਰਹਿਓ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jeeaa a(n)dhar jugat samaiee rahio niraalam raiaa ||1||
verses.translation: He pervades all beings in His mysterious way; the Sovereign Lord remains detached. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਗੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਛਾਇਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਾਪੁ ਨ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jag tis kee chhaiaa jis baap na maiaa ||
verses.translation: The world is a reflection of Him; He has no father or mother.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭੈਣ ਨ ਭਰਾਉ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: naa tis bhain na bharaau kamaiaa ||
verses.translation: He has not acquired any sister or brother.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਓਪਤਿ ਖਪਤਿ ਕੁਲ ਜਾਤੀ ਓਹੁ ਅਜਰਾਵਰੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naa tis opat khapat kul jaatee oh ajaraavar man bhaiaa ||2||
verses.translation: There is no creation or destruction for Him; He has no ancestry or social status. The Ageless Lord is pleasing to my mind. ||2||

verses.original: ਤੂ ਅਕਾਲ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: too akaal purakh naahee sir kaalaa ||
verses.translation: You are the Deathless Primal Being. Death does not hover over Your head.
You are the unseen inaccessible and detached Primal Lord.

verses.original: ਸਤ ਸੰਤੋਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਅਤਿ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸਹਜ ਭਾਇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sat sa(n)tokh sabadh at seetal sahaj bhai liv laiaa ||3||
verses.translation: You are true and content; the Word of Your Shabad is cool and soothing. Through it, we are lovingly, intuitively attuned to You. ||3||
The three qualities are pervasive; the Lord dwells in His home, the fourth state.
He has made death and birth into a bite of food.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰਬ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: niramal jot sarab jagajeevan gur anahadh sabadh dhikhaiaa ||4||
verses.translation: The immaculate Light is the Life of the whole world. The Guru reveals the unstruck melody of the Shabad. ||4||

verses.original: ਊਤਮ ਜਨ ਸੰਤ ਭਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: uootam jan sa(n)t bhale har piaare ||
verses.translation: Sublime and good are those humble Saints, the Beloveds of the Lord.
They are intoxicated with the sublime essence of the Lord, and are carried across to the other side.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਰੇਣ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak ren sa(n)t jan sa(n)gat har gur parasaadhee paiaa ||5||
verses.translation: Nanak is the dust of the Society of the Saints; by Guru's Grace, he finds the Lord. ||5||
You are the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. All beings belong to You.
You are the Great Giver; I am Your slave.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਰਤਨੁ ਦੀਪਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat naam kirapaa kar dheejai gur giaan ratan dheepaiaa ||6||
verses.translation: Please be merciful and bless me with Your Ambrosial Naam, and the jewel, the lamp of the Guru's spiritual wisdom. ||6||

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch tat mil ih tan keeaa ||
verses.translation: From the union of the five elements, this body was made.
Finding the Lord, the Supreme Soul, peace is established.

verses.original: ਕਰਮ ਕਰਤੂਤਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: karam karatoot a(n)mirat fal laagaa har naam ratan man paiaa ||7||
verses.translation: The good karma of past actions brings fruitful rewards, and man is blessed with the jewel of the Lord's Name. ||7||

verses.original: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭੂਖ ਪਿਆਸ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: naa tis bhookh piaas man maaniaa ||
verses.translation: His mind does not feel any hunger or thirst.
He knows the Immaculate Lord to be everywhere, in each and every heart.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਕੇਵਲ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਸੁਭਾਇਆ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat ras raataa keval bairaagee gurmat bhai subhaiaa ||8||
