verses.translation: Imbued with the Lord's Ambrosial essence, he becomes a pure, detached renunciate; he is lovingly absorbed in the Guru's Teachings. ||8||
Whoever does the deeds of the soul, day and night,
sees the immaculate Divine Light deep within.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੁ ਰਸਾਲੁ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਬੇਣੁ ਰਸਾਲੁ ਵਜਾਇਆ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: sabadh rasaal rasan ras rasanaa ben rasaal vajaiaa ||9||
verses.translation: Enraptured with the delightful essence of the Shabad, the source of nectar, my tongue plays the sweet music of the flute. ||9||
He alone plays the sweet music of this flute,
who knows the three worlds.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਬੂਝਹੁ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: naanak boojhahu ieh bidh gurmat har raam naam liv laiaa ||10||
verses.translation: O Nanak, know this, through the Guru's Teachings, and lovingly focus yourself on the Lord's Name. ||10||
Rare are those beings in this world,
who contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and remain detached.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਤਰਹਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਜਗਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: aap tareh sa(n)gat kul taareh tin safal janam jag aaiaa ||11||
verses.translation: They save themselves, and save all their associates and ancestors; fruitful is their birth and coming into this world. ||11||
He alone knows the home of his own heart, and the door to the temple,

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jis poore gur te sojhee hoiee ||
verses.translation: who obtains perfect understanding from the Guru.

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਗੜ ਮਹਲ ਮਹਲੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਤਖਤੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: kaiaa gaR mahal mahalee prabh saachaa sach saachaa takhat rachaiaa ||12||
verses.translation: In the body-fortress is the palace; God is the True Master of this Palace. The True Lord established His True Throne there. ||12||

verses.original: ਚਤੁਰ ਦਸ ਹਾਟ ਦੀਵੇ ਦੁਇ ਸਾਖੀ ॥
verses.translit: chatur dhas haaT dheeve dhui saakhee ||
verses.translation: The fourteen realms and the two lamps are the witnesses.
The Lord's servants, the self-elect, do not taste the poison of corruption.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਅਨੂਪ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar vasat anoop niramolak gur miliaai har dhan paiaa ||13||
verses.translation: Deep within, is the priceless, incomparable commodity; meeting with the Guru, the wealth of the Lord is obtained. ||13||
He alone sits on the throne, who is worthy of the throne.
Following the Guru's Teachings, he subdues the five demons, and becomes the Lord's foot soldier.

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦੀ ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ਸਹਸਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: aadh jugaadhee hai bhee hosee sahasaa bharam chukaiaa ||14||
verses.translation: He has existed from the very beginning of time and throughout the ages; He exists here and now, and will always exist. Meditating on Him, skepticism and doubt are dispelled. ||14||
The Lord of the Throne is greeted and worshipped day and night.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਜਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: eih saach vaddaiee gurmat liv jaatee ||
verses.translation: This true glorious greatness comes to those who love the Guru's Teachings.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਤਰੁ ਤਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਖਾਈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੫॥੧॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: naanak raam japahu tar taaree har a(n)t sakhaiee paiaa ||15||1||18||
verses.translation: O Nanak, meditate on the Lord, and swim across the river; they find the Lord, their best friend, in the end. ||15||1||18||
Maaroo, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਰੇ ਜਨ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: har dhan sa(n)chahu re jan bhaiee ||
verses.translation: Gather in the wealth of the Lord, O humble Siblings of Destiny.
Serve the True Guru, and remain in His Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਤਸਕਰੁ ਚੋਰੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਗਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tasakar chor na laagai taa kau dhun upajai sabadh jagaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: This wealth cannot be stolen; the celestial melody of the Shabad wells up and keeps us awake and aware. ||1||
You are the One Universal Creator, the Immaculate King.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰਹਿ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਕਾਜਾ ॥
verses.translit: too aap savaareh jan ke kaajaa ||
verses.translation: You Yourself arrange and resolve the affairs of Your humble servant.

verses.original: ਅਮਰੁ ਅਡੋਲੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਅਸਥਿਰ ਥਾਨਿ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: amar addol apaar amolak har asathir thaan suhaiaa ||2||
verses.translation: You are immortal, immovable, infinite and priceless; O Lord, Your place is beautiful and eternal. ||2||
In the body-village, the most sublime place,
the supremely noble people dwell.

verses.original: ਊਪਰਿ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: uoopar eka(n)kaar niraalam su(n)n samaadh lagaiaa ||3||
verses.translation: Above them is the Immaculate Lord, the One Universal Creator; they are lovingly absorbed in the profound, primal state of Samaadhi. ||3||
There are nine gates to the body-village;
the Creator Lord fashioned them for each and every person.

verses.original: ਦਸਵੈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਤੀਤੁ ਨਿਰਾਲਾ ਆਪੇ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: dhasavai purakh ateet niraalaa aape alakh lakhaiaa ||4||
verses.translation: Within the Tenth Gate, dwells the Primal Lord, detached and unequalled. The unknowable reveals Himself. ||4||
The Primal Lord cannot be held to account; True is His Celestial Court.
The Hukam of His Command is in effect; True is His Insignia.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਖੋਜਿ ਲਹਹੁ ਘਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak khoj lahahu ghar apanaa har aatam raam naam paiaa ||5||
verses.translation: O Nanak, search and examine your own home, and you shall find the Supreme Soul, and the Name of the Lord. ||5||
The Primal Lord is everywhere, immaculate and all-knowing.
He administers justice, and is absorbed in the spiritual wisdom of the Guru.

verses.original: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੈ ਗਰਦਨਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਲੋਭੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh lai garadhan maare haumai lobh chukaiaa ||6||
verses.translation: He seizes sexual desire and anger by their necks, and kills them; He eradicates egotism and greed. ||6||
In the True Place, the Formless Lord abides.
Whoever understands his own self, contemplates the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਚੈ ਮਹਲਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: sachai mahal nivaas nira(n)tar aavan jaan chukaiaa ||7||
verses.translation: He comes to abide deep within the True Mansion of His Presence, and his comings and goings are ended. ||7||

verses.original: ਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਚਲੈ ਨ ਪਉਣੁ ਉਡਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: naa man chalai na paun uddaavai ||
verses.translation: His mind does not waver, and he is not buffeted by the winds of desire.
Such a Yogi vibrates the unstruck sound current of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਸਬਦ ਝੁਣਕਾਰੁ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪੇ ਵਾਇ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch sabadh jhunakaar niraalam prabh aape vai sunaiaa ||8||
verses.translation: God Himself plays the pure music of the Panch Shabad, the five primal sounds to hear. ||8||
In the Fear of God, in detachment, one intuitively merges into the Lord.
Renouncing egotism, he is imbued with the unstruck sound current.

verses.original: ਅੰਜਨੁ ਸਾਰਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: a(n)jan saar nira(n)jan jaanai sarab nira(n)jan raiaa ||9||
verses.translation: With the ointment of enlightenment, the Immaculate Lord is known; the Immaculate Lord King is pervading everywhere. ||9||
God is eternal and imperishable; He is the Destroyer of pain and fear.
He cures the disease, and cuts away the noose of death.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋ ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: naanak har prabh so bhau bha(n)jan gur miliaai har prabh paiaa ||10||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Lord God is the Destroyer of fear; meeting the Guru, the Lord God is found. ||10||
One who knows the Immaculate Lord chews up death.
One who understands karma, realizes the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਚੋਜੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: aape jaanai aap pachhaanai sabh tis kaa choj sabaiaa ||11||
verses.translation: He Himself knows, and He Himself realizes. This whole world is all His play. ||11||
He Himself is the Banker, and He Himself is the Merchant.
The Appraiser Himself appraises.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕਸਿ ਕਸਵਟੀ ਲਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: aape kas kasavaTee laae aape keemat paiaa ||12||
verses.translation: He Himself tests upon His Touchstone, and He Himself estimates the value. ||12||
God Himself, the Merciful Lord, grants His Grace.
The Gardener pervades and permeates each and every heart.

verses.original: ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਤੀਤੁ ਵਸੈ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖੈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: purakh ateet vasai nihakeval gur purakhai purakh milaiaa ||13||
verses.translation: The pure, primal, detached Lord abides within all. The Guru, the Lord Incarnate, leads us to meet the Lord God. ||13||
God is wise and all-knowing; He purges men of their pride.
Eradicating duality, the One Lord reveals Himself.

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਅਕੁਲ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: aasaa maeh niraalam jonee akul nira(n)jan gaiaa ||14||
verses.translation: Such a being remains unattached amidst hope, singing the Praise of the Immaculate Lord, who has no ancestry. ||14||
Eradicating egotism, he obtains the peace of the Shabad.
He alone is spiritually wise, who contemplates his own self.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਲਾਹਾ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੫॥੨॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: naanak har jas har gun laahaa satasa(n)gat sach fal paiaa ||15||2||19||
verses.translation: O Nanak, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the true profit is obtained; in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, the fruit of Truth is obtained. ||15||2||19||
Maaroo, First Mehla:
Speak the Truth, and remain in the home of Truth.
Remain dead while yet alive, and cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਬੇੜੀ ਤੁਲਹਾ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur bohith gur beRee tulahaa man har jap paar la(n)ghaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: The Guru is the boat, the ship, the raft; meditating on the Lord in your mind, you shall be carried across to the other side. ||1||
Eliminating egotism, possessiveness and greed,
one is liberated from the nine gates, and obtains a place in the Tenth Gate.

verses.original: ਊਪਰਿ ਪਰੈ ਪਰੈ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: uoopar parai parai apara(n)par jin aape aap upaiaa ||2||
verses.translation: Lofty and high, the farthest of the far and infinite, He created Himself. ||2||
Receiving the Guru's Teachings, and lovingly attuned to the Lord, one crosses over.

verses.original: ਅਕਲੁ ਗਾਇ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਕਿਆ ਡਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: akal gai jam te kiaa ddareeaai ||
verses.translation: Singing the Praises of the absolute Lord, why should anyone be afraid of death?

verses.original: ਜਤ ਜਤ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਤ ਤਤ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jat jat dhekhau tat tat tum hee avar na dhuteeaa gaiaa ||3||
verses.translation: Wherever I look, I see only You; I do not sing of any other at all. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਸਰਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: sach har naam sach hai saranaa ||
verses.translation: True is the Lord's Name, and True is His Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਜਿਤੈ ਲਗਿ ਤਰਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: sach gur sabadh jitai lag taranaa ||
verses.translation: True is the Word of the Guru's Shabad, grasping it, one is carries across.

verses.original: ਅਕਥੁ ਕਥੈ ਦੇਖੈ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਫੁਨਿ ਗਰਭਿ ਨ ਜੋਨੀ ਜਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: akath kathai dhekhai apara(n)par fun garabh na jonee jaiaa ||4||
verses.translation: Speaking the Unspoken, one sees the Infinite Lord, and then, he does not have to enter the womb of reincarnation again. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਚ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: sach bin sat sa(n)tokh na paavai ||
verses.translation: Without the Truth, no one finds sincerity or contentment.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: bin gur mukat na aavai jaavai ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, no one is liberated; coming and going in reincarnation continue.

verses.original: ਮੂਲ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: mool ma(n)tr har naam rasain kahu naanak pooraa paiaa ||5||
verses.translation: Chanting the Mool Mantra, and the Name of the Lord, the source of nectar, says Nanak, I have found the Perfect Lord. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਚ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਤਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sach bin bhavajal jai na tariaa ||
verses.translation: Without the Truth, the terrifying world-ocean cannot be crossed.

verses.original: ਏਹੁ ਸਮੁੰਦੁ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਭਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: eh samu(n)dh athaahu mahaa bikh bhariaa ||
verses.translation: This ocean is vast and unfathomable; it is overflowing with the worst poison.

verses.original: ਰਹੈ ਅਤੀਤੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਲੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: rahai ateet gurmat le uoopar har nirabhau kai ghar paiaa ||6||
verses.translation: One who receives the Guru's Teachings, and remains aloof and detached, obtains a place in the home of the Fearless Lord. ||6||
False is the cleverness of loving attachment to the world.
In no time at all, it comes and goes.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ਉਪਜੈ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਖਪਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: naam visaar chaleh abhimaanee upajai binas khapaiaa ||7||
verses.translation: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the proud egotistical people depart; in creation and destruction they are wasted away. ||7||
In creation and destruction, they are bound in bondage.
The noose of egotism and Maya is around their necks.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸੋ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਬੰਧਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: jis raam naam naahee mat gurmat so jam pur ba(n)dh chalaiaa ||8||
verses.translation: Whoever does not accept the Guru's Teachings, and does not dwell upon the Lord's Name, is bound and bagged, and dragged into the City of Death. ||8||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੋਖ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: gur bin mokh mukat kiau paieeaai ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, how can anyone be emancipated or liberated?

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਿਉ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: bin gur raam naam kiau dhiaaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, how can anyone meditate on the Lord's Name?

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਤਰਹੁ ਭਵ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਏ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: gurmat leh tarahu bhav dhutar mukat bhe sukh paiaa ||9||
verses.translation: Accepting the Guru's Teachings, cross over the arduous, terrifying world-ocean; you shall be emancipated, and find peace. ||9||
Through the Guru's Teachings, Krishna lifted up the mountain of Govardhan.
Through the Guru's Teachings, Rama floated stones across the ocean.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: gurmat leh param padh paieeaai naanak gur bharam chukaiaa ||10||
verses.translation: Accepting the Guru's Teachings, the supreme status is obtained; O Nanak, the Guru eradicates doubt. ||10||
Accepting the Guru's Teachings, cross over to the other side through Truth.
O soul, remember the Lord within your heart.

verses.original: ਜਮ ਕੇ ਫਾਹੇ ਕਾਟਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਅਕੁਲ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: jam ke faahe kaaTeh har jap akul nira(n)jan paiaa ||11||
verses.translation: The noose of death is cut away, meditating on the Lord; you shall obtain the Immaculate Lord, who has no ancestry. ||11||
Through the Guru's Teachings, the Holy become one's friends and Siblings of Destiny.
Through the Guru's Teachings, the inner fire is subdued and extinguished.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: man mukh naam japahu jagajeevan ridh a(n)tar alakh lakhaiaa ||12||
verses.translation: Chant the Naam with your mind and mouth; know the unknowable Lord, the Life of the World, deep within the nucleus of your heart. ||12||
The Gurmukh understands, and is pleased with the Word of the Shabad.
Who does he praise or slander?

verses.original: ਚੀਨਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਜਗਦੀਸਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਗੰਨਾਥੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: cheenahu aap japahu jagadheesar har jaga(n)naath man bhaiaa ||13||
verses.translation: Know yourself, and meditate on the Lord of the Universe; let your mind be pleased with the Lord, the Master of the Universe. ||13||
Know the One who pervades all the realms of the universe.
As Gurmukh, understand and realize the Shabad.

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਭੋਗੇ ਭੋਗਣਹਾਰਾ ਰਹੈ ਅਤੀਤੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT bhoge bhoganahaaraa rahai ateet sabaiaa ||14||
verses.translation: The Enjoyer enjoys each and every heart, and yet He remains detached from all. ||14||
Through the Guru's Teachings, chant the Pure Praises of the Lord.
Through the Guru's Teachings, behold the lofty Lord with your eyes.

verses.original: ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੰਗਾਇਆ ॥੧੫॥੩॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: sravanee naam sunai har baanee naanak har ra(n)g ra(n)gaiaa ||15||3||20||
verses.translation: Whoever listens to the Lord's Name, and the Word of His Bani, O Nanak, is imbued with the color of the Lord's Love. ||15||3||20||
Maaroo, First Mehla:
Leave behind sexual desire, anger and the slander of others.
Renounce greed and possessiveness, and become carefree.

verses.original: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕਾ ਸੰਗਲੁ ਤੋੜਿ ਨਿਰਾਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bhram kaa sa(n)gal toR niraalaa har a(n)tar har ras paiaa ||1||
verses.translation: Break the chains of doubt, and remain unattached; you shall find the Lord, and the Lord's sublime essence, deep within yourself. ||1||

verses.original: ਨਿਸਿ ਦਾਮਨਿ ਜਿਉ ਚਮਕਿ ਚੰਦਾਇਣੁ ਦੇਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: nis dhaaman jiau chamak cha(n)dhain dhekhai ||
verses.translation: As one sees the flash of lightning in the night,
see the Divine Light deep within your nucleus, day and night.

verses.original: ਆਨੰਦ ਰੂਪੁ ਅਨੂਪੁ ਸਰੂਪਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੇਖਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aana(n)dh roop anoop saroopaa gur poorai dhekhaiaa ||2||
verses.translation: The Lord, the embodiment of bliss, incomparably beautiful, reveals the Perfect Guru. ||2||
So meet with the True Guru, and God Himself will save you.
He placed the lamps of the sun and the moon in the home of the sky.

verses.original: ਦੇਖਿ ਅਦਿਸਟੁ ਰਹਹੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਸਭੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dhekh adhisaT rahahu liv laagee sabh tirabhavan braham sabaiaa ||3||
verses.translation: See the invisible Lord, and remain absorbed in loving devotion. God is all throughout the three worlds. ||3||

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਏ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭਉ ਜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat ras paae tirasanaa bhau jaae ||
verses.translation: Obtaining the sublime ambrosial essence, desire and fear are dispelled.
The state of inspired illumination is obtained, and self-conceit is eradicated.

verses.original: ਊਚੀ ਪਦਵੀ ਊਚੋ ਊਚਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: uoochee padhavee uoocho uoochaa niramal sabadh kamaiaa ||4||
verses.translation: The lofty and exalted state, the highest of the high is obtained, practicing the immaculate Word of the Shabad. ||4||
The Naam, the Name of the invisible and unfathomable Lord, is infinite.
The sublime essence of the Beloved Naam is utterly sweet.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak kau jug jug har jas dheejai har japeeaai a(n)t na paiaa ||5||
verses.translation: O Lord, please bless Nanak with Your Praise in each and every age; meditating on the Lord, I cannot find His limits. ||5||
With the Naam deep within the nucleus of the self, the jewel is obtained.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਧੀਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: har japate man man te dheeraa ||
verses.translation: Meditating on the Lord, the mind is comforted and consoled by the mind itself.

verses.original: ਦੁਘਟ ਘਟ ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਜਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: dhughaT ghaT bhau bha(n)jan paieeaai baahuR janam na jaiaa ||6||
verses.translation: On that most difficult path, the Destroyer of fear is found, and one does not have to enter the womb of reincarnation again. ||6||
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, inspiration for loving devotional worship wells up.
I beg for the treasure of the Naam, and the Lord's Praise.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਤਾਰੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: har bhaavai gur mel milaae har taare jagat sabaiaa ||7||
verses.translation: When it pleases the Lord, He unites me in Union with the Guru; the Lord saves the whole world. ||7||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਿਓ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਤਿ ਵਾ ਕੇ ॥
verses.translit: jin jap japio satigur mat vaa ke ||
verses.translation: One who chants the Lord's Chant, attains the Wisdom of the True Guru.

verses.original: ਜਮਕੰਕਰ ਕਾਲੁ ਸੇਵਕ ਪਗ ਤਾ ਕੇ ॥
verses.translit: jamaka(n)kar kaal sevak pag taa ke ||
verses.translation: The tyrant, the Messenger of Death, becomes a servant at his feet.

verses.original: ਊਤਮ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਜਗੁ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: uootam sa(n)gat gat mit uootam jag bhaujal paar taraiaa ||8||
verses.translation: In the noble congregation of the Sangat, one's state and way of life become noble as well, and one crosses over the terrifying world-ocean. ||8||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰ ਤਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: eih bhavajal jagat sabadh gur tareeaai ||
verses.translation: Through the Shabad, one crosses over this terrifying world-ocean.
The duality within is burnt away from within.

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਬਾਣ ਲੇ ਜਮ ਕਉ ਮਾਰੈ ਗਗਨੰਤਰਿ ਧਣਖੁ ਚੜਾਇਆ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch baan le jam kau maarai gagana(n)tar dhanakh chaRaiaa ||9||
verses.translation: Taking up the five arrows of virtue, Death is killed, drawing the Bow of the Tenth Gate in the Mind's Sky. ||9||

verses.original: ਸਾਕਤ ਨਰਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: saakat nar sabadh surat kiau paieeaai ||
verses.translation: How can the faithless cynics attain enlightened awareness of the Shabad?
Without awareness of the Shabad, they come and go in reincarnation.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਰਾਇਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh mukat parain har poorai bhaag milaiaa ||10||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh obtains the support of liberation; by perfect destiny, he meets the Lord. ||10||
The Fearless True Guru is our Savior and Protector.
Devotional worship is obtained through the Guru, the Lord of the world.

verses.original: ਧੁਨਿ ਅਨੰਦ ਅਨਾਹਦੁ ਵਾਜੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: dhun ana(n)dh anaahadh vaajai gur sabadh nira(n)jan paiaa ||11||
verses.translation: The blissful music of the unstruck sound current vibrates and resounds; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Immaculate Lord is obtained. ||11||
He alone is fearless, who has no destiny written on His head.
God Himself is unseen; He reveals Himself through His wondrous creative power.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਅਤੀਤੁ ਅਜੋਨੀ ਸੰਭਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: aap ateet ajonee sa(n)bhau naanak gurmat so paiaa ||12||
verses.translation: He Himself is unattached, unborn and self-existent. O Nanak, through the Guru's Teachings, He is found. ||12||
The True Guru knows the state of one's inner being.
He alone is fearless, who realizes the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਅਨਤ ਨ ਮਨੁ ਡੋਲਾਇਆ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar dhekh nira(n)tar boojhai anat na man ddolaiaa ||13||
verses.translation: He looks within his own inner being, and realizes the Lord within all; his mind does not waver at all. ||13||
He alone is fearless, within whose being the Lord abides.
Day and night, he is delighted with the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: naanak har jas sa(n)gat paieeaai har sahaje sahaj milaiaa ||14||
verses.translation: O Nanak, in the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, the Lord's Praise is obtained, and one easily, intuitively meets the Lord. ||14||
One who knows God, within the self and beyond,
remains detached, and brings his wandering mind back to its home.

verses.original: ਊਪਰਿ ਆਦਿ ਸਰਬ ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਈ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੫॥੪॥੨੧॥
verses.translit: uoopar aadh sarab tih loiee sach naanak a(n)mirat ras paiaa ||15||4||21||
verses.translation: The True Primal Lord is over all the three worlds; O Nanak, His Ambrosial Nectar is obtained. ||15||4||21||
Maaroo, First Mehla:
The Creator Lord is infinite; His creative power is wondrous.
Created beings have no power over Him.

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਉਪਾਇ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਦੇ ਆਪੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jeea upai rijak dhe aape sir sir hukam chalaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: He formed the living beings, and He Himself sustains them; the Hukam of His Command controls each and every one. ||1||
The all-pervading Lord orchestrates all through His Hukam.
Who is near, and who is far away?

verses.original: ਗੁਪਤ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਹਰਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਤਾਕੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gupat pragaT har ghaT ghaT dhekhahu varatai taak sabaiaa ||2||
verses.translation: Behold the Lord, both hidden and manifest, in each and every heart; the unique Lord is permeating all. ||2||
One whom the Lord unites with Himself, merges in conscious awareness.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, meditate on the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਆਨਦ ਰੂਪ ਅਨੂਪ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਭਰਮੁ ਜਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aanadh roop anoop agochar gur miliaai bharam jaiaa ||3||
verses.translation: God is the embodiment of bliss, incomparably beautiful and unfathomable; meeting with the Guru, doubt is dispelled. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਧਨ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: man tan dhan te naam piaaraa ||
verses.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is more dear to me than my mind, body and wealth.
In the end, when I must depart, it shall be my only help and support.

verses.original: ਮੋਹ ਪਸਾਰ ਨਹੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਬੇਲੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: moh pasaar nahee sa(n)g belee bin har gur kin sukh paiaa ||4||
verses.translation: In this world of love and attachment, no one is anyone else's friend or companion; without the Lord, without the Guru, who has ever found peace? ||4||

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis kau nadhar kare gur pooraa ||
verses.translation: He, unto whom the Perfect Guru grants His Grace,
is merged in the Word of the Shabad, through the Teachings of the brave, heroic Guru.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਸਰੇਵਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਭੂਲਾ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak gur ke charan sarevahu jin bhoolaa maarag paiaa ||5||
verses.translation: O Nanak, dwell upon, and serve at the Guru's feet; He places those who wander back on the Path. ||5||

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾਂ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਜਸੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t janaa(n) har dhan jas piaaraa ||
verses.translation: The wealth of the Lord's Praise is very dear to the humble Saints.
Through the Guru's Teachings, I have obtained Your Name, Lord.

verses.original: ਜਾਚਿਕੁ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੇ ਦਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: jaachik sev kare dhar har kai har dharageh jas gaiaa ||6||
verses.translation: The beggar serves at the Lord's door, and in the Court of the Lord, sings His Praises. ||6||
When one meets the True Guru, he is called into the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.
In the True Court, he is blessed with salvation and honor.

verses.original: ਸਾਕਤ ਠਉਰ ਨਾਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰ ਜਨਮ ਮਰੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: saakat Thaur naahee har ma(n)dhar janam marai dhukh paiaa ||7||
verses.translation: The faithless cynic has no place of rest in the Lord's palace; he suffers the pains of birth and death. ||7||
So serve the True Guru, the unfathomable ocean,
and you shall obtain the profit, the wealth, the jewel of the Naam.

verses.original: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਲੁ ਜਾਇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਵਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਰ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: bikhiaa mal jai a(n)mirat sar naavahu gur sar sa(n)tokh paiaa ||8||
verses.translation: The filth of corruption is washed away, by bathing in the pool of Ambrosial Nectar. In the Guru's pool, contentment is obtained. ||8||
So serve the Guru without hesitation.
And in the midst of hope, remain unmoved by hope.

verses.original: ਸੰਸਾ ਦੂਖ ਬਿਨਾਸਨੁ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: sa(n)saa dhookh binaasan sevahu fir baahuR rog na laiaa ||9||
verses.translation: Serve the Eradicator of cynicism and suffering, and you shall never again be afflicted by the disease. ||9||
One who is pleasing to the True Lord is blessed with glorious greatness.
Who else can teach him anything?

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਏਕਾ ਵਰਤੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: har gur moorat ekaa varatai naanak har gur bhaiaa ||10||
verses.translation: The Lord and the Guru are pervading in one form. O Nanak, the Lord loves the Guru. ||10||
Some read scriptures, the Vedas and the Puraanas.
Some sit and listen, and read to others.

verses.original: ਅਜਗਰ ਕਪਟੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਉ ਖੁਲੑੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: ajagar kapaT kahahu kiau khul(h)ai bin satigur tat na paiaa ||11||
verses.translation: Tell me, how can the heavy, rigid doors be opened? Without the True Guru, the essence of reality is not realized. ||11||
Some collect dust, and smear their bodies with ashes;
but deep within them are the outcasts of anger and egotism.

verses.original: ਪਾਖੰਡ ਕੀਨੇ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: paakha(n)dd keene jog na paieeaai bin satigur alakh na paiaa ||12||
verses.translation: Practicing hypocrisy, Yoga is not obtained; without the True Guru, the unseen Lord is not found. ||12||
Some make vows to visit sacred shrines of pilgrimage, keep fasts and live in the forest.
Some practice chastity, charity and self-discipline, and speak of spiritual wisdom.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਇਆ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: raam naam bin kiau sukh paieeaai bin satigur bharam na jaiaa ||13||
verses.translation: But without the Lord's Name, how can anyone find peace? Without the True Guru, doubt is not dispelled. ||13||
Inner cleansing techniques, channeling the energy to raise the Kundalini to the Tenth Gate,
inhaling, exhaling and holding the breath by the force of the mind -

verses.original: ਪਾਖੰਡ ਧਰਮੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਉ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: paakha(n)dd dharam preet nahee har sau gur sabadh mahaa ras paiaa ||14||
verses.translation: by empty hypocritical practices, Dharmic love for the Lord is not produced. Only through the Word of the Guru's Shabad is the sublime, supreme essence obtained. ||14||
Seeing the Lord's creative power, my mind remains satisfied.
Through the Guru's Shabad, I have realized that all is God.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ॥੧੫॥੫॥੨੨॥
verses.translit: naanak aatam raam sabaiaa gur satigur alakh lakhaiaa ||15||5||22||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Lord, the Supreme Soul, is in all. The Guru, the True Guru, has inspired me to see the unseen Lord. ||15||5||22||
Maaroo, Solhay, Third Mehla:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
By the Hukam of His Command, He effortlessly created the Universe.
Creating the creation, He gazes upon His own greatness.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aape kare karaae aape hukame rahiaa samaiee he ||1||
verses.translation: He Himself acts, and inspires all to act; in His Will, He pervades and permeates all. ||1||
The world is in the darkness of love and attachment to Maya.
How rare is that Gurmukh who contemplates, and understands.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aape nadhar kare so paae aape mel milaiee he ||2||
verses.translation: He alone attains the Lord, unto whom He grants His Grace. He Himself unites in His Union. ||2||
Uniting with Himself, He bestows glorious greatness.
By Guru's Grace, one comes to know the Lord's worth.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਫਿਰੈ ਬਿਲਲਾਦੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: manmukh bahut firai bilalaadhee dhoojai bhai khuaaiee he ||3||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh wanders everywhere, weeping and wailing; he is utterly ruined by the love of duality. ||3||
Egotism was instilled into the illusion of Maya.
The self-willed manmukh is deluded, and loses his honor.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਨਾਇ ਰਾਚੈ ਸਾਚੈ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: gurmukh hovai so nai raachai saachai rahiaa samaiee he ||4||
verses.translation: But one who becomes Gurmukh is absorbed in the Name; he remains immersed in the True Lord. ||4||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur te giaan naam ratan paiaa ||
verses.translation: Spiritual wisdom is obtained from the Guru, along with the jewel of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
Desires are subdued, and one remains immersed in the mind.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਖੇਲ ਕਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: aape khel kare sabh karataa aape dhei bujhaiee he ||5||
verses.translation: The Creator Himself stages all His plays; He Himself bestows understanding. ||5||
One who serves the True Guru eradicates self-conceit.
Meeting with his Beloved, he finds peace through the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਾਤਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਤੇ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar piaar bhagatee raataa sahaj mate ban aaiee he ||6||
verses.translation: Deep within his inner being, he is imbued with loving devotion; intuitively, he becomes one with the Lord. ||6||
The Destroyer of pain is known through the Guru.
The Great Giver, the Life of the world, Himself has met me.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਾਏ ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਭਉ ਭਰਮੁ ਸਰੀਰਹੁ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: jis no laae soiee boojhai bhau bharam sareerahu jaiee he ||7||
verses.translation: He alone understands, whom the Lord joins with Himself. Fear and doubt are taken away from his body. ||7||
He Himself is the Gurmukh, and He Himself bestows His blessings.
Through the True Word of the Shabad, serve the True Guru.

verses.original: ਜਰਾ ਜਮੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: jaraa jam tis joh na saakai saache siau ban aaiee he ||8||
verses.translation: Old age and death cannot even touch one who is in harmony with the True Lord. ||8||
The world is burning up in the fire of desire.
It burns and burns, and is destroyed in all its corruption.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਕਬਹੂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: manmukh Thaur na paae kabahoo satigur boojh bujhaiee he ||9||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh finds no place of rest anywhere. The True Guru has imparted this understanding. ||9||
Those who serve the True Guru are very fortunate.
They remain lovingly focused on the True Name forever.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar naam raviaa nihakeval tirasanaa sabadh bujhaiee he ||10||
verses.translation: The Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord, permeates the nucleus of their inner being; through the Shabad, their desires are quenched. ||10||
True is the Word of the Shabad, and True is the Bani of His Word.
How rare is that Gurmukh who realizes this.

verses.original: ਸਚੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਰਹਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: sache sabadh rate bairaagee aavan jaan rahaiee he ||11||
verses.translation: Those who are imbued with the True Shabad are detached. Their comings and goings in reincarnation are ended. ||11||
One who realizes the Shabad is cleansed of impurities.
The Immaculate Naam abides within his mind.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: satigur apanaa sadh hee seveh haumai vichahu jaiee he ||12||
verses.translation: He serves his True Guru forever, and egotism is eradicated from within. ||12||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਬੂਝੈ ਤਾ ਦਰੁ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur te boojhai taa dhar soojhai ||
verses.translation: If one comes to understand, through the Guru, then he comes to know the Lord's Door.
But without the Naam, one babbles and argues in vain.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੂਖ ਗਵਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: satigur seve kee vaddiaaiee tirasanaa bhookh gavaiee he ||13||
verses.translation: The glory of serving the True Guru is that it eradicates hunger and thirst. ||13||
When the Lord unites them with Himself, then they come to understand.
Without spiritual wisdom, they understand nothing at all.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: gur kee dhaat sadhaa man a(n)tar baanee sabadh vajaiee he ||14||
verses.translation: One whose mind is filled with the Guru's gift forever - his inner being resounds with the Shabad, and the Word of the Guru's Bani. ||14||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jo dhur likhiaa su karam kamaiaa ||
verses.translation: He acts according to his pre-ordained destiny.
No one can erase the Command of the Primal Lord.

verses.original: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਵਾਸਾ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: satasa(n)gat meh tin hee vaasaa jin kau dhur likh paiee he ||15||
verses.translation: They alone dwell in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, who have such pre-ordained destiny. ||15||
He alone finds the Lord, unto whom He grants His Grace.
He links his consciousness to the deep meditative state of the True Shabad.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਭੀਖਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਰਿ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaas kahai bena(n)tee bheekhiaa naam dhar paiee he ||16||1||
verses.translation: Nanak, Your slave, offers this humble prayer; I stand at Your Door, begging for Your Name. ||16||1||
Maaroo, Third Mehla:
The One and only Lord is pervading and permeating everywhere.
How rare is that person, who as Gurmukh, understands this.

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: eko rav rahiaa sabh a(n)tar tis bin avar na koiee he ||1||
verses.translation: The One Lord is permeating and pervading, deep within the nucleus of all. Without Him, there is no other at all. ||1||
He created the 8.4 millions species of beings.
The spiritual teachers and meditators proclaim this.

verses.original: ਸਭਨਾ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸਮਾਹੇ ਆਪੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਹੋਰ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sabhanaa rijak samaahe aape keemat hor na hoiee he ||2||
verses.translation: He Himself nourishes all; no one else can estimate His value. ||2||
Love and attachment to Maya are utter darkness.
Egotism and possessiveness have spread throughout the expanse of the universe.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਲਤ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: anadhin jalat rahai dhin raatee gur bin saa(n)t na hoiee he ||3||
verses.translation: Night and day, they burn, day and night; without the Guru, there is no peace or tranquility. ||3||
He Himself unites, and He Himself separates.
He Himself establishes, and He Himself disestablishes.

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ਹੋਰਨਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: sachaa hukam sachaa paasaaraa horan hukam na hoiee he ||4||
verses.translation: True is the Hukam of His Command, and True is the expanse of His universe. No one else can issue any Command. ||4||
He alone is attached to the Lord, whom the Lord attaches to Himself.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee jam kaa bhau bhaagai ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, the fear of death runs away.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar sabadh sadhaa sukhadhaataa gurmukh boojhai koiee he ||5||
verses.translation: The Shabad, the Giver of peace, dwells forever deep within the nucleus of the self. One who is Gurmukh understands. ||5||
God Himself unites those united in His Union.

verses.original: ਪੁਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋ ਮੇਟਣਾ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: purab likhiaa so meTanaa na jaae ||
verses.translation: Whatever is pre-ordained by destiny, cannot be erased.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: anadhin bhagat kare dhin raatee gurmukh sevaa hoiee he ||6||
verses.translation: Night and day, His devotees worship Him, day and night; one who becomes Gurmukh serves Him. ||6||
Serving the True Guru, lasting peace is experienced.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਆਇ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: aape aai miliaa sabhanaa kaa dhaataa ||
verses.translation: He Himself, the Giver of all, has come and met me.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਚੀਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: haumai maar tirasanaa agan nivaaree sabadh cheen sukh hoiee he ||7||
verses.translation: Subduing egotism, the fire of thirst has been extinguished; contemplating the Word of the Shabad, peace is found. ||7||
One who is attached to his body and family, does not understand.
But one who becomes Gurmukh, sees the Lord with his eyes.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: anadhin naam ravai dhin raatee mil preetam sukh hoiee he ||8||
verses.translation: Night and day, he chants the Naam, day and night; meeting with his Beloved, he finds peace. ||8||
The self-willed manmukh wanders distracted, attached to duality.
That unfortunate wretch - why didn't he just die as soon as he was born?

verses.original: ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: aavat jaat birathaa janam gavaiaa bin gur mukat na hoiee he ||9||
verses.translation: Coming and going, he wastes away his life in vain. Without the Guru, liberation is not obtained. ||9||
That body which is stained with the filth of egotism is false and impure.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਧੋਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: je sau dhoveh taa mail na jaiee ||
verses.translation: It may be washed a hundred times, but its filth is still not removed.

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਧੋਪੈ ਤਾ ਹਛੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਮੈਲੀ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: sabadh dhopai taa hachhee hovai fir mailee mool na hoiee he ||10||
verses.translation: But if it is washed with the Word of the Shabad, then it is truly cleansed, and it shall never be soiled again. ||10||
The five demons destroy the body.

verses.original: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਵੀਚਾਰਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: mar mar ja(n)meh sabadh na veechaareh ||
verses.translation: He dies and dies again, only to be reincarnated; he does not contemplate the Shabad.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਗੁਬਾਰਾ ਜਿਉ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਸੁਧਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar maiaa moh gubaaraa jiau supanai sudh na hoiee he ||11||
verses.translation: The darkness of emotional attachment to Maya is within his inner being; as if in a dream, he does not understand. ||11||

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਪੰਚਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਹੈ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: eik pa(n)chaa maar sabadh hai laage ||
verses.translation: Some conquer the five demons, by being attached to the Shabad.
They are blessed and very fortunate; the True Guru comes to meet them.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਰਵਹਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar saach raveh ra(n)g raate sahaj samaavai soiee he ||12||
verses.translation: Within the nucleus of their inner being, they dwell upon the Truth; attuned to the Lord's Love, they intuitively merge in Him. ||12||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਾਲ ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur kee chaal guroo te jaapai ||
verses.translation: The Guru's Way is known through the Guru.
His perfect servant attains realization through the Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਵੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sabadh ravai ghaT a(n)tar rasanaa ras chaakhai sach soiee he ||13||
verses.translation: Deep within his heart, he dwells forever upon the Shabad; he tastes the sublime essence of the True Lord with his tongue. ||13||
Egotism is conquered and subdued by the Shabad.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਖੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam rakhai ur dhaare ||
verses.translation: I have enshrined the Name of the Lord within my heart.

verses.original: ਏਕਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਉ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: ekas bin hau hor na jaanaa sahaje hoi su hoiee he ||14||
verses.translation: Other than the One Lord, I know nothing at all. Whatever will be, will automatically be. ||14||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਹਜੁ ਕਿਨੈ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bin satigur sahaj kinai nahee paiaa ||
verses.translation: Without the True Guru, no one obtains intuitive wisdom.
The Gurmukh understands, and is immersed in the True Lord.

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚ ਰਾਤੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਖੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: sachaa sev sabadh sach raate haumai sabadhe khoiee he ||15||
verses.translation: He serves the True Lord, and is attuned to the True Shabad. The Shabad banishes egotism. ||15||
He Himself is the Giver of virtue, the Contemplative Lord.
The Gurmukh is given the winning dice.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਤੇ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak naam samaaveh saachai saache te pat hoiee he ||16||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, immersed in the Naam, the Name of the Lord, one becomes true; from the True Lord, honor is obtained. ||16||2||
Maaroo, Third Mehla:
One One True Lord is the Life of the World, the Great Giver.
Serving the Guru, through the Word of the Shabad, He is realized.

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਅਮਰੁ ਏਕਾ ਪਤਿਸਾਹੀ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਰ ਬਣਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: eko amar ekaa patisaahee jug jug sir kaar banaiee he ||1||
verses.translation: There is only One Command, and there is only One Supreme King. In each and every age, He links each to their tasks. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: so jan niramal jin aap pachhaataa ||
verses.translation: That humble being is immaculate, who knows his own self.
The Lord, the Giver of peace, Himself comes and meets him.

verses.original: ਰਸਨਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੀ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: rasanaa sabadh ratee gun gaavai dhar saachai pat paiee he ||2||
verses.translation: His tongue is imbued with the Shabad, and he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord; he is honored in the Court of the True Lord. ||2||
The Gurmukh is blessed with the glorious greatness of the Naam.
The self-willed manmukh, the slanderer, loses his honor.

verses.original: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਪਰਮ ਹੰਸ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naam rate param ha(n)s bairaagee nij ghar taaRee laiee he ||3||
verses.translation: Attuned to the Naam, the supreme soul-swans remain detached; in the home of the self, they remain absorbed in deep meditative trance. ||3||
That humble being who dies in the Shabad is perfect.
The brave, heroic True Guru chants and proclaims this.

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਮਨੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਭਾਇ ਸੁਭਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: kaiaa a(n)dhar a(n)mirat sar saachaa man peevai bhai subhaiee he ||4||
verses.translation: Deep within the body is the true pool of Ambrosial Nectar; the mind drinks it in with loving devotion. ||4||
The Pandit, the religious scholar, reads and instructs others,

verses.original: ਘਰ ਜਲਤੇ ਕੀ ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: ghar jalate kee khabar na paae ||
verses.translation: but he does not realize that his own home is on fire.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਪੜਿ ਥਾਕੇ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: bin satigur seve naam na paieeaai paR thaake saa(n)t na aaiee he ||5||
verses.translation: Without serving the True Guru, the Naam is not obtained. You can read until you are exhausted, but you shall not find peace and tranquility. ||5||
Some smear their bodies with ashes, and wander around in religious disguises.
Without the Word of the Shabad, who has ever subdued egotism?

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਲਤ ਰਹਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੇਖਿ ਭਰਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: anadhin jalat raheh dhin raatee bharam bhekh bharamaiee he ||6||
verses.translation: Night and day, they continue burning, day and night; they are deluded and confused by their doubt and religious costumes. ||6||

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਮਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਉਦਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: eik gireh kuTa(n)b meh sadhaa udhaasee ||
verses.translation: Some, in the midst of their household and family, remain always unattached.
They die in the Shabad, and dwell in the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਹਹਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: anadhin sadhaa raheh ra(n)g raate bhai bhai bhagat chit laiee he ||7||
verses.translation: Night and day, they remain forever attuned to His Love; they focus their consciousness on loving devotion and the Fear of God. ||7||
The self-willed manmukh indulges in slander, and is ruined.
The dog of greed barks within him.

verses.original: ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: jamakaal tis kadhe na chhoddai a(n)t giaa pachhutaiee he ||8||
verses.translation: The Messenger of Death never leaves him, and in the end, he leaves, regretting and repenting. ||8||
Through the True Word of the Shabad, true honor is obtained.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: bin naavai mukat na paavai koiee ||
verses.translation: Without the Name, no one attains liberation.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੋ ਨਾਉ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਐਸੀ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: bin satigur ko naau na paae prabh aaisee banat banaiee he ||9||
verses.translation: Without the True Guru, no one finds the Name. Such is the making which God has made. ||9||
Some are Siddhas and seekers, and great contemplators.
Some remain imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Formless Lord, day and night.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਭਉ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: jis no aap milaae so boojhai bhagat bhai bhau jaiee he ||10||
verses.translation: He alone understands, whom the Lord unites with Himself; through loving devotional worship, fear is dispelled. ||10||
Some take cleansing baths and give donations to charities, but they do not understand.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਨੈ ਸਿਉ ਲੂਝਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: eik manooaa maar manai siau loojheh ||
verses.translation: Some struggle with their minds, and conquer and subdue their minds.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਇਕ ਰੰਗੀ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: saachai sabadh rate ik ra(n)gee saachai sabadh milaiee he ||11||
verses.translation: Some are imbued with love for the True Word of the Shabad; they merge with the True Shabad. ||11||
He Himself creates and bestows glorious greatness.
By the Pleasure of His Will, He bestows union.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮੇਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਇਉ ਫੁਰਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: aape nadhar kare man vasiaa merai prabh iau furamaiee he ||12||
verses.translation: Bestowing His Grace, He comes to dwell in the mind; such is the Command ordained by my God. ||12||
Those humble beings who serve the True Guru are true.
The false, self-willed manmukhs do not know how to serve the Guru.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: aape karataa kar kar vekhai jiau bhaavai tiau laiee he ||13||
verses.translation: The Creator Himself creates the creation and watches over it; he attaches all according to the Pleasure of His Will. ||13||
In each and every age, the True Lord is the one and only Giver.
Through perfect destiny, one realizes the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੇ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਦਰੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: sabadh mile se vichhuRe naahee nadharee sahaj milaiee he ||14||
verses.translation: Those who are immersed in the Shabad are not separated again. By His Grace, they are intuitively immersed in the Lord. ||14||
Acting in egotism, they are stained with the filth of Maya.
They die and die again, only to be reborn in the love of duality.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਮਨਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: bin satigur seve mukat na hoiee man dhekhahu liv laiee he ||15||
verses.translation: Without serving the True Guru, no one finds liberation. O mind, tune into this, and see. ||15||
He does whatever He pleases.
No one has done, or can do anything by himself.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak naam milai vaddiaaiee dhar saachai pat paiee he ||16||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, through the Name, one is blessed with glorious greatness, and obtains honor in the Court of the True Lord. ||16||3||
Maaroo, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੋ ਆਇਆ ਸੋ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਜਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: jo aaiaa so sabh ko jaasee ||
verses.translation: All who come shall have to depart.
In the love of duality, they are caught by the noose of the Messenger of Death.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: satigur raakhe se jan ubare saache saach samaiee he ||1||
verses.translation: Those humble beings who are protected by the True Guru, are saved. They merge into the Truest of the True. ||1||
The Creator Himself creates the creation, and watches over it.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਲੇਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: jis no nadhar kare soiee jan lekhai ||
verses.translation: Thay alone are acceptable, upon whom He bestows His Glance of Grace.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gurmukh giaan tis sabh kichh soojhai agiaanee a(n)dh kamaiee he ||2||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh attains spiritual wisdom, and understands everything. The ignorant ones act blindly. ||2||
The self-willed manmukh is cynical; he doesn't understand.
He dies and dies again, only to be reborn, and loses his life uselessly again.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gurmukh naam rate sukh paiaa sahaje saach samaiee he ||3||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh is imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord; he find peace, and is intuitively immersed in the True Lord. ||3||
Chasing after worldly affairs, the mind has become corroded and rusty.

verses.original: ਫਿਰਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: fir hovai ka(n)chan bheTai gur pooraa ||
verses.translation: But meeting with the Perfect Guru, it is transmuted into gold once again.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: aape bakhas le sukh paae poorai sabadh milaiee he ||4||
verses.translation: When the Lord Himself grants forgiveness, then peace is obtained; through the Perfect Word of the Shabad, one is united with Him. ||4||
The false and evil-minded are the most wicked of the wicked.
They are the most unworthy of the unworthy.

verses.original: ਕਚੀ ਮਤਿ ਫੀਕਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲੈ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: kachee mat feekaa mukh bolai dhuramat naam na paiee he ||5||
verses.translation: With false intellect, and insipid words of mouth, evil-minded, they do not obtain the Naam. ||5||
The unworthy soul-bride is not pleasing to her Husband Lord.
False-minded, her actions are false.

verses.original: ਪਿਰ ਕਾ ਸਾਉ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਮੂਰਖਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: pir kaa saau na jaanai moorakh bin gur boojh na paiee he ||6||
verses.translation: The foolish person does not know the excellence of her Husband Lord. Without the Guru, she does not understand at all. ||6||
The evil-minded, wicked soul-bride practices wickedness.

verses.original: ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਪਿਰ ਖਸਮ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: seegaar kare pir khasam na bhaavai ||
verses.translation: She decorates herself, but her Husband Lord is not pleased.

verses.original: ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਸਦਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: gunava(n)tee sadhaa pir raavai satigur mel milaiee he ||7||
verses.translation: The virtuous soul-bride enjoys and ravishes her Husband Lord forever; the True Guru unites her in His Union. ||7||
God Himself issues the Hukam of His Command, and beholds all.
Some are forgiven, according to their pre-ordained destiny.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: anadhin naam rate sach paiaa aape mel milaiee he ||8||
verses.translation: Night and day, they are imbued with the Naam, and they find the True Lord. He Himself unites them in His Union. ||8||
Egotism attaches them to the juice of emotional attachment, and makes them run around.
The Gurmukh is intuitively immersed in the True Love of the Lord.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲੈ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: aape melai aape kar vekhai bin satigur boojh na paiee he ||9||
verses.translation: He Himself unites, He Himself acts, and beholds. Without the True Guru, understanding is not obtained. ||9||

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਜਨ ਜਾਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: eik sabadh veechaar sadhaa jan jaage ||
verses.translation: Some contemplate the Word of the Shabad; these humble beings remain always awake and aware.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਸੋਇ ਰਹੇ ਅਭਾਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: eik maiaa moh soi rahe abhaage ||
verses.translation: Some are attached to the love of Maya; these unfortunate ones remain asleep.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਹੋਰੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: aape kare karaae aape hor karanaa kichhoo na jaiee he ||10||
verses.translation: He Himself acts, and inspires all to act; no one else can do anything. ||10||
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, death is conquered and killed.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਖੈ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam rakhai ur dhaare ||
verses.translation: Keep the Name of the Lord enshrined within your heart.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: satigur sevaa te sukh paiaa har kai naam samaiee he ||11||
verses.translation: Serving the True Guru, peace is obtained, and one merges in the Name of the Lord. ||11||
In the love of duality, the world wanders around insane.
Immersed in love and attachment to Maya, it suffers in pain.

verses.original: ਬਹੁਤੇ ਭੇਖ ਕਰੈ ਨਹ ਪਾਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: bahute bhekh karai neh paae bin satigur sukh na paiee he ||12||
verses.translation: Wearing all sorts of religious robes, He is not obtained. Without the True Guru, peace is not found. ||12||

verses.original: ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਹੀਐ ਜਾ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: kis no kaheeaai jaa aap karaae ||
verses.translation: Who is to blame, when He Himself does everything?
As He wills, so is the path we take.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: aape miharavaan sukhadhaataa jiau bhaavai tivai chalaiee he ||13||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Merciful Giver of peace; as He wills, so do we follow. ||13||
He Himself is the Creator, and He Himself is the Enjoyer.
He Himself is detached, and He Himself is attached.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ਮਧੁਸੂਦਨੁ ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਮੇਟਿਆ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: aape niramal miharavaan madhusoodhan jis dhaa hukam na meTiaa jaiee he ||14||
verses.translation: He Himself is immaculate, compassionate, the lover of nectar; the Hukam of His Command cannot be erased. ||14||
Those who know the One Lord are very fortunate.

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਵਸਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT vas rahiaa jagajeevan dhaataa ||
verses.translation: He dwells in each and every heart, the Great Giver, the Life of the world.

verses.original: ਇਕ ਥੈ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: eik thai gupat paragaT hai aape gurmukh bhram bhau jaiee he ||15||
verses.translation: At the same time, He is both hidden and revealed. For the Gurmukh, doubt and fear are dispelled. ||15||
The Gurmukh knows the One, the Dear Lord.
Deep within the nucleus of his inner being, is the Naam, the Name of the Lord; he realizes the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੪॥
verses.translit: jis too dheh soiee jan paae naanak naam vaddaiee he ||16||4||
verses.translation: He alone receives it, unto whom You give it. O Nanak, the Naam is glorious greatness. ||16||4||
Maaroo, Third Mehla:
I praise the true, profound and unfathomable Lord.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕੈ ਚੀਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: sabh jag hai tis hee kai cheerai ||
verses.translation: All the world is in His power.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਘਟ ਭੋਗਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਆਪੇ ਸੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sabh ghaT bhogavai sadhaa dhin raatee aape sookh nivaasee he ||1||
verses.translation: He enjoys all hearts forever, day and night; He Himself dwells in peace. ||1||
True is the Lord and Master, and True is His Name.
By Guru's Grace, I enshrine Him in my mind.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਆਇ ਵਸਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੂਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aape aai vasiaa ghaT a(n)tar tooTee jam kee faasee he ||2||
verses.translation: He Himself has come to dwell deep within the nucleus of my heart; the noose of death has been snapped. ||2||
Whom should I serve, and whom should I praise?
I serve the True Guru, and praise the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sachai sabadh sadhaa mat uootam a(n)tar kamal pragaasee he ||3||
verses.translation: Through the True Shabad, the intellect is exalted and ennobled forever, and the lotus deep within blossoms forth. ||3||
The body is frail and perishable, like paper.

verses.original: ਬੂੰਦ ਪਵੈ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਢਹਤ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਬਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: boo(n)dh pavai binasai ddahat na laagai baaraa ||
verses.translation: When the drop of water falls upon it, it crumbles and dissolves instantaneously.

verses.original: ਕੰਚਨ ਕਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: ka(n)chan kaiaa gurmukh boojhai jis a(n)tar naam nivaasee he ||4||
verses.translation: But the body of the Gurmukh, who understands, is like gold; the Naam, the Name of the Lord, dwells deep within. ||4||
Pure is that kitchen, which is enclosed by spiritual awareness.
The Lord's Name is my food, and Truth is my support.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਹੈ ਪਾਵਨੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਘਟਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: sadhaa tirapat pavitr hai paavan jit ghaT har naam nivaasee he ||5||
verses.translation: Forever satisfied, sanctified and pure is that person, within whose heart the Lord's Name abides. ||5||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਜੋ ਸਾਚੈ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: hau tin balihaaree jo saachai laage ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to those who are attached to the Truth.
They sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and remain awake and aware night and day.

verses.original: ਸਾਚਾ ਸੂਖੁ ਸਦਾ ਤਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: saachaa sookh sadhaa tin a(n)tar rasanaa har ras raasee he ||6||
verses.translation: True peace fills them forever, and their tongues savor the sublime essence of the Lord. ||6||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੇਤਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
verses.translit: har naam chetaa avar na poojaa ||
verses.translation: I remember the Lord's Name, and no other at all.
I serve the One Lord, and no other at all.

verses.original: ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਸਚੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: poorai gur sabh sach dhikhaiaa sachai naam nivaasee he ||7||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru has revealed the whole Truth to me; I dwell in the True Name. ||7||

verses.original: ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bhram bhram jonee fir fir aaiaa ||
verses.translation: Wandering, wandering in reincarnation, again and again, he comes into the world.
He is deluded and confused, when the Lord and Master confuses him.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਚੀਨੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: har jeeau milai taa gurmukh boojhai cheenai sabadh abinaasee he ||8||
verses.translation: He meets with the Dear Lord, when, as Gurmukh, he understands; he remembers the Shabad, the Word of the immortal, eternal Lord God. ||8||
I am a sinner, overflowing with sexual desire and anger.

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਲੈ ਬੋਲਹ ਨਾ ਹਮ ਗੁਣ ਨ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਾਧੀ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa muh lai boleh naa ham gun na sevaa saadhee ||
verses.translation: With what mouth should I speak? I have no virtue, and I have rendered no service.

verses.original: ਡੁਬਦੇ ਪਾਥਰ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਆਪੇ ਸਾਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: ddubadhe paathar mel laih tum aape saach naam abinaasee he ||9||
verses.translation: I am a sinking stone; please, Lord, unite me with Yourself. Your Name is eternal and imperishable. ||9||

verses.original: ਨਾ ਕੋਈ ਕਰੇ ਨ ਕਰਣੈ ਜੋਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: naa koiee kare na karanai jogaa ||
verses.translation: No one does anything; no one is able to do anything.
That alone happens, which the Lord Himself does, and causes to be done.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: aape bakhas laih sukh paae sadh hee naam nivaasee he ||10||
verses.translation: Those whom He Himself forgives, find peace; they dwell forever in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||10||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਜਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: eih tan dharatee sabadh beej apaaraa ||
verses.translation: This body is the earth, and the infinite Shabad is the seed.
Deal and trade with the True Name alone.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਧਨੁ ਜੰਮਿਆ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: sach dhan ja(n)miaa toT na aavai a(n)tar naam nivaasee he ||11||
verses.translation: The True wealth increases; it is never exhausted, when the Naam dwells deep within. ||11||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਅਵਗਣਿਆਰੇ ਨੋ ਗੁਣੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: har jeeau avaganiaare no gun keejai ||
verses.translation: O Dear Lord, please bless me, the worthless sinner, with virtue.
Forgive me, and bless me with Your Name.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਇਕਤੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: gurmukh hovai so pat paae ikat naam nivaasee he ||12||
verses.translation: One who becomes Gurmukh, is honored; he dwells in the Name of the One Lord alone. ||12||

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸਮਝ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar har dhan samajh na hoiee ||
verses.translation: The wealth of the Lord is deep within one's inner being, but he does not realize it.
By Guru's Grace, one comes to understand.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: gurmukh hovai so dhan paae sadh hee naam nivaasee he ||13||
verses.translation: One who becomes Gurmukh is blessed with this wealth; he lives forever in the Naam. ||13||
Fire and wind lead him into delusions of doubt.
In love and attachment to Maya, he has no understanding at all.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧੇ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: manmukh a(n)dhe kichhoo na soojhai gurmat naam pragaasee he ||14||
verses.translation: The blind, self-willed manmukh sees nothing; through the Guru's Teachings, the Naam is gloriously revealed. ||14||
The manmukhs are asleep in egotism and Maya.

verses.original: ਅਪਣਾ ਘਰੁ ਨ ਸਮਾਲਹਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਵਿਗੂਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: apanaa ghar na samaaleh a(n)t vigoote ||
verses.translation: They do not watch over their own homes, and are ruined in the end.

verses.original: ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਜਾਲੈ ਦੁਖੇ ਦੁਖਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: par ni(n)dhaa kareh bahu chi(n)taa jaalai dhukhe dhukh nivaasee he ||15||
verses.translation: They slander others, and burn in great anxiety; they dwell in pain and suffering. ||15||
The Creator Himself has created the creation.
He blesses the Gurmukh with understanding.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak naam rate man niramal naame naam nivaasee he ||16||5||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam - their minds become immaculate; they dwell in the Naam, and only the Naam. ||16||5||
Maaroo, Third Mehla:
I serve the One Lord, who is eternal, stable and True.
Attached to duality, the whole world is false.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਾਚੇ ਹੀ ਸਾਚਿ ਪਤੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gurmatee sadhaa sach saalaahee saache hee saach pateejai he ||1||
verses.translation: Following the Guru's Teachings, I praise the True Lord forever, pleased with the Truest of the True. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਬਹੁਤੇ ਮੈ ਏਕੁ ਨ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: tere gun bahute mai ek na jaataa ||
verses.translation: Your Glorious Virtues are so many, Lord; I do not know even one.
The Life of the world, the Great Giver, attaches us to himself.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aape bakhase dhe vaddiaaiee gurmat ih man bheejai he ||2||
verses.translation: He Himself forgives, and bestows glorious greatness. Following the Guru's Teachings, this mind is delighted. ||2||
The Word of the Shabad has subdued the waves of Maya.
Egotism has been conquered, and this mind has become immaculate.

verses.original: ਸਹਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sahaje gun gaavai ra(n)g raataa rasanaa raam raveejai he ||3||
verses.translation: I intuitively sing His Glorious Praises, imbued with the Lord's Love. My tongue chants and savors the Lord's Name. ||3||
Crying out, ""Mine, mine!"" he spends his life.
The self-willed manmukh does not understand; he wanders around in ignorance.

verses.original: ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਘੜੀ ਮੁਹਤੁ ਨਿਹਾਲੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਆਰਜਾ ਛੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: jamakaal ghaRee muhat nihaale anadhin aarajaa chheejai he ||4||
verses.translation: The Messenger of Death watches over him every moment, every instant; night and day, his life is wasting away. ||4||
He practices greed within, and does not understand.
He does not see the Messenger of Death hovering over his head.

verses.original: ਐਥੈ ਕਮਾਣਾ ਸੁ ਅਗੈ ਆਇਆ ਅੰਤਕਾਲਿ ਕਿਆ ਕੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: aaithai kamaanaa su agai aaiaa a(n)takaal kiaa keejai he ||5||
verses.translation: Whatever one does in this world, will come to face him in the hereafter; what can he do at that very last moment? ||5||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਸਚਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਤਿਨ ਸਾਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jo sach laage tin saachee soi ||
verses.translation: Those who are attached to the Truth are true.
The self-willed manmukhs, attached to duality, weep and wail.

verses.original: ਦੁਹਾ ਸਿਰਿਆ ਕਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਭੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: dhuhaa siriaa kaa khasam hai aape aape gun meh bheejai he ||6||
verses.translation: He is the Lord and Master of both worlds; He Himself delights in virtue. ||6||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh sadhaa jan sohai ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, His humble servant is exalted forever.
This mind is enticed by the Naam, the source of nectar.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਮੈਲੁ ਪਤੰਗੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਭੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: maiaa moh mail pata(n)g na laagai gurmatee har naam bheejai he ||7||
verses.translation: It is not stained at all by the dirt of attachment to Maya; through the Guru's Teachings, it is pleased and saturated with the Lord's Name. ||7||
The One Lord is contained within all.
By Guru's Grace, He is revealed.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਇ ਸਾਚੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: haumai maar sadhaa sukh paiaa nai saachai a(n)mrit peejai he ||8||
verses.translation: One who subdues his ego, finds lasting peace; he drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar of the True Name. ||8||
God is the Destroyer of sin and pain.
The Gurmukh serves Him, and contemplates the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: sabh kichh aape aap varatai gurmukh tan man bheejai he ||9||
verses.translation: He Himself is pervading everything. The Gurmukh's body and mind are saturated and pleased. ||9||
The world is burning in the fire of Maya.
The Gurmukh extinguishes this fire, by contemplating the Shabad.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar saa(n)t sadhaa sukh paiaa gurmatee naam leejai he ||10||
verses.translation: Deep within are peace and tranquility, and lasting peace is obtained. Following the Guru's Teachings, one is blessed with the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||10||

verses.original: ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾਸਣਿ ਬੈਠੇ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: ei(n)dhr i(n)dhraasan baiThe jam kaa bhau paaveh ||
verses.translation: Even Indra, seated upon his throne, is caught in the fear of death.

verses.original: ਜਮੁ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jam na chhoddai bahu karam kamaaveh ||
verses.translation: The Messenger of Death will not spare them, even though they try all sorts of things.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਤਾ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਪੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: satigur bheTai taa mukat paieeaai har har rasanaa peejai he ||11||
verses.translation: When one meets with the True Guru, one is liberated, drinking in and savoring the sublime essence of the Lord, Har, Har. ||11||
There is no devotion within the self-willed manmukh.
Through devotional worship, the Gurmukh obtains peace and tranquility.

verses.original: ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਾਵਨ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: pavitr paavan sadhaa hai baanee gurmat a(n)tar bheejai he ||12||
verses.translation: Forever pure and sanctified is the Word of the Guru's Bani; following the Guru's Teachings, one's inner being is drenched in it. ||12||
I have considered Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva.
They are bound by the three qualities - the three gunas; they are far away from liberation.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਏਕੋ ਹੈ ਜਾਤਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਵੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: gurmukh giaan eko hai jaataa anadhin naam raveejai he ||13||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh knows the spiritual wisdom of the One Lord. Night and day, he chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||13||

verses.original: ਬੇਦ ਪੜਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਬੂਝਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: bedh paReh har naam na boojheh ||
verses.translation: He may read the Vedas, but he does not realize the Lord's Name.
For the sake of Maya, he reads and recites and argues.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧਾ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar mail agiaanee a(n)dhaa kiau kar dhutar tareejai he ||14||
verses.translation: The ignorant and blind person is filled with filth within. How can he cross over the impassable world-ocean? ||14||
He voices all the controversies of the Vedas,

verses.original: ਨ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਨ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: n a(n)tar bheejai na sabadh pachhaaneh ||
verses.translation: but his inner being is not saturated or satisfied, and he does not realize the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਪੁੰਨੁ ਪਾਪੁ ਸਭੁ ਬੇਦਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: pu(n)n paap sabh bedh dhiraRaiaa gurmukh a(n)mrit peejai he ||15||
verses.translation: The Vedas tell all about virtue and vice, but only the Gurmukh drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||15||
The One True Lord is all by Himself.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: tis bin dhoojaa avar na koiee ||
verses.translation: There is no one else except Him.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਰਵੀਜੈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੬॥
verses.translit: naanak naam rate man saachaa sacho sach raveejai he ||16||6||
verses.translation: O Nanak, true is the mind of one who is attuned to the Naam; he speaks Truth, and nothing but Truth. ||16||6||
Maaroo, Third Mehla:
The True Lord has established the Throne of Truth.

verses.original: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਤਿਥੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਨ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: nij ghar vasiaa tithai moh na maiaa ||
verses.translation: He dwells in His own home deep within the self, where there is no emotional attachment to Maya.

verses.original: ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਾਚੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sadh hee saach vasiaa ghaT a(n)tar gurmukh karanee saaree he ||1||
verses.translation: The True Lord dwells deep within the nucleus of the Gurmukh's heart forever; his actions are excellent. ||1||
True is his merchandise, and true is his trade.

verses.original: ਨ ਤਿਥੈ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: n tithai bharam na dhoojaa pasaaraa ||
verses.translation: There is no doubt within him, and no expanse of duality.

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਧਨੁ ਖਟਿਆ ਕਦੇ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sachaa dhan khaTiaa kadhe toT na aavai boojhai ko veechaaree he ||2||
verses.translation: He has earned the true wealth, which is never exhausted. How few are those who contemplate this, and understand. ||2||
They alone are attached to the True Name, whom the Lord Himself attaches.
The Word of the Shabad is deep within the nucleus of the self; good fortune is recorded upon their foreheads.

verses.original: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sachai sabadh sadhaa gun gaaveh sabadh rate veechaaree he ||3||
verses.translation: Through the True Word of the Shabad, they sing the True Praises of the Lord; they are attuned to contemplative meditation on the Shabad. ||3||
I praise the True Lord, the Truest of the True.
I see the One Lord, and no other.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਊਚੋ ਊਚੀ ਪਉੜੀ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਰਤਨਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: gurmat uoocho uoochee pauRee giaan ratan haumai maaree he ||4||
verses.translation: The Guru's Teachings are the ladder to reach the highest of the high. the jewel of spiritual wisdom conquers egotism. ||4||
Emotional attachment to Maya is burnt away by the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sach man vasiaa jaa tudh bhaiaa ||
verses.translation: The True One comes to dwell in the mind, when it pleases You, O Lord.

verses.original: ਸਚੇ ਕੀ ਸਭ ਸਚੀ ਕਰਣੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਿਖਾ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: sache kee sabh sachee karanee haumai tikhaa nivaaree he ||5||
verses.translation: True are all the actions of the truthful; the thirst of egotism is subdued. ||5||
All by Himself, God created emotional attachment to Maya.
How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, realize the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸਾਚੀ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: gurmukh hovai su sach kamaavai saachee karanee saaree he ||6||
verses.translation: One who becomes Gurmukh practices Truth; true and excellent are his actions. ||6||

verses.original: ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈ ਜੋ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kaar kamaiee jo mere prabh bhaiee ||
verses.translation: He does those deeds which are pleasing to my God;
through the Shabad, he burns away egotism and the thirst of desire.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: gurmat sadh hee a(n)tar seetal haumai maar nivaaree he ||7||
verses.translation: Following the Guru's Teachings, he remains forever cool and calm deep within; he conquers and subdues his ego. ||7||

verses.original: ਸਚਿ ਲਗੇ ਤਿਨ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: sach lage tin sabh kichh bhaavai ||
verses.translation: Those who are attached to the Truth are pleased with everything.
They are embellished with the True Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਐਥੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਸੇ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਨਦਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: aaithai saache se dhar saache nadharee nadhar savaaree he ||8||
verses.translation: Those who are true in this world, are true in the Court of the Lord. The Merciful Lord adorns them with His Mercy. ||8||
Those who are attached to duality, and not the Truth,
are trapped in emotional attachment to Maya; they totally suffer in pain.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਾਪੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: bin gur dhukh sukh jaapai naahee maiaa moh dhukh bhaaree he ||9||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, they do not understand pain and pleasure; attached to Maya, they suffer in terrible pain. ||9||
Those whose minds are pleased with the True Word of the Shabad
act according to pre-ordained destiny.

verses.original: ਸਚੋ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: sacho seveh sach dhiaaveh sach rate veechaaree he ||10||
verses.translation: They serve the True Lord, and meditate on the True Lord; they are imbued with contemplative meditation on the True Lord. ||10||
Service to the Guru seems sweet to them.
Night and day, they are intuitively immersed in celestial peace.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: har har karatiaa man niramal hoaa gur kee sev piaaree he ||11||
verses.translation: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, their minds become immaculate; they love to serve the Guru. ||11||

verses.original: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: se jan sukhe'ee satigur sache laae ||
verses.translation: Those humble beings are at peace, whom the True Guru attaches to the Truth.
He Himself, in His Will, merges them into Himself.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਉਬਰੇ ਹੋਰ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਖੁਆਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: satigur raakhe se jan ubare hor maiaa moh khuaaree he ||12||
verses.translation: Those humble beings, whom the True Guru protects, are saved. The rest are ruined through emotional attachment to Maya. ||12||
