The Gurmukh realizes the True Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: naa tis kuTa(n)b naa tis maataa ||
verses.translation: He has no family, and he has no mother.

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਆਧਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: eko ek raviaa sabh a(n)tar sabhanaa jeeaa kaa aadhaaree he ||13||
verses.translation: The One and Only Lord is pervading and permeating deep within the nucleus of all. He is the Support of all beings. ||13||
Egotism, possessiveness, and the love of duality

verses.original: ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਖਸਮਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kichh na chalai dhur khasam likh paiaa ||
verses.translation: - none of these shall go along with you; such is the pre-ordained will of our Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਾਚੇ ਤੇ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: gur saache te saach kamaaveh saachai dhookh nivaaree he ||14||
verses.translation: Through the True Guru, practice Truth, and the True Lord shall take away your pains. ||14||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਤੂ ਦੇਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jaa too dheh sadhaa sukh paae ||
verses.translation: If You so bless me, then I shall find lasting peace.
Through the True Word of the Shabad, I live the Truth.

verses.original: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhar saachaa man tan saachaa bhagat bhare bha(n)ddaaree he ||15||
verses.translation: The True Lord is within me, and my mind and body have become True. I am blessed with the overflowing treasure of devotional worship. ||15||
He Himself watches, and issues His Command.
He Himself inspires us to obey His Will.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੭॥
verses.translit: naanak naam rate bairaagee man tan rasanaa naam savaaree he ||16||7||
verses.translation: O Nanak, only those who are attuned to the Naam are detached; their minds, bodies and tongues are embellished with the Naam. ||16||7||
Maaroo, Third Mehla:
He Himself created Himself, and came into being.
The One Lord is pervading in all, remaining hidden.

verses.original: ਸਭਨਾ ਸਾਰ ਕਰੇ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਅਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sabhanaa saar kare jagajeevan jin apanaa aap pachhaataa he ||1||
verses.translation: The Lord, the Life of the world, takes care of all. Whoever knows his own self, realizes God. ||1||
He who created Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva,
links each and every being to its tasks.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jis bhaavai tis aape mele jin gurmukh eko jaataa he ||2||
verses.translation: He merges into Himself, whoever is pleasing to His Will. The Gurmukh knows the One Lord. ||2||
The world is coming and going in reincarnation.
Attached to Maya, it dwells on its many sins.

verses.original: ਥਿਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: thir saachaa saalaahee sadh hee jin gur kaa sabadh pachhaataa he ||3||
verses.translation: One who realizes the Word of the Guru's Shabad, praises forever the eternal, unchanging True Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਮੂਲਿ ਲਗੇ ਓਨੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: eik mool lage onee sukh paiaa ||
verses.translation: Some are attached to the root - they find peace.
But those who are attached to the branches, waste their lives away uselessly.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲ ਤਿਨ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਲਾਗੇ ਜੋ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat fal tin jan kau laage jo boleh a(n)mirat baataa he ||4||
verses.translation: Those humble beings, who chant the Name of the Ambrosial Lord, produce the ambrosial fruit. ||4||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਆ ਬੋਲਹ ਬੋਲ ॥
verses.translit: ham gun naahee kiaa boleh bol ||
verses.translation: I have no virtues; what words should I speak?
You see all, and weigh them on Your scale.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਰਹਣਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: jiau bhaavai tiau raakheh rahanaa gurmukh eko jaataa he ||5||
verses.translation: By Your will, You preserve me, and so do I remain. The Gurmukh knows the One Lord. ||5||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਤਾ ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jaa tudh bhaanaa taa sachee kaarai laae ||
verses.translation: According to Your Will, You link me to my true tasks.
Renouncing vice, I am immersed in virtue.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੋ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: gun meh eko niramal saachaa gur kai sabadh pachhaataa he ||6||
verses.translation: The One Immaculate True Lord abides in virtue; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is realized. ||6||
Wherever I look, there I see Him.
Duality and evil-mindedness are destroyed through the Shabad.

verses.original: ਏਕਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ਸਮਾਣਾ ਅਪਣੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਸਦ ਰਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: ekas meh prabh ek samaanaa apanai ra(n)g sadh raataa he ||7||
verses.translation: The One Lord God is immersed in His Oneness. He is attuned forever to His own delight. ||7||
The body-lotus is withering away,
but the ignorant, self-willed manmukh does not understand the Shabad.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਕਾਇਆ ਖੋਜੇ ਪਾਏ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee kaiaa khoje paae jagajeevan dhaataa he ||8||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, he searches his body, and finds the Great Giver, the Life of the world. ||8||
The Lord frees up the body-fortress, which was seized by sins,

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਰਾਖੈ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa har jeeau raakhai ur dhaare ||
verses.translation: when one keeps the Dear Lord enshrined forever in the heart.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਇਛੇ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ਜਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਜੀਠੈ ਰਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: jo ichhe soiee fal paae jiau ra(n)g majeeThai raataa he ||9||
verses.translation: The fruits of his desires are obtained, and he is dyed in the permanent color of the Lord's Love. ||9||
The self-willed manmukh speaks of spiritual wisdom, but does not understand.

verses.original: ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: fir fir aavai Thaur na koiee ||
verses.translation: Again and again, he comes into the world, but he finds no place of rest.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: gurmukh giaan sadhaa saalaahe jug jug eko jaataa he ||10||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh is spiritually wise, and praises the Lord forever. Throughout each and every age, the Gurmukh knows the One Lord. ||10||

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਦੁਖ ਸਬਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh kaar kare sabh dhukh sabaae ||
verses.translation: All the deeds which the manmukh does bring pain - nothing but pain.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਉ ਦਰਿ ਜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar sabadh naahee kiau dhar jaae ||
verses.translation: The Word of the Shabad is not within him; how can he go to the Court of the Lord?

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਦ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sabadh vasai man saachaa sadh seve sukhadhaataa he ||11||
verses.translation: The True Shabad dwells deep within the mind of the Gurmukh; he serves the Giver of peace forever. ||11||
Wherever I look, I see You, everywhere.
Through the Perfect Guru, all this is known.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਦਾ ਸਦ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: naamo naam dhiaaieeaai sadhaa sadh ih man naame raataa he ||12||
verses.translation: I meditate forever and ever on the Naam; this mind is imbued with the Naam. ||12||
Imbued with the Naam, the body is sanctified.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਡੂਬਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਨੀਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: bin naavai ddoob mue bin neeraa ||
verses.translation: Without the Naam, they are drowned and die without water.

verses.original: ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਇਕਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: aaveh jaaveh naam nahee boojheh ikanaa gurmukh sabadh pachhaataa he ||13||
verses.translation: They come and go, but do not understand the Naam. Some, as Gurmukh, realize the Word of the Shabad. ||13||
The Perfect True Guru has imparted this understanding.

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: vin naavai mukat kinai na paiee ||
verses.translation: Without the Name, no one attains liberation.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਸਹਜਿ ਰਹੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: naame naam milai vaddiaaiee sahaj rahai ra(n)g raataa he ||14||
verses.translation: Through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, one is blessed with glorious greatness; he remains intuitively attuned to the Lord's Love. ||14||
The body-village crumbles and collapses into a pile of dust.
Without the Shabad, the cycle of reincarnation is not brought to an end.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੁ ਸਲਾਹੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: saach salaahe saach samaavai jin gurmukh eko jaataa he ||15||
verses.translation: One who knows the One Lord, through the True Guru, praises the True Lord, and remains immersed in the True Lord. ||15||

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: jis no nadhar kare so paae || saachaa sabadh vasai man aae ||
verses.translation: The True Word of the Shabad comes to dwell in the mind, when the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੮॥
verses.translit: naanak naam rate nira(n)kaaree dhar saachai saach pachhaataa he ||16||8||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Formless Lord, realize the True Lord in His True Court. ||16||8||
Maaroo, Solhay, Third Mehla:
O Creator, it is You Yourself who does all.
All beings and creatures are under Your Protection.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aape gupat varatai sabh a(n)tar gur kai sabadh pachhaataa he ||1||
verses.translation: You are hidden, and yet permeating within all; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, You are realized. ||1||
Devotion to the Lord is a treasure overflowing.
He Himself blesses us with contemplative meditation on the Shabad.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਸਹਿ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jo tudh bhaavai soiee karaseh sache siau man raataa he ||2||
verses.translation: You do whatever You please; my mind is attuned to the True Lord. ||2||
You Yourself are the priceless diamond and jewel.
In Your Mercy, You weigh with Your scale.

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਆਪਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jeea ja(n)t sabh saran tumaaree kar kirapaa aap pachhaataa he ||3||
verses.translation: All beings and creatures are under Your protection. One who is blessed by Your Grace realizes his own self. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: jis no nadhar hovai dhur teree ||
verses.translation: One who receives Your Mercy, O Primal Lord,
does not die, and is not reborn; he is released from the cycle of reincarnation.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: saache gun gaavai dhin raatee jug jug eko jaataa he ||4||
verses.translation: He sings the Glorious Praises of the True Lord, day and night, and, throughout the ages, he knows the One Lord. ||4||
Emotional attachment to Maya wells up throughout the whole world,
from Brahma, Vishnu and all the demi-gods.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਣੇ ਸੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਗਿਆਨ ਮਤੀ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: jo tudh bhaane se naam laage giaan matee pachhaataa he ||5||
verses.translation: Those who are pleasing to Your Will, are attached to the Naam; through spiritual wisdom and understanding, You are recognized. ||5||
The world is engrossed in vice and virtue.

verses.original: ਹਰਖੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: harakh sog sabh dhukh hai bhaaraa ||
verses.translation: Happiness and misery are totally loaded with pain.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: gurmukh hovai so sukh paae jin gurmukh naam pachhaataa he ||6||
verses.translation: One who becomes Gurmukh finds peace; such a Gurmukh recognizes the Naam. ||6||
No one can erase the record of one's actions.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one finds the door of salvation.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਆਪੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: poorab likhiaa so fal paiaa jin aap maar pachhaataa he ||7||
verses.translation: One who conquers self-conceit and recognizes the Lord, obtains the fruits of his pre-destined rewards. ||7||

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa moh har siau chit na laagai ||
verses.translation: Emotionally attached to Maya, one's consciousness is not attached to the Lord.
In the love of duality, he will suffer terrible agony in the world hereafter.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੇ ਭੇਖਧਾਰੀ ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: manmukh bharam bhule bhekhadhaaree a(n)t kaal pachhutaataa he ||8||
verses.translation: The hypocritical, self-willed manmukhs are deluded by doubt; at the very last moment, they regret and repent. ||8||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: har kai bhaanai har gun gaae ||
verses.translation: In accordance with the Lord's Will, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
He is rid of all sins, and all suffering.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੈ ਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: har niramal niramal hai baanee har setee man raataa he ||9||
verses.translation: The Lord is immaculate, and immaculate is the Word of His Bani. My mind is imbued with the Lord. ||9||

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jis no nadhar kare so gun nidh paae ||
verses.translation: One who is blessed with the Lord's Glance of Grace, obtains the Lord, the treasure of virtue.
Egotism and possessiveness are brought to an end.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਅਵਗਣ ਕਾ ਏਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲੀ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: gun avagan kaa eko dhaataa gurmukh viralee jaataa he ||10||
verses.translation: The One Lord is the only Giver of virtue and vice, merits and demerits; how rare are those who, as Gurmukh, understand this. ||10||
My God is immaculate, and utterly infinite.
God unites with Himself, through contemplation of the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਸਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਰਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: aape bakhase sach dhiraRaae man tan saachai raataa he ||11||
verses.translation: He Himself forgives, and implants the Truth. The mind and body are then attuned to the True Lord. ||11||

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: man tan mailaa vich jot apaaraa ||
verses.translation: Within the polluted mind and body is the Light of the Infinite Lord.
One who understands the Guru's Teachings, contemplates this.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: haumai maar sadhaa man niramal rasanaa sev sukhadhaataa he ||12||
verses.translation: Conquering egotism, the mind becomes immaculate forever; with his tongue, he serves the Lord, the Giver of peace. ||12||

verses.original: ਗੜ ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਬਹੁ ਹਟ ਬਾਜਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: gaR kaiaa a(n)dhar bahu haT baajaaraa ||
verses.translation: In the fortress of the body there are many shops and bazaars;

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਅਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: tis vich naam hai at apaaraa ||
verses.translation: within them is the Naam, the Name of the utterly infinite Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh sadhaa dhar sohai haumai maar pachhaataa he ||13||
verses.translation: In His Court, one is embellished forever with the Word of the Guru's Shabad; he conquers egotism and realizes the Lord. ||13||
The jewel is priceless, inaccessible and infinite.
How can the poor wretch estimate its worth?

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਤੋਲਿ ਤੋਲਾਏ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadhe tol tolaae a(n)tar sabadh pachhaataa he ||14||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, it is weighed, and so the Shabad is realized deep within. ||14||

verses.original: ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਿਸਥਾਰਾ ॥ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: simirat saasatr bahut bisathaaraa || maiaa moh pasariaa paasaaraa ||
verses.translation: The great volumes of the Simritees and the Shaastras only extend the extension of attachment to Maya.

verses.original: ਮੂਰਖ ਪੜਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: moorakh paReh sabadh na boojheh gurmukh viralai jaataa he ||15||
verses.translation: The fools read them, but do not understand the Word of the Shabad. How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, understand. ||15||
The Creator Himself acts, and causes all to act.
Through the True Word of His Bani, Truth is implanted deep within.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੯॥
verses.translit: naanak naam milai vaddiaaiee jug jug eko jaataa he ||16||9||
verses.translation: O Nanak, through the Naam, one is blessed with glorious greatness, and throughout the ages, the One Lord is known. ||16||9||
Maaroo, Third Mehla:
Serve the True Creator Lord.
The Word of the Shabad is the Destroyer of pain.

verses.original: ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ਆਪੇ ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: agam agochar keemat nahee paiee aape agam athaahaa he ||1||
verses.translation: He is inaccessible and unfathomable; He cannot be evaluated. He Himself is inaccessible and immeasurable. ||1||
The True Lord Himself makes Truth pervasive.
He attaches some humble beings to the Truth.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੋ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: saacho seveh saach kamaaveh naame sach samaahaa he ||2||
verses.translation: They serve the True Lord and practice Truth; through the Name, they are absorbed in the True Lord. ||2||
The Primal Lord unites His devotees in His Union.
He attaches them to true devotional worship.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਇਸੁ ਜਨਮੈ ਕਾ ਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: saachee baanee sadhaa gun gaavai is janamai kaa laahaa he ||3||
verses.translation: One who sings forever the Glorious Praises of the Lord, through the True Word of His Bani, earns the profit of this life. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਰੁ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh vanaj kareh par aap pachhaaneh ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh trades, and understands his own self.

verses.original: ਏਕਸ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: ekas bin ko avar na jaaneh ||
verses.translation: He knows no other than the One Lord.

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਸਚੇ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: sachaa saahu sache vanajaare poo(n)jee naam visaahaa he ||4||
verses.translation: True is the banker, and True are His traders, who buy the merchandise of the Naam. ||4||
He Himself fashions and creates the Universe.
He inspires a few to realize the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਾਚੇ ਕਾਟੇ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਫਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: satigur seveh se jan saache kaaTe jam kaa faahaa he ||5||
verses.translation: Those humble beings who serve the True Guru are true. He snaps the noose of death from around their necks. ||5||
He destroys, creates, embellishes and fashions all beings,
and attaches them to duality, attachment and Maya.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਜੇਵੜਾ ਗਲਿ ਫਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: manmukh fireh sadhaa a(n)dh kamaaveh jam kaa jevaRaa gal faahaa he ||6||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs wander around forever, acting blindly. Death has strung his noose around their necks. ||6||
He Himself forgives, and enjoins us to serve the Guru.
Through the Guru's Teachings, the Naam comes to dwell within the mind.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਸਾਚਾ ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: anadhin naam dhiaae saachaa is jag meh naamo laahaa he ||7||
verses.translation: Night and day, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the True Lord, and earn the profit of the Naam in this world. ||7||
He Himself is True, and True is His Name.
The Gurmukh bestows it, and enshrines it within the mind.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਸਿਰਿ ਚੂਕਾ ਕਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: jin man vasiaa se jan soheh tin sir chookaa kaahaa he ||8||
verses.translation: Noble and exalted are those, within whose mind the Lord abides. Their heads are free of strife. ||8||
He is inaccessible and unfathomable; His value cannot be appraised.
By Guru's Grace, He dwells within the mind.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਲੇਖਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੰਗੈ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sabadh saalaahee gunadhaataa lekhaa koi na ma(n)gai taahaa he ||9||
verses.translation: No one calls that person to account, who praises the Word of the Shabad, the Giver of virtue. ||9||

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਰੁਦ੍ਰੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: brahamaa bisan rudhr tis kee sevaa ||
verses.translation: Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva serve Him.
Even they cannot find the limits of the unseen, unknowable Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੂ ਅਪਣੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: jin kau nadhar kareh too apanee gurmukh alakh lakhaahaa he ||10||
verses.translation: Those who are blessed by Your Glance of Grace, become Gurmukh, and comprehend the incomprehensible. ||10||
The Perfect True Guru has imparted this understanding.
I have enshrined the Naam, the One Name, within my mind.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀ ਤੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: naam japee tai naam dhiaaiee mahal pai gun gaahaa he ||11||
verses.translation: I chant the Naam, and meditate on the Naam. Singing His Glorious Praises, I enter the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||11||
The servant serves, and obeys the Command of the Infinite Lord.
The self-willed manmukhs do not know the value of the Lord's Command.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਮੰਨੇ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: hukame ma(n)ne hukame vaddiaaiee hukame veparavaahaa he ||12||
verses.translation: By the Hukam of the Lord's Command, one is exalted; by His Hukam, one is glorified; by His Hukam, one becomes carefree. ||12||
By Guru's Grace, one recognizes the Lord's Hukam.
The wandering mind is restrained, and brought back to the home of the One Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੇ ਰਾਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: naame raataa sadhaa bairaagee naam ratan man taahaa he ||13||
verses.translation: Imbued with the Naam, one remains forever detached; the jewel of the Naam rests within the mind. ||13||

verses.original: ਸਭ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: sabh jag meh varatai eko soiee ||
verses.translation: The One Lord is pervasive throughout all the world.
By Guru's Grace, He is revealed.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੁ ਸਲਾਹਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: sabadh salaaheh se jan niramal nij ghar vaasaa taahaa he ||14||
verses.translation: Those humble beings who praise the Shabad are immaculate; they dwell within the home of their own inner self. ||14||
The devotees abide forever in Your Sanctuary, Lord.
You are inaccessible and unfathomable; Your value cannot be estimated.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਤੂ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: jiau tudh bhaaveh tiau too raakheh gurmukh naam dhiaahaa he ||15||
verses.translation: As it pleases Your Will, You keep us; the Gurmukh meditates on the Naam. ||15||
Forever and ever, I sing Your Glorious Praises.
O my True Lord and Master, may I become pleasing to Your Mind.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਸਚੁ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੧॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: naanak saach kahai bena(n)tee sach dhevahu sach samaahaa he ||16||1||10||
verses.translation: Nanak offers this true prayer: O Lord, please bless me with Truth, that I may merge in the Truth. ||16||1||10||
Maaroo, Third Mehla:
Those who serve the True Guru are very fortunate.
Night and day, they remain lovingly attuned to the True Name.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਰਵਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੈ ਓਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sukhadhaataa raviaa ghaT a(n)tar sabadh sachai omaahaa he ||1||
verses.translation: The Lord, the Giver of peace, abides forever deep within their hearts; they delight in the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||
When the Lord grants His Grace, one meets with the Guru.
The Name of the Lord is enshrined within the mind.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸਬਦੇ ਮਨਿ ਓਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har man vasiaa sadhaa sukhadhaataa sabadhe man omaahaa he ||2||
verses.translation: The Lord, the Giver of peace, abides forever within the mind; the mind is delighted with the Word of the Shabad. ||2||
When the Lord bestows His Mercy, He unites in His Union.
Egotism and attachment are burned away by the Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਰਹੈ ਇਕ ਰੰਗੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਕਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sadhaa mukat rahai ik ra(n)gee naahee kisai naal kaahaa he ||3||
verses.translation: In the Love of the One Lord, one remains liberated forever; he is not in conflict with anyone. ||3||
Without serving the True Guru, there is only pitch-black darkness.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਪਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: bin sabadhai koi na paavai paaraa ||
verses.translation: Without the Shabad, no one crosses over to the other side.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਮਹਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: jo sabadh raate mahaa bairaagee so sach sabadhe laahaa he ||4||
verses.translation: Those who are imbued with the Shabad, are very detached. They earn the profit of the True Word of the Shabad. ||4||

verses.original: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਕਰਤੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh sukh karatai dhur likh paiaa ||
verses.translation: Pain and pleasure are pre-ordained by the Creator.
He Himself has caused the love of duality to be pervasive.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਅਲਿਪਤੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਵੇਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: gurmukh hovai su alipato varatai manmukh kaa kiaa vesaahaa he ||5||
verses.translation: One who becomes Gurmukh remains detached; how can anyone trust the self-willed manmukh? ||5||

verses.original: ਸੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਜੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: se manmukh jo sabadh na pachhaaneh ||
verses.translation: Those who do not recognize the Shabad are manmukhs.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਭੈ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: gur ke bhai kee saar na jaaneh ||
verses.translation: They do not know the essence of the Fear of the Guru.

verses.original: ਭੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਉ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਮੁ ਕਾਢਿ ਲਏਗਾ ਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: bhai bin kiau nirabhau sach paieeaai jam kaadd legaa saahaa he ||6||
verses.translation: Without this Fear, how can anyone find the Fearless True Lord? The Messenger of Death will pull the breath out. ||6||
The invulnerable Messenger of Death cannot be killed.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadhe neR na aaiee ||
verses.translation: The Word of the Guru's Shabad prevents him from approaching.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣੇ ਤਾ ਦੂਰਹੁ ਭਾਗੈ ਮਤੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: sabadh sune taa dhoorahu bhaagai mat maare har jeeau veparavaahaa he ||7||
verses.translation: When he hears the Word of the Shabad, he runs far away. He is afraid that the self-sufficient Dear Lord will kill him. ||7||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਸਿਰਕਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: har jeeau kee hai sabh sirakaaraa ||
verses.translation: The Dear Lord is the Ruler above all.
What can this wretched Messenger of Death do?

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਬੰਦਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਕਢਦਾ ਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: hukamee ba(n)dhaa hukam kamaavai hukame kaddadhaa saahaa he ||8||
verses.translation: As slave to the Hukam of the Lord's Command, the mortal acts according to His Hukam. According to His Hukam, he is deprived of his breath. ||8||
The Gurmukh realizes that the True Lord created the creation.
The Gurmukh knows that the Lord has expanded the entire expanse.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਬੂਝੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: gurmukh hovai so sach boojhai sabadh sachai sukh taahaa he ||9||
verses.translation: One who becomes Gurmukh, understands the True Lord. Through the True Word of the Shabad, he finds peace. ||9||
The Gurmukh knows that the Lord is the Architect of karma.
Throughout the four ages, he recognizes the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਨਮੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: gurmukh marai na janamai gurmukh gurmukh sabadh samaahaa he ||10||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh does not die, the Gurmukh is not reborn; the Gurmukh is immersed in the Shabad. ||10||
The Gurmukh praises the Naam, and the Shabad.
God is inaccessible, unfathomable and self-sufficient.

verses.original: ਏਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰਿ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਸਬਦੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: ek naam jug chaar udhaare sabadhe naam visaahaa he ||11||
verses.translation: The Naam, the Name of the One Lord, saves and redeems throughout the four ages. Through the Shabad, one trades in the Naam. ||11||
The Gurmukh obtains eternal peace and tranqulity.
The Gurmukh enshrines the Naam within his heart.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੂਝੈ ਕਾਟੇ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਫਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: gurmukh hovai so naam boojhai kaaTe dhuramat faahaa he ||12||
verses.translation: One who becomes Gurmukh recognizes the Naam, and the noose of evil-mindedness is snapped. ||12||
The Gurmukh wells up from, and then merges back into Truth.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਨ ਜੂਨੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: naa mar ja(n)mai na joonee paavai ||
verses.translation: He does not die and take birth, and is not consigned to reincarnation.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਰਹਹਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਲੈਦੇ ਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sadhaa raheh ra(n)g raate anadhin laidhe laahaa he ||13||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh remains forever imbued with the color of the Lord's Love. Night and day, he earns a profit. ||13||
The Gurmukhs, the devotees, are exalted and beautified in the Court of the Lord.
They are embellished with the True Word of His Bani, and the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਹਜ ਸੇਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: anadhin gun gaavai dhin raatee sahaj setee ghar jaahaa he ||14||
verses.translation: Night and day, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, day and night, and they intuitively go to their own home. ||14||
The Perfect True Guru proclaims the Shabad;
night and day, remain lovingly attuned to devotional worship.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗੁਣ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: har gun gaaveh sadh hee niramal niramal gun paatisaahaa he ||15||
verses.translation: One who sings forever the Glorious Praises of the Lord, becomes immaculate; Immaculate are the Glorious Praises of the Sovereign Lord . ||15||
The True Lord is the Giver of virtue.
How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, understand this.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੇ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਸੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੇਪਰਵਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੨॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: naanak jan naam salaahe bigasai so naam beparavaahaa he ||16||2||11||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak praises the Naam; he blossoms forth in the ecstasy of the Name of the self-sufficient Lord. ||16||2||11||
Maaroo, Third Mehla:
Serve the Dear Lord, the inaccessible and infinite.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: tis dhaa a(n)t na paieeaai paaraavaaraa ||
verses.translation: He has no end or limitation.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤਿਤੁ ਘਟਿ ਮਤਿ ਅਗਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadh raviaa ghaT a(n)tar tit ghaT mat agaahaa he ||1||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, one who dwells upon the Lord deep within his heart - his heart is filled with infinite wisdom. ||1||
The One Lord is pervading and permeating amidst all.
By Guru's Grace, He is revealed.

verses.original: ਸਭਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ਕਰੇ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦੇਦਾ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸੰਬਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sabhanaa pratipaal kare jagajeevan dhedhaa rijak sa(n)baahaa he ||2||
verses.translation: The Life of the world nurtures and cherishes all, giving sustenance to all. ||2||
The Perfect True Guru has imparted this understanding.
By the Hukam of His Command, He created the entire Universe.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਨੇ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: hukam ma(n)ne soiee sukh paae hukam sir saahaa paatisaahaa he ||3||
verses.translation: Whoever submits to His Command, finds peace; His Command is above the heads of kings and emperors. ||3||
True is the True Guru. Infinite is the Word of His Shabad.
Through His Shabad, the world is saved.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਦੇਦਾ ਸਾਸ ਗਿਰਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: aape karataa kar kar vekhai dhedhaa saas giraahaa he ||4||
verses.translation: The Creator Himself created the creation; He gazes upon it, and blesses it with breath and nourishment. ||4||
Out of millions, only a few understand.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh rate ra(n)g laae ||
verses.translation: Imbued with the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they are colored in His Love.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਾਲਾਹਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਬਖਸੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: har saalaaheh sadhaa sukhadhaataa har bakhase bhagat salaahaa he ||5||
verses.translation: They praise the Lord, the Giver of peace forever; the Lord forgives His devotees, and blesses them with His Praise. ||5||
Those humble beings who serve the True Guru are true.
The falsest of the false die, only to be reborn.

verses.original: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਅਥਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: agam agochar veparavaahaa bhagat vachhal athaahaa he ||6||
verses.translation: The inaccessible, unfathomable, self-sufficient, incomprehensible Lord is the Lover of His devotees. ||6||
The Perfect True Guru implants Truth within.
Through the True Word of the Shabad, they sing His Glorious Praises forever.

verses.original: ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਲਿਖਦਾ ਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: gunadhaataa varatai sabh a(n)tar sir sir likhadhaa saahaa he ||7||
verses.translation: The Giver of virtue is pervading deep within the nucleus of all beings; He inscribes the time of destiny upon each and every person's head. ||7||
The Gurmukh knows that God is always ever-present.
That humble being who serves the Shabad, is comforted and fulfilled.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੈ ਓਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: anadhin seveh sachee baanee sabadh sachai omaahaa he ||8||
verses.translation: Night and day, he serves the True Word of the Guru's Bani; he delights in the True Word of the Shabad. ||8||
The ignorant and blind cling to all sorts of rituals.
They stubborn-mindedly perform these rituals, and are consigned to reincarnation.

verses.original: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਲਬੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਾ ਦੋਰਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: bikhiaa kaaran lab lobh kamaaveh dhuramat kaa dhoraahaa he ||9||
verses.translation: For the sake of poison, they act in greed and possessiveness, and evil-minded duality. ||9||
The Perfect True Guru implants devotional worship within.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh har naam chit laae ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he lovingly centers his consciousness on the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭੀਨੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: man tan har raviaa ghaT a(n)tar man bheenai bhagat salaahaa he ||10||
verses.translation: The Lord pervades his mind, body and heart; deep within, his mind is drenched with devotional worship and praise of the Lord. ||10||
My True Lord God is the Destroyer of demons.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, His devotees are saved.

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: meraa prabh saachaa sadh hee saachaa sir saahaa paatisaahaa he ||11||
verses.translation: My True Lord God is forever True. He is the Emperor over the heads of kings. ||11||

verses.original: ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਸਚੇ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: se bhagat sache terai man bhaae ||
verses.translation: True are those devotees, who are pleasing to Your Mind.

verses.original: ਦਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: dhar keeratan kareh gur sabadh suhaae ||
verses.translation: They sing the Kirtan of His Praises at His Door; they are embellished and exalted by the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਨਿਰਧਨ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵੇਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: saachee baanee anadhin gaaveh niradhan kaa naam vesaahaa he ||12||
verses.translation: Night and day, they sing the True Word of His Bani. The Naam is the wealth of the poor. ||12||
Those whom You unite, Lord, are never separated again.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they praise You forever.

verses.original: ਸਭਨਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਤੂ ਏਕੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: sabhanaa sir too eko saahib sabadhe naam salaahaa he ||13||
verses.translation: You are the One Lord and Master over all. Through the Shabad, the Naam is praised. ||13||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਤੁਧੁਨੋ ਕੋਈ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: bin sabadhai tudhuno koiee na jaanee ||
verses.translation: Without the Shabad, no one knows You.
You Yourself speak the Unspoken Speech.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਸੰਬਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: aape sabadh sadhaa gur dhaataa har naam jap sa(n)baahaa he ||14||
verses.translation: You Yourself are the Shabad forever, the Guru, the Great Giver; chanting the Lord's Name, You bestow Your treasure. ||14||
You Yourself are the Creator of the Universe.
No one can erase what You have written.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਸਹਸਾ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: gurmukh naam dheveh too aape sahasaa ganat na taahaa he ||15||
verses.translation: You Yourself bless the Gurmukh with the Naam, who is no longer skeptical, and is not held to account. ||15||
Your true devotees stand at the Door of Your Court.
They serve the Shabad with love and affection.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਨਾਮੇ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸੋਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੩॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: naanak naam rate bairaagee naame kaaraj sohaa he ||16||3||12||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam remain detached; through the Naam, their affairs are resolved. ||16||3||12||
Maaroo, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੇਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਇਕੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: merai prabh saachai ik khel rachaiaa ||
verses.translation: My True Lord God has staged a play.

verses.original: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਜੇਹਾ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: koi na kis hee jehaa upaiaa ||
verses.translation: He has created no one like anyone else.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਫਰਕੁ ਕਰੇ ਵੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਸਭਿ ਰਸ ਦੇਹੀ ਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aape farak kare vekh vigasai sabh ras dhehee maahaa he ||1||
verses.translation: He made them different, and he gazes upon them with pleasure; he placed all the flavors in the body. ||1||
You Yourself vibrate the beat of the breath.
Shiva and Shakti, energy and matter - You have placed them into the body.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਉਲਟੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਗਿਆਨ ਰਤਨੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee ulaTee hovai giaan ratan sabadh taahaa he ||2||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, one turns away from the world, and attains the jewel of spiritual wisdom, and the Word of the Shabad. ||2||
He Himself created darkness and light.
He alone is pervasive; there is no other at all.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਕਮਲੁ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਬੁਧਿ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee aap pachhaanai kamal bigasai budh taahaa he ||3||
verses.translation: One who realizes his own self - by Guru's Grace, the lotus of his mind blossoms forth. ||3||
Only He Himself knows His depth and extent.

verses.original: ਹੋਰੁ ਲੋਕੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: hor lok sun sun aakh vakhaanai ||
verses.translation: Other people can only listen and hear what is spoken and said.

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਸਾਚੀ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: giaanee hovai su gurmukh boojhai saachee sifat salaahaa he ||4||
verses.translation: One who is spiritually wise, understands himself as Gurmukh; he praises the True Lord. ||4||
Deep within the body is the priceless object.
He Himself opens the doors.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sahaje a(n)mrit peevai tirasanaa agan bujhaahaa he ||5||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh intuitively drings in the Ambrosial Nectar, and the fire of desire is quenched. ||5||
He placed all the flavors within the body.
How rare are those who understand, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਖੋਜੇ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਾਹੇ ਜਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhar khoje sabadh saalaahe baahar kaahe jaahaa he ||6||
verses.translation: So search within yourself, and praise the Shabad. Why run around outside your self? ||6||

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਚਾਖੇ ਸਾਦੁ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: vin chaakhe saadh kisai na aaiaa ||
verses.translation: Without tasting, no one enjoys the flavor.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀ ਅਮਰਾ ਪਦੁ ਹੋਏ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਸੁ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit pee amaraa padh hoe gur kai sabadh ras taahaa he ||7||
verses.translation: The Ambrosial Nectar is drunk, and the immoral status is obtained, when one obtains the sublime essence of the Guru's Shabad. ||7||

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸੋ ਸਭਿ ਗੁਣ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: aap pachhaanai so sabh gun jaanai ||
verses.translation: One who realizes himself, knows all virtues.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh har naam vakhaanai ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he chants the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: anadhin naam rataa dhin raatee maiaa moh chukaahaa he ||8||
verses.translation: Night and day, he remains imbued with the Naam, day and night; he is rid of emotional attachment to Maya. ||8||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gur sevaa te sabh kichh paae ||
verses.translation: Serving the Guru, all things are obtained;
egotism, possessiveness and self-conceit are taken away.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਸੋਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: aape kirapaa kare sukhadhaataa gur kai sabadhe sohaa he ||9||
verses.translation: The Lord, the Giver of peace Himself grants His Grace; He exalts and adorns with the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||9||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਹੈ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: gur kaa sabadh a(n)mirat hai baanee ||
verses.translation: The Guru's Shabad is the Ambrosial Bani.
Night and day, chant the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਚਾ ਵਸੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੋ ਘਟੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: har har sachaa vasai ghaT a(n)tar so ghaT niramal taahaa he ||10||
verses.translation: That heart becomes immaculate, which is filled with the True Lord, Har, Har. ||10||
His servants serve, and praise His Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa ra(n)g raate har gun gaaveh ||
verses.translation: Imbued forever with the color of His Love, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਪਰਮਲ ਵਾਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: aape bakhase sabadh milaae paramal vaas man taahaa he ||11||
verses.translation: He Himself forgives, and unites them with the Shabad; the fragrance of sandalwood permeates their minds. ||11||
Through the Shabad, they speak the Unspoken, and praise the Lord.
My True Lord God is self-sufficient.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਸਬਦੈ ਕਾ ਰਸੁ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: aape gunadhaataa sabadh milaae sabadhai kaa ras taahaa he ||12||
verses.translation: The Giver of virtue Himself unites them with the Shabad; they enjoy the sublime essence of the Shabad. ||12||
The confused, self-willed manmukhs find no place of rest.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jo dhur likhiaa su karam kamaae ||
verses.translation: They do those deeds which they are pre-destined to do.

verses.original: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਰਾਤੇ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਖੋਜੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: bikhiaa raate bikhiaa khojai mar janamai dhukh taahaa he ||13||
verses.translation: Imbued with poison, they search out poison, and suffer the pains of death and rebirth. ||13||
He Himself praises Himself.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਮਾਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: tere gun prabh tujh hee maahe ||
verses.translation: Your Glorious Virtues are within You alone, God.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਆਪਿ ਸਚਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੀ ਆਪੇ ਅਲਖੁ ਅਥਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: too aap sachaa teree baanee sachee aape alakh athaahaa he ||14||
verses.translation: You Yourself are True, and True is the Word of Your Bani. You Yourself are invisible and unknowable. ||14||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਦਾਤੇ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: bin gur dhaate koi na paae ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, the Giver, no one finds the Lord,
though one may make hundreds of thousands and millions of attempts.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਬਦੇ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: gur kirapaa te ghaT a(n)tar vasiaa sabadhe sach saalaahaa he ||15||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, He dwells deep within the heart; through the Shabad, praise the True Lord. ||15||

verses.original: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਧੁਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: se jan mile dhur aap milaae ||
verses.translation: They alone meet Him, whom the Lord unites with Himself.
They are adorned and exalted with the True Word of His Bani, and the Shabad.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਿਤ ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੪॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: naanak jan gun gaavai nit saache gun gaaveh gunee samaahaa he ||16||4||13||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak continually sings the Glorious Praises of the True Lord; singing His Glories, he is immersed in the Glorious Lord of Virtue. ||16||4||13||
Maaroo, Third Mehla:
The One Lord is eternal and unchanging, forever True.
Through the Perfect Guru, this understanding is obtained.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਭੀਨੇ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸੀਲੁ ਸੰਨਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har ras bheene sadhaa dhiaain gurmat seel sa(n)naahaa he ||1||
verses.translation: Those who are drenched with the sublime essence of the Lord, meditate forever on Him; following the Guru's Teachings, they obtain the armor of humility. ||1||
Deep within, they love the True Lord forever.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh har naam piaaraa ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they love the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: nau nidh naam vasiaa ghaT a(n)tar chhoddiaa maiaa kaa laahaa he ||2||
verses.translation: The Naam, the embodiment of the nine treasures, abides within their hearts; they renounce the profit of Maya. ||2||
Both the king and his subjects are involved in evil-mindedness and duality.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਏਕੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: bin satigur seve ek na hoiee ||
verses.translation: Without serving the True Guru, they do not become one with the Lord.

verses.original: ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਰਾਜੁ ਤਿਨਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ek dhiaain sadhaa sukh pain nihachal raaj tinaahaa he ||3||
verses.translation: Those who meditate on the One Lord find eternal peace. Their power is eternal and unfailing. ||3||
No one can save them from coming and going.
Birth and death come from Him.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਗਤਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਤੇ ਪਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: gurmukh saachaa sadhaa dhiaavahu gat mukat tisai te paahaa he ||4||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh meditates forever on the True Lord. Emancipation and liberation are obtained from Him. ||4||
Truth and self-control are found through the Door of the True Guru.
Egotism and anger are silenced through the Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸੀਲੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: satigur sev sadhaa sukh paieeaai seel sa(n)tokh sabh taahaa he ||5||
verses.translation: Serving the True Guru, lasting peace is found; humility and contentment all come from Him. ||5||
Out of egotism and attachment, the Universe welled up.
Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, all the world perishes.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚਾ ਜਗਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: bin satigur seve naam na paieeaai naam sachaa jag laahaa he ||6||
verses.translation: Without serving the True Guru, the Naam is not obtained. The Naam is the True profit in this world. ||6||
True is His Will, beauteous and pleasing through the Word of the Shabad.
The Panch Shabad, the five primal sounds, vibrate and resonate.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਕੇਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: sadhaa kaaraj sach naam suhelaa bin sabadhai kaaraj kehaa he ||7||
verses.translation: Through the True Name, one's actions are forever embellished. Without the Shabad, what can anyone do? ||7||

verses.original: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਹਸੈ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਰੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: khin meh hasai khin meh rovai ||
verses.translation: One instant, he laughs, and the next instant, he cries.
Because of duality and evil-mindedness, his affairs are not resolved.

verses.original: ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਕਰਤੈ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਏ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਚਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: sa(n)jog vijog karatai likh paae kirat na chalai chalaahaa he ||8||
verses.translation: Union and separation are pre-ordained by the Creator. Actions already committed cannot be taken back. ||8||
One who lives the Word of the Guru's Shabad becomes Jivan Mukta - liberated while yet alive.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: har siau sadh hee rahai samaae ||
verses.translation: He remains forever immersed in the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: gur kirapaa te milai vaddiaaiee haumai rog na taahaa he ||9||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, one is blessed with glorious greatness; he is not afflicted by the disease of egotism. ||9||
Eating tasty delicacies, he fattens up his body

verses.original: ਭੇਖ ਕਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: bhekh karai gur sabadh na kamaae ||
verses.translation: and wears religious robes, but he does not live to the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰੋਗੁ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਰੀ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar rog mahaa dhukh bhaaree bisaTaa maeh samaahaa he ||10||
verses.translation: Deep with the nucleus of his being is the great disease; he suffers terrible pain, and eventually sinks into the manure. ||10||
He reads and studies the Vedas, and argues about them;

verses.original: ਘਟ ਮਹਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT meh braham tis sabadh na pachhaaneh ||
verses.translation: God is within his own heart, but he does not recognize the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਤਤੁ ਬਿਲੋਵੈ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: gurmukh hovai su tat bilovai rasanaa har ras taahaa he ||11||
verses.translation: One who becomes Gurmukh churns the essence of reality; his tongue savors the sublime essence of the Lord. ||11||
Those who forsake the object within their own hearts, wander outside.
The blind, self-willed manmukhs do not taste the flavor of God.

verses.original: ਅਨ ਰਸ ਰਾਤੀ ਰਸਨਾ ਫੀਕੀ ਬੋਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: an ras raatee rasanaa feekee bole har ras mool na taahaa he ||12||
verses.translation: Imbued with the taste of another, their tongues speak tasteless, insipid words. They never taste the sublime essence of the Lord. ||12||
The self-willed manmukh has doubt as his spouse.
He dies of evil-mindedness, and suffers forever.

verses.original: ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਮਨੁ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਇਆ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh man dhoojai laiaa supanai sukh na taahaa he ||13||
verses.translation: His mind is attached to sexual desire, anger and duality, and he does not find peace, even in dreams. ||13||
The body becomes golden, with the Word of the Shabad as its spouse.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭੋਗ ਭੋਗੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin bhog bhoge har siau piaaro ||
verses.translation: Night and day, enjoy the enjoyments, and be in love with the Lord.

verses.original: ਮਹਲਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਗੈਰ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਏ ਭਾਣਾ ਬੁਝਿ ਸਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: mahalaa a(n)dhar gair mahal paae bhaanaa bujh samaahaa he ||14||
verses.translation: Deep within the mansion of the self, one finds the Lord, who transcends this mansion. Realizing His Will, we merge in Him. ||14||
The Great Giver Himself gives.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਨਹੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਕਾ ਚਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: tis aagai nahee kisai kaa chaaraa ||
verses.translation: No one has any power to stand against Him.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਥਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: aape bakhase sabadh milaae tis dhaa sabadh athaahaa he ||15||
verses.translation: He Himself forgives, and unites us with the Shabad; The Word of His Shabad is unfathomable. ||15||

verses.original: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jeeau pi(n)dd sabh hai tis keraa ||
verses.translation: Body and soul, all belong to Him.
The True Lord is my only Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪਿ ਸਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੫॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: naanak gurbaanee har paiaa har jap jaap samaahaa he ||16||5||14||
verses.translation: O Nanak, through the Word of the Guru's Bani, I have found the Lord. Chanting the Lord's Chant, I merge in Him. ||16||5||14||
Maaroo, Third Mehla:
The Gurmukh contemplates the sound current of the Naad instead of the Vedas.
The Gurmukh attains infinite spiritual wisdom and meditation.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gurmukh kaar kare prabh bhaavai gurmukh pooraa paidhaa ||1||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh acts in harmony with God's Will; the Gurmukh finds perfection. ||1||
The mind of the Gurmukh turns away from the world.
The Gurmukh vibrates the Naad, the sound current of the Guru's Bani.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sach rate bairaagee nij ghar vaasaa paidhaa ||2||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh, attuned to the Truth, remains detached, and dwells in the home of the self deep within. ||2||
I speak the Ambrosial Teachings of the Guru.
I lovingly chant the Truth, through the True Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਚਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sach ra(n)g raataa man meraa sache sach samaidhaa ||3||
verses.translation: My mind remains forever imbued with the Love of the True Lord. I am immersed in the Truest of the True. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਤ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh man niramal sat sar naavai ||
verses.translation: Immaculate and pure is the mind of the Gurmukh, who bathes in the Pool of Truth.
No filth attaches to him; he merges in the True Lord.

verses.original: ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: sacho sach kamaavai sadh hee sachee bhagat dhiraRaidhaa ||4||
verses.translation: He truly practices Truth forever; true devotion is implanted within him. ||4||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਬੈਣੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਨੈਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sach bainee gurmukh sach nainee ||
verses.translation: True is the speech of the Gurmukh; true are the eyes of the Gurmukh.
The Gurmukh practices and lives the Truth.

verses.original: ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਅਵਰਾ ਸਚੁ ਕਹਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: sadh hee sach kahai dhin raatee avaraa sach kahaidhaa ||5||
verses.translation: He speaks the Truth forever, day and night, and inspires others to speak the Truth. ||5||
True and exalted is the speech of the Gurmukh.
The Gurmukh speaks Truth, only Truth.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਚੋ ਸਚਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sadh seveh sacho sachaa gurmukh sabadh sunaidhaa ||6||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh serves the Truest of the True forever; the Gurmukh proclaims the Word of the Shabad. ||6||
One who becomes Gurmukh understands.
He rids himself of egotism, Maya and doubt.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪਉੜੀ ਊਤਮ ਊਚੀ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: gur kee pauRee uootam uoochee dhar sachai har gun gaidhaa ||7||
verses.translation: He ascends the sublime, exalted ladder of the Guru, and he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord at His True Door. ||7||
The Gurmukh practices true self-control, and acts in excellence.
The Gurmukh obtains the gate of salvation.

verses.original: ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: bhai bhagat sadhaa ra(n)g raataa aap gavai samaidhaa ||8||
verses.translation: Through loving devotion, he remains forever imbued with the Lord's Love; eradicating self-conceit, he merges in the Lord. ||8||
One who becomes Gurmukh examines his own mind, and instructs others.
He is lovingly attuned to the True Name forever.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਸੀ ਜੋ ਸਚੇ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: jo tis bhaavai soiee karasee jo sache man bhaidhaa ||9||
verses.translation: They act in harmony with the Mind of the True Lord. ||9||
As it pleases His Will, He unites us with the True Guru.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jaa tis bhaavai taa ma(n)n vasaae ||
verses.translation: As it pleases His Will, He comes to dwell within the mind.

verses.original: ਆਪਣੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਭਾਣੈ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: aapanai bhaanai sadhaa ra(n)g raataa bhaanai ma(n)n vasaidhaa ||10||
verses.translation: As it pleases His Will, He imbues us with His Love; as it pleases His Will, He comes to dwell in the mind. ||10||
Those who act stubborn-mindedly are destroyed.
Wearing all sorts of religious robes, they do not please the Lord.

verses.original: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਰਾਤੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਦੁਖੇ ਦੁਖਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: bikhiaa raate dhukh kamaaveh dhukhe dhukh samaidhaa ||11||
verses.translation: Tinged by corruption, they earn only pain; they are immersed in pain. ||11||
One who becomes Gurmukh earns peace.
He comes to understand death and birth.

verses.original: ਮਰਣੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਜੋ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: maran jeevan jo sam kar jaanai so mere prabh bhaidhaa ||12||
verses.translation: One who looks alike upon death and birth, is pleasing to my God. ||12||
The Gurmukh, while remaining dead, is respected and approved.
He realizes that coming and going are according to God's Will.

verses.original: ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜੰਮੈ ਨਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: marai na ja(n)mai naa dhukh paae man hee maneh samaidhaa ||13||
verses.translation: He does not die, he is not reborn, and he does not suffer in pain; his mind merges in the Mind of God. ||13||
Very fortunate are those who find the True Guru.
They eradicate egotism and attachment from within.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: man niramal fir mail na laagai dhar sachai sobhaa paidhaa ||14||
verses.translation: Their minds are immaculate, and they are never again stained with filth. They are honored at the Door of the True Court. ||14||
He Himself acts, and inspires all to act.
He Himself watches over all; He establishes and disestablishes.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਲੇਖੈ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sevaa mere prabh bhaavai sach sun lekhai paidhaa ||15||
verses.translation: The service of the Gurmukh is pleasing to my God; one who listens to the Truth is approved. ||15||
The Gurmukh practices Truth, and only Truth.
The Gurmukh is immaculate; no filth attaches to him.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੧॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: naanak naam rate veechaaree naame naam samaidhaa ||16||1||15||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who contemplate the Naam are imbued with it. They merge in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||16||1||15||
Maaroo, Third Mehla:
He Himself fashioned the Universe, through the Hukam of His Command.
He Himself establishes and disestablishes, and embellishes with grace.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਨਿਆਉ ਕਰੇ ਸਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aape niaau kare sabh saachaa saache saach milaidhaa ||1||
verses.translation: The True Lord Himself administers all justice; through Truth, we merge in the True Lord. ||1||
The body takes the form of a fortress.
Emotional attachment to Maya has expanded throughout its expanse.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਭਸਮੈ ਕੀ ਢੇਰੀ ਖੇਹੂ ਖੇਹ ਰਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bin sabadhai bhasamai kee dderee khehoo kheh ralaidhaa ||2||
verses.translation: Without the Word of the Shabad, the body is reduced to a pile of ashes; in the end, dust mingles with dust. ||2||
The body is the infinite fortress of gold;
it is permeated by the Infinite Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਚੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gurmukh gaavai sadhaa gun saache mil preetam sukh paidhaa ||3||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh sings the Glorious Praises of the True Lord forever; meeting his Beloved, he finds peace. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: kaiaa har ma(n)dhar har aap savaare ||
verses.translation: The body is the temple of the Lord; the Lord Himself embellishes it.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਵਸੈ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: tis vich har jeeau vasai muraare ||
verses.translation: The Dear Lord dwells within it.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਣਜਨਿ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh vanajan vaapaaree nadharee aap milaidhaa ||4||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the merchants trade, and in His Grace, the Lord merges them with Himself. ||4||
He alone is pure, who eradicates anger.
He realizes the Shabad, and reforms himself.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: aape kare karaae karataa aape ma(n)n vasaidhaa ||5||
verses.translation: The Creator Himself acts, and inspires all to act; He Himself abides in the mind. ||5||
Pure and unique is devotional worship.
The mind and body are washed clean, contemplating the Shabad.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: anadhin sadhaa rahai ra(n)g raataa kar kirapaa bhagat karaidhaa ||6||
verses.translation: One who remains forever imbued with His Love, night and day - in His Mercy, the Lord inspires him to perform devotional worship service. ||6||

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: eis man ma(n)dhar meh manooaa dhaavai ||
verses.translation: In this temple of the mind, the mind wanders around.

verses.original: ਸੁਖੁ ਪਲਰਿ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: sukh palar tiaag mahaa dhukh paavai ||
verses.translation: Discarding joy like straw, it suffers in terrible pain.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਆਪੇ ਖੇਲੁ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: bin satigur bheTe Thaur na paavai aape khel karaidhaa ||7||
verses.translation: Without meeting the True Guru, it finds no place of rest; He Himself has staged this play. ||7||
He Himself is infinite; He contemplates Himself.
He Himself bestows Union through actions of excellence.

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਾਰ ਕਰੇ ਵੇਚਾਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: kiaa ko kaar kare vechaaraa aape bakhas milaidhaa ||8||
verses.translation: What can the poor creatures do? Granting forgiveness, He unites them with Himself. ||8||
The Perfect Lord Himself unites them with the True Guru.
Through the True Word of the Shabad, he makes them brave spiritual heroes.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: aape mele dhe vaddiaaiee sache siau chit laidhaa ||9||
verses.translation: Uniting them with Himself, He bestows glorious greatness; He inspires them to focus their consciousness on the True Lord. ||9||
The True Lord is deep within the heart.
How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, realize this.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: naam nidhaan vasiaa ghaT a(n)tar rasanaa naam dhiaaidhaa ||10||
verses.translation: The treasure of the Naam abides deep within their hearts; they meditate on the Naam with their tongues. ||10||
He wanders through foreign lands, but does not look within himself.
Attached to Maya, he is bound and gagged by the Messenger of Death.

verses.original: ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਤੂਟੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਰਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: jam kee faasee kabahoo na tooTai dhoojai bhai bharamaidhaa ||11||
verses.translation: The noose of death around his neck will never be untied; in the love of duality, he wanders in reincarnation. ||11||

verses.original: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: jap tap sa(n)jam hor koiee naahee ||
verses.translation: There is no real chanting, meditation, penance or self-control,

verses.original: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਕਮਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: jab lag gur kaa sabadh na kamaahee ||
verses.translation: as long as one does not live to the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh miliaa sach paiaa sache sach samaidhaa ||12||
verses.translation: Accepting the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one obtains Truth; through Truth, one merges in the True Lord. ||12||
Sexual desire and anger are very powerful in the world.

verses.original: ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖ ਕਾ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: bahu karam kamaaveh sabh dhukh kaa pasaaraa ||
verses.translation: They lead to all sorts of actions, but these only add to all the pain.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: satigur seveh se sukh paaveh sachai sabadh milaidhaa ||13||
verses.translation: Those who serve the True Guru find peace; they are united with the True Shabad. ||13||
Air, water and fire make up the body.
Emotional attachment to Maya rules deep within all.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤੇ ਜਾ ਤਿਸੈ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: jin keete jaa tisai pachhaaneh maiaa moh chukaidhaa ||14||
verses.translation: When one realizes the One who created him, emotional attachment to Maya is dispelled. ||14||
Some are engrossed in emotional attachment to Maya and pride.
They are self-conceited and egotistical.

verses.original: ਜਮਕਾਲੈ ਕੀ ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: jamakaalai kee khabar na paiee a(n)t giaa pachhutaidhaa ||15||
verses.translation: They never think about the Messenger of Death; in the end, they leave, regretting and repenting. ||15||
He alone knows the Way, who created it.
The Gurmukh, who is blessed with the Shabad, realizes Him.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੨॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaas kahai bena(n)tee sach naam chit laidhaa ||16||2||16||
verses.translation: Slave Nanak offers ths prayer; O Lord, let my consciousness be attached to the True Name. ||16||2||16||
Maaroo, Third Mehla:
From the very beginning of time, and throughout the ages, the Merciful Lord has been the Great Giver.
Through the Shabad, the Word of the Perfect Guru, He is realized.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁਨੋ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tudhuno seveh se tujheh samaaveh too aape mel milaidhaa ||1||
verses.translation: Those who serve You are immersed in You. You unite them in Union with Yourself. ||1||
You are inaccessible and unfathomable; Your limits cannot be found.
All beings and creatures seek Your Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਵਹਿ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jiau tudh bhaavai tivai chalaaveh too aape maarag paidhaa ||2||
verses.translation: As is pleases Your Will, You guide us along; You Yourself place us on the Path. ||2||
The True Lord is, and shall always be.
He Himself creates - there is no other at all.

verses.original: ਸਭਨਾ ਸਾਰ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਪਹੁਚਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sabhanaa saar kare sukhadhaataa aape rijak pahuchaidhaa ||3||
verses.translation: The Giver of peace takes care of all; He Himself sustains them. ||3||
You are inaccessible, unfathomable, invisible and infinite;
no one knows Your extent.

verses.original: ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: aapanaa aap pachhaaneh aape gurmatee aap bujhaidhaa ||4||
verses.translation: You Yourself realize Yourself. Through the Guru's Teachings, You reveal Yourself. ||4||

verses.original: ਪਾਤਾਲ ਪੁਰੀਆ ਲੋਅ ਆਕਾਰਾ ॥ ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕਰਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: paataal pureeaa loa aakaaraa || tis vich varatai hukam karaaraa ||
verses.translation: Your Almighty Command prevails throughout the nether worlds, realms and worlds of form.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਸਾਜੇ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਢਾਹੇ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: hukame saaje hukame ddaahe hukame mel milaidhaa ||5||
verses.translation: By the Hukam of Your Command, You create, and by Your Command, You destroy. By Your Command, You unite in Union. ||5||
One who realizes Your Command, praises Your Command.
You are Inaccessible, Unfathomable and Self-Sufficient.

verses.original: ਜੇਹੀ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: jehee mat dheh so hovai too aape sabadh bujhaidhaa ||6||
verses.translation: As is the understanding You give, so do I become. You Yourself reveal the Shabad. ||6||
Night and day, the days of our lives wear away.
Night and day both bear witness to this loss.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅੰਧੁ ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ਮੂੜਾ ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਰੂਆਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: manmukh a(n)dh na chetai mooRaa sir uoopar kaal rooaaidhaa ||7||
verses.translation: The blind, foolish, self-willed manmukh is not aware of this; death is hovering over his head. ||7||

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: man tan seetal gur charanee laagaa ||
verses.translation: The mind and body are cooled and soothed, holding tight to the Guru's Feet.
Doubt is eliminated from within, and fear runs away.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਸਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਬੋਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: sadhaa ana(n)dh sache gun gaaveh sach baanee bolaidhaa ||8||
verses.translation: One is in bliss forever, singing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord, and speaking the True Word of His Bani. ||8||
One who knows You as the Architect of Karma,
has the good fortune of perfect destiny, and recognizes the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਜਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: jat pat sach sachaa sach soiee haumai maar milaidhaa ||9||
verses.translation: The Lord, the Truest of the True, is his social class and honor. Conquering his ego, he is united with the Lord. ||9||
The stubborn and insensitive mind is attached to the love of duality.
Deluded by doubt, the unfortunate wander around in confusion.

verses.original: ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: karam hovai taa satigur seve sahaje hee sukh paidhaa ||10||
verses.translation: But if they are blessed by God's Grace, they serve the True Guru, and easily obtain peace. ||10||
He Himself created the 8.4 million species of beings.
Only in this human life, is devotional worship to the Guru implanted within.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: bin bhagatee bisaTaa vich vaasaa bisaTaa vich fir paidhaa ||11||
verses.translation: Without devotion, one lives in manure; he falls into manure again and again. ||11||
If one is blessed with His Grace, devotional worship to the Guru is implanted within.
Without God's Grace, how can anyone find Him?

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: aape kare karaae karataa jiau bhaavai tivai chalaidhaa ||12||
verses.translation: The Creator Himself acts, and inspires all to act; as He wills, he leads us on. ||12||
The Simritees and the Shaastras do not know His limits.
The blind fool does not recognize the essence of reality.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: aape kare karaae karataa aape bharam bhulaidhaa ||13||
verses.translation: The Creator Himself acts, and inspires all to act; He Himself deludes with doubt. ||13||
He Himself causes everything to be done.
He Himself joins each and every person to his tasks.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: aape thaap uthaape vekhai gurmukh aap bujhaidhaa ||14||
verses.translation: He Himself establishes and disestablishes, and watches over all; He reveals Himself to the Gurmukh. ||14||
The True Lord and Master is profoundly deep and unfathomable.
Praising Him forever, the mind is comforted and consoled.

verses.original: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: agam agochar keemat nahee paiee gurmukh ma(n)n vasaidhaa ||15||
verses.translation: He is inaccessible and unfathomable; His value cannot be estimated. He dwells in the mind of the Gurmukh. ||15||
He Himself is detached; all others are entangled in their affairs.
By Guru's Grace, one comes to understand Him.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੩॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: naanak naam vasai ghaT a(n)tar gurmatee mel milaidhaa ||16||3||17||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, comes to dwell deep within the heart; through the Guru's Teachings, one is united in His Union. ||16||3||17||
Maaroo, Third Mehla:
For thirty-six ages, utter darkness prevailed.
Only You Yourself know this, O Creator Lord.

verses.original: ਹੋਰ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਕਿ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: hor kiaa ko kahai k aakh vakhaanai too aape keemat paidhaa ||1||
verses.translation: What can anyone else say? What can anyone explain? Only You Yourself can estimate Your worth. ||1||
The One Universal Creator created the entire Universe.
All the plays and dramas are to Your glory and greatness.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਵੇਕ ਕਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਆਪੇ ਭੰਨਿ ਘੜਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aape vek kare sabh saachaa aape bha(n)n ghaRaidhaa ||2||
verses.translation: The True Lord Himself makes all distinctions; He Himself breaks and builds. ||2||
The Juggler has staged His juggling show.
Through the Perfect Guru, one comes to behold it.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਰਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sadhaa alipat rahai gur sabadhee saache siau chit laidhaa ||3||
verses.translation: One who remains forever detached in the Word of the Guru's Shabad - his consciousness is attuned to the True Lord. ||3||
The musical instruments of the body vibrate and resound.
The Player Himself plays them.

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪਉਣੁ ਵਹੈ ਇਕ ਰੰਗੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਵਣੈ ਸਭ ਵਜਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT paun vahai ik ra(n)gee mil pavanai sabh vajaidhaa ||4||
verses.translation: The breath flows equally through the hearts of each and every being. Receiving the breath, all the instruments sing. ||4||
Whatever the Creator does, surely comes to pass.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, egotism is consumed.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਨਾਮੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee kisai dhe vaddiaaiee naamo naam dhiaaidhaa ||5||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, some are blessed with glorious greatness; they meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||5||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਲਾਹਾ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: gur seve jevadd hor laahaa naahee ||
verses.translation: There is no other profit as great as service to the Guru.
The Naam abides within my mind, and I praise the Naam.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਨਾਮੋ ਲਾਹਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: naamo naam sadhaa sukhadhaataa naamo laahaa paidhaa ||6||
verses.translation: The Naam is forever the Giver of peace. Through the Naam, we earn the profit. ||6||
Without the Name, all the world suffers in misery.
The more actions one does, the more the corruption increases.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਕਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: naam na seveh kiau sukh paieeaai bin naavai dhukh paidhaa ||7||
verses.translation: Without serving the Naam, how can anyone find peace? Without the Naam, one suffers in pain. ||7||
He Himself acts, and inspires all to act.
By Guru's Grace, He reveals Himself to a few.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋੜਹਿ ਮੁਕਤੀ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: gurmukh hoveh se ba(n)dhan toReh mukatee kai ghar paidhaa ||8||
verses.translation: One who becomes Gurmukh breaks his bonds, and attains the home of liberation. ||8||
One who calculates his accounts, burns in the world.
His skepticism and corruption are never dispelled.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਗਣਤ ਚੁਕਾਏ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: gurmukh hovai su ganat chukaae sache sach samaidhaa ||9||
verses.translation: One who becomes Gurmukh abandons his calculations; through Truth, we merge in the True Lord. ||9||

verses.original: ਜੇ ਸਚੁ ਦੇਇ ਤ ਪਾਏ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: je sach dhei ta paae koiee ||
verses.translation: If God grants Truth, then we may attain it.
By Guru's Grace, it is revealed.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: sach naam saalaahe ra(n)g raataa gur kirapaa te sukh paidhaa ||10||
verses.translation: One who praises the True Name, and remains imbued with the Lord's Love, by Guru's Grace, finds peace. ||10||
The Beloved Naam, the Name of the Lord, is chanting, meditation, penance and self-control.
God, the Destroyer, destroys sins.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: har kai naam tan man seetal hoaa sahaje sahaj samaidhaa ||11||
verses.translation: Through the Name of the Lord, the body and mind are cooled and soothed, and one is intuitively, easily absorbed into the Celestial Lord. ||11||

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਮਨਿ ਮੈਲੈ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar lobh man mailai mal laae ||
verses.translation: With greed within them, their minds are filthy, and they spread filth around.
They do filthy deeds, and suffer in pain.

verses.original: ਕੂੜੋ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਰੇ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: kooRo kooR kare vaapaaraa kooR bol dhukh paidhaa ||12||
verses.translation: They deal in falsehood, and nothing but falsehood; telling lies, they suffer in pain. ||12||
Rare is that person who enshrines the Immaculate Bani of the Guru's Word within his mind.
By Guru's Grace, his skepticism is removed.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਚਲੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੇਤਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: gur kai bhaanai chalai dhin raatee naam chet sukh paidhaa ||13||
verses.translation: He walks in harmony with the Guru's Will, day and night; remembering the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he finds peace. ||13||
The True Lord Himself is the Creator.
He Himself creates and destroys.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਹੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: gurmukh hovai su sadhaa salaahe mil saache sukh paidhaa ||14||
verses.translation: One who becomes Gurmukh, praises the Lord forever. Meeting the True Lord, he finds peace. ||14||

verses.original: ਅਨੇਕ ਜਤਨ ਕਰੇ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਵਸਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: anek jatan kare i(n)dhree vas na hoiee ||
verses.translation: Making countless efforts, sexual desire is not overcome.
Everyone is burning in the fires of sexuality and anger.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਮਨੁ ਵਸਿ ਆਵੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਰੇ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: satigur seve man vas aavai man maare maneh samaidhaa ||15||
verses.translation: Serving the True Guru, one brings his mind under control; conquering his mind, he merges in the Mind of God. ||15||
You Yourself created the sense of 'mine' and 'yours.'

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਜੰਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਜੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: sabh tere ja(n)t tere sabh jeeaa ||
verses.translation: All creatures are Yours; You created all beings.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਸਦਾ ਤੂ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੪॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: naanak naam samaal sadhaa too gurmatee ma(n)n vasaidhaa ||16||4||18||
verses.translation: O Nanak, contemplate the Naam forever; through the Guru's Teachings, the Lord abides in the mind. ||16||4||18||
Maaroo, Third Mehla:
The Dear Lord is the Giver, inaccessible and unfathomable.
He does not have even an iota of greed; He is self-sufficient.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਅਪੜਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਈ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tis no apaR na sakai koiee aape mel milaidhaa ||1||
verses.translation: No one can reach up to Him; He Himself unites in His Union. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਨਿਹਚਉ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jo kichh karai su nihachau hoiee ||
verses.translation: Whatever He does, surely comes to pass.
