verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: tis bin dhaataa avar na koiee ||
verses.translation: There is no other Giver, except for Him.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਮੇਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jis no naam dhaan kare so paae gur sabadhee melaidhaa ||2||
verses.translation: Whoever the Lord blesses with His gift, obtains it. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He unites him with Himself. ||2||
The fourteen worlds are Your markets.
The True Guru reveals them, along with one's inner being.

verses.original: ਨਾਵੈ ਕਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਕੋ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naavai kaa vaapaaree hovai gur sabadhee ko paidhaa ||3||
verses.translation: One who deals in the Name, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, obtains it. ||3||
Serving the True Guru, one obtains intuitive bliss.
The Lord of the Universe comes to dwell within the heart.

verses.original: ਸਹਜੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਆਪੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: sahaje bhagat kare dhin raatee aape bhagat karaidhaa ||4||
verses.translation: He intuitively practices devotional worship day and night; God Himself practices devotional worship. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਤਿਨੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: satigur te vichhuRe tinee dhukh paiaa ||
verses.translation: Those who are separated from the True Guru, suffer in misery.
Night and day, they are punished, and they suffer in total agony.

verses.original: ਮਥੇ ਕਾਲੇ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਦੁਖ ਹੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: mathe kaale mahal na paaveh dhukh hee vich dhukh paidhaa ||5||
verses.translation: Their faces are blackened, and they do not obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. They suffer in sorrow and agony. ||5||
Those who serve the True Guru are very fortunate.
They intuitively enshrine love for the True Lord.

verses.original: ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਚੈ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: sacho sach kamaaveh sadh hee sachai mel milaidhaa ||6||
verses.translation: They practice Truth, forever Truth; they are united in Union with the True Lord. ||6||

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਚਾ ਦੇਇ ਸੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jis no sachaa dhei su paae ||
verses.translation: He alone obtains the Truth, unto whom the True Lord gives it.
His inner being is filled with Truth, and his doubt is dispelled.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਸਚੈ ਕਾ ਆਪੇ ਦਾਤਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: sach sachai kaa aape dhaataa jis dhevai so sach paidhaa ||7||
verses.translation: The True Lord Himself is the Giver of Truth; he alone obtains the Truth, unto whom He gives it. ||7||
He Himself is the Creator of all.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jis no aap bujhaae boojhai koiee ||
verses.translation: Only one whom He instructs, understands Him.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: aape bakhase dhe vaddiaaiee aape mel milaidhaa ||8||
verses.translation: He Himself forgives, and grants glorious greatness. He himself unites in His Union. ||8||
Acting egotistically, one loses his life.
Even in the world hereafter, emotioal attachment to Maya does not leave him.

verses.original: ਅਗੈ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਲੇਖਾ ਲੇਵੈ ਜਿਉ ਤਿਲ ਘਾਣੀ ਪੀੜਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: agai jamakaal lekhaa levai jiau til ghaanee peeRaidhaa ||9||
verses.translation: In the world hereafter, the Messenger of Death calls him to account, and crushes him like sesame seeds in the oil-press. ||9||
By perfect destiny, one serves the Guru.
If God grants His Grace, then one serves.

verses.original: ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਮਹਲਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: jamakaal tis neR na aavai mahal sachai sukh paidhaa ||10||
verses.translation: The Messenger of Death cannot even approach him, and in the Mansion of the True Lord's Presence, he finds peace. ||10||

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: tin sukh paiaa jo tudh bhaae ||
verses.translation: They alone find peace, who are pleasing to Your Will.
By perfect destiny, they are attached to the Guru's service.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੈ ਹਥਿ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: terai hath hai sabh vaddiaaiee jis dheveh so paidhaa ||11||
verses.translation: All glorious greatness rests in Your Hands; he alone obtains it, unto whom You give it. ||11||
Through the Guru, one's inner being is enlightened and illumined.
The wealth of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, comes to dwell in the mind.

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨ ਰਤਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਗਵਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: giaan ratan sadhaa ghaT chaanan agiaan a(n)dher gavaidhaa ||12||
verses.translation: The jewel of spiritual wisdom ever illumines the heart, and the darkness of spiritual ignorance is dispelled. ||12||
The blind and ignorant are attached to duality.
The unfortunates are drowned without water, and die.

verses.original: ਚਲਦਿਆ ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਬਾਧਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: chaladhiaa ghar dhar nadhar na aavai jam dhar baadhaa dhukh paidhaa ||13||
verses.translation: When they depart from the world, they do not find the Lord's door and home; bound and gagged at Death's door, they suffer in pain. ||13||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: bin satigur seve mukat na hoiee ||
verses.translation: Without serving the True Guru, no one finds liberation.
Go ask any spiritual teacher or meditator.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: satigur seve tis milai vaddiaaiee dhar sachai sobhaa paidhaa ||14||
verses.translation: Whoever serves the True Guru is blessed with glorious greatness, and honored in the Court of the True Lord. ||14||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨੋ ਸੇਵੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: satigur no seve tis aap milaae ||
verses.translation: One who serves the True Guru, the Lord merges into Himself.
Cutting away attachment, one lovingly focuses on the True Lord.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਵਣਜਹਿ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਨਾਮੋ ਲਾਹਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sach vanajeh vaapaaree naamo laahaa paidhaa ||15||
verses.translation: The merchants deal forever in Truth; they earn the profit of the Naam. ||15||
The Creator Himself acts, and inspires all to act.
He alone is liberated, who dies in the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੫॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: naanak naam vasai man a(n)tar naamo naam dhiaaidhaa ||16||5||19||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Naam dwells deep within the mind; meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||16||5||19||
Maaroo, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੋ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jo tudh karanaa so kar paiaa ||
verses.translation: Whatever You do, is done.
How rare are those who walk in harmony with the Lord's Will.

verses.original: ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨੇ ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਭਾਣੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bhaanaa ma(n)ne so sukh paae bhaane vich sukh paidhaa ||1||
verses.translation: One who surrenders to the Lord's Will finds peace; he finds peace in the Lord's Will. ||1||
Your Will is pleasing to the Gurmukh.
Practicing Truth, he intuitively finds peace.

verses.original: ਭਾਣੇ ਨੋ ਲੋਚੈ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਆਪਿ ਮਨਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bhaane no lochai bahuteree aapanaa bhaanaa aap manaidhaa ||2||
verses.translation: Many long to walk in harmony with the Lord's Will; He Himself inspires us to surrender to His Will. ||2||

verses.original: ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨੇ ਸੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: teraa bhaanaa ma(n)ne su milai tudh aae ||
verses.translation: One who surrenders to Your Will, meets with You, Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jis bhaanaa bhaavai so tujheh samaae ||
verses.translation: One who is pleased with Your Will is immersed in You.

verses.original: ਭਾਣੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਭਾਣਾ ਕਿਸਹਿ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bhaane vich vaddee vaddiaaiee bhaanaa kiseh karaidhaa ||3||
verses.translation: Glorious greatness rests in God's Will; rare are those who accept it. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jaa tis bhaavai taa guroo milaae ||
verses.translation: When it pleases His Will, He leads us to meet the Guru.
The Gurmukh finds the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪਣੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਭਾਣਾ ਦੇਹਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: tudh aapanai bhaanai sabh sirasaT upaiee jis no bhaanaa dheh tis bhaidhaa ||4||
verses.translation: By Your Will, You created the whole Universe; those whom You bless with Your favor are pleased with Your Will. ||4||
The blind, self-willed manmukhs practice cleverness.

verses.original: ਭਾਣਾ ਨ ਮੰਨੇ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: bhaanaa na ma(n)ne bahut dhukh paiee ||
verses.translation: They do not surrender to the Lord's Will, and suffer terrible pain.

verses.original: ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲਾ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਏ ਘਰੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: bharame bhoolaa aavai jaae ghar mahal na kabahoo paidhaa ||5||
verses.translation: Deluded by doubt, they come and go in reincarnation; they never find the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||5||
The True Guru brings Union, and grants glorious greatness.
The Primal Lord ordained service to the True Guru.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: satigur seve taa naam paae naame hee sukh paidhaa ||6||
verses.translation: Serving the True Guru, the Naam is obtained. Through the Naam, one finds peace. ||6||
Everything wells up from the Naam, and through the Naam, perishes.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur kirapaa te man tan bheejai ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, the mind and body are pleased with the Naam.

verses.original: ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਰਸਿ ਭੀਜੈ ਰਸ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: rasanaa naam dhiaae ras bheejai ras hee te ras paidhaa ||7||
verses.translation: Meditating on the Naam, the tongue is drenched with the Lord's sublime essence. Through this essence, the Essence is obtained. ||7||
Rare are those who find the Mansion of the Lord's Presence within the mansion of their own body.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh sach chit laae ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they lovingly focus their consciousness on the True Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਚੁ ਦੇਇ ਸੋਈ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਏ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: jis no sach dhei soiee sach paae sache sach milaidhaa ||8||
verses.translation: Whoever the Lord blesses with Truth obtains Truth; he merges in Truth, and only Truth. ||8||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: naam visaar man tan dhukh paiaa ||
verses.translation: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mind and body suffer in pain.
Attached to the love of Maya, he earns nothing but disease.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹੈ ਕੁਸਟੀ ਨਰਕੇ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: bin naavai man tan hai kusaTee narake vaasaa paidhaa ||9||
verses.translation: Without the Name, his mind and body are afflicted with leprosy, and he obtains his home in hell. ||9||
Those who are imbued with the Naam - their bodies are immaculate and pure.
Their soul-swan is immaculate, and in the Lord's Love, they find eternal peace.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: naam salaeh sadhaa sukh paiaa nij ghar vaasaa paidhaa ||10||
verses.translation: Praising the Naam, they find eternal peace, and dwell in the home of their own inner being. ||10||
Everyone deals and trades.
Without the Name, all the world loses.

verses.original: ਨਾਗੋ ਆਇਆ ਨਾਗੋ ਜਾਸੀ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: naago aaiaa naago jaasee vin naavai dhukh paidhaa ||11||
verses.translation: Naked they come, and naked they go; without the Name, they suffer in pain. ||11||

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jis no naam dhei so paae ||
verses.translation: He alone obtains the Naam, unto whom the Lord gives it.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh har ma(n)n vasaae ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord comes to dwell in the mind.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: gur kirapaa te naam vasiaa ghaT a(n)tar naamo naam dhiaaidhaa ||12||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, the Naam dwells deep within the heart, and one meditates upon the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||12||

verses.original: ਨਾਵੈ ਨੋ ਲੋਚੈ ਜੇਤੀ ਸਭ ਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: naavai no lochai jetee sabh aaiee ||
verses.translation: Everyone who comes into the world, longs for the Name.

verses.original: ਨਾਉ ਤਿਨਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਕਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: naau tinaa milai dhur purab kamaiee ||
verses.translation: They alone are blessed with the Name, whose past actions were so ordained by the Primal Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: jinee naau paiaa se vaddabhaagee gur kai sabadh milaidhaa ||13||
verses.translation: Those who obtain the Name are very fortunate. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they are united with God. ||13||
Utterly incomparable is the fortress of the body.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਬਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: tis vich beh prabh kare veechaaraa ||
verses.translation: Within it, God sits in contemplation.

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਨਿਆਉ ਸਚੋ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: sachaa niaau sacho vaapaaraa nihachal vaasaa paidhaa ||14||
verses.translation: He administers true justice, and trades in Truth; through Him, one finds the eternal, unchanging dwelling. ||14||
Deep within the inner self are glorious homes and beautiful places.
But rare is that person who, as Gurmukh, finds these places.

verses.original: ਇਤੁ ਸਾਥਿ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ਸਚੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਚਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: eit saath nibahai saalaahe sache har sachaa ma(n)n vasaidhaa ||15||
verses.translation: If one stays in these places, and praises the True Lord, the True Lord comes to dwell in the mind. ||15||
My Creator Lord has formed this formation.

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਦੇਹੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਭ ਵਥੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: eis dhehee vich sabh vath paiee ||
verses.translation: He has placed everything within this body.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਣਜਹਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੬॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: naanak naam vanajeh ra(n)g raate gurmukh ko naam paidhaa ||16||6||20||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who deal in the Naam are imbued with His Love. The Gurmukh obtains the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||16||6||20||
Maaroo, Third Mehla:
Contemplating the Word of the Shabad, the body becomes golden.

verses.original: ਤਿਥੈ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: tithai har vasai jis dhaa a(n)t na paaraavaaraa ||
verses.translation: The Lord abides there; He has no end or limitation.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਹੁ ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: anadhin har sevih sachee baanee har jeeau sabadh milaidhaa ||1||
verses.translation: Night and day, serve the Lord, and chant the True Word of the Guru's Bani. Through the Shabad, meet the Dear Lord. ||1||
I am a sacrifice to those who remember the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਤਿਨ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh tin mel milaau ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I unite in Union with the Lord.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਲਾਈ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਬਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tin kee dhoor laiee mukh masatak satasa(n)gat beh gun gaidhaa ||2||
verses.translation: I touch the dust of their feet to my face and forehead; sitting in the Society of the Saints, I sing His Glorious Praises. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: har ke gun gaavaa je har prabh bhaavaa ||
verses.translation: I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, as I am pleasing to the Lord God.
With the Lord's Name deep within my inner being, I am adorned with the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਡੀ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gurbaanee chahu ku(n)ddee suneeaai saachai naam samaidhaa ||3||
verses.translation: The Word of the Guru's Bani is heard throughout the four corners of the world; through it, we merge in the True Name. ||3||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਜਿ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਭਾਲੇ ॥ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: so jan saachaa j a(n)tar bhaale || gur kai sabadh har nadhar nihaale ||
verses.translation: That humble being, who searches within himself, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, sees the Lord with his eyes.

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਨਦਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: giaan a(n)jan paae gur sabadhee nadharee nadhar milaidhaa ||4||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Shabad, he applies the ointment of spiritual wisdom to his eyes; the Gracious Lord, in His Grace, unites him with Himself. ||4||
By great good fortune, I obtained this body;
in this human life, I have focused my consciousness on the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਸਭੁ ਅੰਧ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਿਸਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: bin sabadhai sabh a(n)dh a(n)dheraa gurmukh kiseh bujhaidhaa ||5||
verses.translation: Without the Shabad, everything is enveloped in utter darkness; only the Gurmukh understands. ||5||
Some merely waste away their lives - why have they even come into the world?
The self-willed manmukhs are attached to the love of duality.

verses.original: ਏਹ ਵੇਲਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਹਾਥਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਪਗਿ ਖਿਸਿਐ ਪਛੁਤਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: eh velaa fir haath na aavai pag khisiaai pachhutaidhaa ||6||
verses.translation: This opportunity shall not into their hands again; their foot slips, and they come to regret and repent. ||6||
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the body is sanctified.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਚੁ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: tis vich vasai sach gunee gaheeraa ||
verses.translation: The True Lord, the ocean of virtue, dwells within it.

verses.original: ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: sacho sach vekhai sabh thaiee sach sun ma(n)n vasaidhaa ||7||
verses.translation: One who sees the Truest of the True everywhere, hears the Truth, and enshrines it within his mind. ||7||
Egotism and mental calculations are relieved through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਖਹੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: har jeeau hiradhai rakhahu ur dhaare ||
verses.translation: Keep the Dear Lord close, and enshrine Him in your heart.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh sadhaa saalaahe mil saache sukh paidhaa ||8||
verses.translation: One who praises the Lord forever, through the Guru's Shabad, meets with the True Lord, and finds peace. ||8||
He alone remembers the Lord, whom the Lord inspires to remember.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh vasai man aae ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He comes to dwell in the mind.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਆਪੇ ਬੂਝੈ ਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: aape vekhai aape boojhai aapai aap samaidhaa ||9||
verses.translation: He Himself sees, and He Himself understands; He merges all into Himself. ||9||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਮਨ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਥੁ ਪਾਈ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: jin man vich vath paiee soiee jaanai ||
verses.translation: He alone knows, who has placed the object within his mind.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he comes to understand himself.

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: aap pachhaanai soiee jan niramal baanee sabadh sunaidhaa ||10||
verses.translation: That humble being who understands himself is immaculate. He proclaims the Guru's Bani, and the Word of the Shabad. ||10||
This body is sanctified and purified;
through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, it contemplates the Lord, the ocean of virtue.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: anadhin gun gaavai ra(n)g raataa gun keh gunee samaidhaa ||11||
verses.translation: One who chants the Glorious Praises of the Lord night and day, and remains attuned to His Love, chants His Glorious Virtues, immersed in the Glorious Lord. ||11||

verses.original: ਏਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਸਭ ਮੂਲੁ ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: eh sareer sabh mool hai maiaa ||
verses.translation: This body is the source of all Maya;
in love with duality, it is deluded by doubt.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: har na chetai sadhaa dhukh paae bin har chete dhukh paidhaa ||12||
verses.translation: It does not remember the Lord, and suffers in eternal pain. Without remembering the Lord, it suffers in pain. ||12||
One who serves the True Guru is approved and respected.

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਹੰਸੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: kaiaa ha(n)s niramal dhar sachai jaan ||
verses.translation: His body and soul-swan are immaculate and pure; in the Court of the Lord, he is known to be true.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵੇ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ਸੋਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: har seve har ma(n)n vasaae sohai har gun gaidhaa ||13||
verses.translation: He serves the Lord, and enshrines the Lord in his mind; he is exalted, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||13||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bin bhaagaa gur seviaa na jai ||
verses.translation: Without good destiny, no one can serve the True Guru.
The self-willed manmukhs are deluded, and die weeping and wailing.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੇਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: jin kau nadhar hovai gur keree har jeeau aap milaidhaa ||14||
verses.translation: Those who are blessed by the Guru's Glance of Grace - the Dear Lord unites them with Himself. ||14||
In the body fortress, are the solidly-constructed markets.
The Gurmukh purchases the object, and takes care of it.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਊਤਮ ਪਦਵੀ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam dhiaai dhin raatee uootam padhavee paidhaa ||15||
verses.translation: Meditating on the Name of the Lord, day and night, he attains the sublime, exalted status. ||15||
The True Lord Himself is the Giver of peace.
Through the Shabad of the Perfect Guru, He is realized.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਕੋ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੭॥੨੧॥
verses.translit: naanak naam salaahe saachaa poorai bhaag ko paidhaa ||16||7||21||
verses.translation: Nanak praises the Naam, the True Name of the Lord; through perfect destiny, He is found. ||16||7||21||
Maaroo, Third Mehla:
The Formless Lord created the universe of form.
By the Hukam of His Command, He created attachment to Maya.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਖੇਲ ਕਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aape khel kare sabh karataa sun saachaa ma(n)n vasaidhaa ||1||
verses.translation: The Creator Himself stages all the plays; hearing of the True Lord, enshrine Him in your mind. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਾਈ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਸੂਤਿ ਜਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa maiee trai gun parasoot jamaiaa ||
verses.translation: Maya, the mother, gave birth to the three gunas, the three qualities,
and proclaimed the four Vedas to Brahma.

verses.original: ਵਰ੍ਹੇ ਮਾਹ ਵਾਰ ਥਿਤੀ ਕਰਿ ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: varhe maeh vaar thitee kar is jag meh sojhee paidhaa ||2||
verses.translation: Creating the years, months, days and dates, He infused intelligence into the world. ||2||
Service to the Guru is the most excellent action.
Enshrine the Lord's Name within your heart.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਵਰਤੀ ਜਗ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਇਸੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gurbaanee varatee jag a(n)tar is baanee te har naam paidhaa ||3||
verses.translation: The Word of the Guru's Bani prevails throughout the world; through this Bani, the Lord's Name is obtained. ||3||
He reads the Vedas, but he starts arguments night and day.
He does not remember the Naam, the Name of the Lord; he is bound and gagged by the Messenger of Death.

verses.original: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: dhoojai bhai sadhaa dhukh paae trai gun bharam bhulaidhaa ||4||
verses.translation: In the love of duality, he suffers in pain forever; he is deluded by doubt, and confused by the three gunas. ||4||
The Gurmukh is in love with the One Lord alone;
he submerges in his mind the three-phased desire.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: saachai sabadh sadhaa hai mukataa maiaa moh chukaidhaa ||5||
verses.translation: Through the True Word of the Shabad, he is liberated forever; he renounces emotional attachment to Maya. ||5||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸੇ ਹੁਣਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: jo dhur raate se hun raate ||
verses.translation: Those who are so pre-ordained to be imbued, are imbued with love for the Lord.
By Guru's Grace, they are intuitively intoxicated.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: satigur sev sadhaa prabh paiaa aapai aap milaidhaa ||6||
verses.translation: Serving the True Guru forever, they find God; He Himself unites them with Himself. ||6||
In attachment to Maya and doubt, the Lord is not found.
Attached to the love of duality, one suffers in pain.

verses.original: ਸੂਹਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਦਿਨ ਥੋੜੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਇਸੁ ਜਾਦੇ ਬਿਲਮ ਨ ਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: soohaa ra(n)g dhin thoRe hovai is jaadhe bilam na laidhaa ||7||
verses.translation: The crimson color lasts for only a few days; all too soon, it fades away. ||7||
So color this mind in the Fear and the Love of God.
Dyed in this color, one merges in the True Lord.

verses.original: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਕੋ ਇਹੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: poorai bhaag ko ih ra(n)g paae gurmatee ra(n)g chaRaidhaa ||8||
verses.translation: By perfect destiny, some may obtain this color. Through the Guru's Teachings, this color is applied. ||8||
The self-willed manmukhs take great pride in themselves.

verses.original: ਦਰਗਹ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: dharageh kab hee na paavai maan ||
verses.translation: In the Court of the Lord, they are never honored.

verses.original: ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਗੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: dhoojai laage janam gavaiaa bin boojhe dhukh paidhaa ||9||
verses.translation: Attached to duality, they waste their lives; without understanding, they suffer in pain. ||9||
My God has hidden Himself deep within the self.
By Guru's Grace, one is united in the Lord's Union.

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਚਾ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: sachaa prabh sachaa vaapaaraa naam amolak paidhaa ||10||
verses.translation: God is True, and True is His trade, through which the priceless Naam is obtained. ||10||

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: eis kaiaa kee keemat kinai na paiee ||
verses.translation: No one has found this body's value.
My Lord and Master has worked His handiwork.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਸੋਧੈ ਆਪਹਿ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: gurmukh hovai su kaiaa sodhai aapeh aap milaidhaa ||11||
verses.translation: One who becomes Gurmukh purifies his body, and then the Lord unites him with Himself. ||11||

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਤੋਟਾ ਕਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਲਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaiaa vich toTaa kaiaa vich laahaa ||
verses.translation: Within the body, one loses, and within the body, one wins.
The Gurmukh seeks the self-sustaining Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਣਜਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: gurmukh vanaj sadhaa sukh paae sahaje sahaj milaidhaa ||12||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh trades, and finds peace forever; he intuitively merges in the Celestial Lord. ||12||
True is the Lord's Mansion, and True is His treasure.
The Great Giver Himself gives.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਮਨਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: gurmukh saalaahe sukhadhaate man mele keemat paidhaa ||13||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh praises the Giver of peace; his mind is united with the Lord, and he comes to know His worth. ||13||

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kaiaa vich vasat keemat nahee paiee ||
verses.translation: Within the body is the object; its value cannot be estimated.
He Himself grants glorious greatness to the Gurmukh.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਹਟੁ ਸੋਈ ਵਥੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਇ ਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: jis dhaa haT soiee vath jaanai gurmukh dhei na pachhotaidhaa ||14||
verses.translation: He alone knows this object, to whom this store belongs; the Gurmukh is blessed with it, and does not come to regret. ||14||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: har jeeau sabh meh rahiaa samaiee ||
verses.translation: The Dear Lord is pervading and permeating all.
By Guru's Grace, He is found.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਸਬਦੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: aape mel milaae aape sabadhe sahaj samaidhaa ||15||
verses.translation: He Himself unites in His Union; through the Word of the Shabad, one intuitively merges with Him. ||15||
The True Lord Himself unites us in the Word of His Shabad.
Within the Shabad, doubt is driven out.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੮॥੨੨॥
verses.translit: naanak naam milai vaddiaaiee naame hee sukh paidhaa ||16||8||22||
verses.translation: O Nanak, He blesses us with His Naam, and throgh the Naam, peace is found. ||16||8||22||
Maaroo, Third Mehla:
He is inaccessible, unfathomable and self-sustaining.
He Himself is merciful, inaccessible and unlimited.

verses.original: ਅਪੜਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਮੇਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: apaR koi na sakai tis no gur sabadhee melaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: No one can reach up to Him; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is met. ||1||
He alone serves You, who pleases You.
Through the Guru's Shabad, he merges in the True Lord.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: anadhin gun raveh dhin raatee rasanaa har ras bhaiaa ||2||
verses.translation: Night and day, he chants the Lord's Praises, day and night; his tongue savors and delights in the sublime essence of the Lord. ||2||
Those who die in the Shabad - their death is exalted and glorified.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: har ke gun hiradhai ur dhaareh ||
verses.translation: They enshrine the Lord's Glories in their hearts.

verses.original: ਜਨਮੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੇ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: janam safal har charanee laage dhoojaa bhaau chukaiaa ||3||
verses.translation: Holding tight to the Guru's feet, their lives becomes prosperous, and they are rid of the love of duality. ||3||
The Dear Lord unites them in Union with Himself.
Through the Guru's Shabad, self-conceit is dispelled.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਾਤੇ ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: anadhin sadhaa har bhagatee raate is jag meh laahaa paiaa ||4||
verses.translation: Those who remain attuned to devotional worship to the Lord, night and day, earn the profit in this world. ||4||

verses.original: ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਾ ਮੈ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: tere gun kahaa mai kahan na jaiee ||
verses.translation: What Glorious Virtues of Yours should I describe? I cannot describe them.

verses.original: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)t na paaraa keemat nahee paiee ||
verses.translation: You have no end or limitation. Your value cannot be estimated.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: aape dhiaa kare sukhadhaataa gun meh gunee samaiaa ||5||
verses.translation: When the Giver of peace Himself bestows His Mercy, the virtuous are absorbed in virtue. ||5||

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਮੋਹੁ ਹੈ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: eis jag meh moh hai paasaaraa ||
verses.translation: In this world, emotional attachment is spread all over.
The ignorant, self-willed manmukh is immersed in utter darkness.

verses.original: ਧੰਧੈ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: dha(n)dhai dhaavat janam gavaiaa bin naavai dhukh paiaa ||6||
verses.translation: Chasing after worldly affairs, he wastes away his life in vain; without the Name, he suffers in pain. ||6||
If God grants His Grace, then one finds the True Guru.
Through the Shabad, the filth of egotism is burned away.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: man niramal giaan ratan chaanan agiaan a(n)dher gavaiaa ||7||
verses.translation: The mind becomes immaculate, and the jewel of spiritual wisdom brings enlightenment; the darkness of spiritual ignorance is dispelled. ||7||

verses.original: ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਅਨੇਕ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: tere naam anek keemat nahee paiee ||
verses.translation: Your Names are countless; Your value cannot be estimated.
I enshrine the Lord's True Name within my heart.

verses.original: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਉਣੁ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: keemat kaun kare prabh teree too aape sahaj samaiaa ||8||
verses.translation: Who can estimate Your value, God? You are immersed and absorbed in Yourself. ||8||
The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is priceless, inaccessible and infinite.
No one can weigh it.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਤੋਲੇ ਤੋਲਿ ਤੋਲਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਮੇਲਿ ਤੋਲਾਇਆ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: aape tole tol tolaae gur sabadhee mel tolaiaa ||9||
verses.translation: You Yourself weigh, and estimate all; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, You unite, when the weight is perfect. ||9||
Your servant serves, and offers this prayer.
Please, let me sit near You, and unite me with Yourself.

verses.original: ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: sabhanaa jeeaa kaa sukhadhaataa poorai karam dhiaaiaa ||10||
verses.translation: You are the Giver of peace to all beings; by perfect karma, we meditate on You. ||10||

verses.original: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਜਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jat sat sa(n)jam j sach kamaavai ||
verses.translation: Chastity, truth and self-control come by practicing and living the Truth.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: eih man niramal j har gun gaavai ||
verses.translation: This mind becomes immaculate and pure, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: eis bikh meh a(n)mrit paraapat hovai har jeeau mere bhaiaa ||11||
verses.translation: In this world of poison, the Ambrosial Nectar is obtained, if it pleases my Dear Lord. ||11||
He alone understands, whom God inspires to understand.
Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, one's inner being is awakened.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਏ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: haumai meraa Thaak rahaae sahaje hee sach paiaa ||12||
verses.translation: Egotism and possessiveness are silenced and subdued, and one intuitively finds the True Lord. ||12||
Without good karma, countless others wander around.

verses.original: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਚੁਕੈ ਨ ਫੇਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: mar mar ja(n)mai chukai na feree ||
verses.translation: They die, and die again, only to be reborn; they cannot escape the cycle of reincarnation.

verses.original: ਬਿਖੁ ਕਾ ਰਾਤਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: bikh kaa raataa bikh kamaavai sukh na kabahoo paiaa ||13||
verses.translation: Imbued with poison, they practice poison and corruption, and they never find peace. ||13||
Many disguise themselves with religious robes.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: bin sabadhai haumai kinai na maaree ||
verses.translation: Without the Shabad, no one has conquered egotism.

verses.original: ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: jeevat marai taa mukat paae sachai nai samaiaa ||14||
verses.translation: One who remains dead while yet alive is liberated, and merges in the True Name. ||14||
Spiritual ignorance and desire burn this human body.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: tis dhee boojhai j gur sabadh kamaae ||
verses.translation: He alone puts out this fire, who practices and lives the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: tan man seetal karodh nivaare haumai maar samaiaa ||15||
verses.translation: His body and mind are cooled and soothed, and his anger is silenced; conquering egotism, he merges in the Lord. ||15||
True is the Lord and Master, and True is His glorious greatness.
By Guru's Grace, a rare few attain this.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਏਕ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧੬॥੧॥੨੩॥
verses.translit: naanak ek kahai bena(n)tee naame naam samaiaa ||16||1||23||
verses.translation: Nanak offers this one prayer: through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, may I merge in the Lord. ||16||1||23||
Maaroo, Third Mehla:
By Your Grace, please unite with Your devotees.
Your devotees ever praise You, lovingly focusing on You.

verses.original: ਤਉ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਉਬਰਹਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tau saranaiee ubareh karate aape mel milaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: In Your Sanctuary, they are saved, O Creator Lord; You unite them in Union with Yourself. ||1||
Sublime and exalted is devotion to the Perfect Word of the Shabad.
Peace prevails within; they are pleasing to Your Mind.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਾਤਾ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: man tan sachee bhagatee raataa sache siau chit laiaa ||2||
verses.translation: One whose mind and body are imbued with true devotion, focuses his consciousness on the True Lord. ||2||
In egotism, the body is forever burning.
When God grants His Grace, one meets the Perfect Guru.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar agiaan sabadh bujhaae satigur te sukh paiaa ||3||
verses.translation: The Shabad dispels the spiritual ignorance within, and through the True Guru, one finds peace. ||3||
The blind, self-willed manmukh acts blindly.
He is in terrible trouble, and wanders in reincarnation.

verses.original: ਜਮ ਕਾ ਜੇਵੜਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਕਾਟੈ ਅੰਤੇ ਬਹੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: jam kaa jevaRaa kadhe na kaaTai a(n)te bahu dhukh paiaa ||4||
verses.translation: He can never snap the noose of Death, and in the end, he suffers in horrible pain. ||4||
Through the Shabad, one's comings and goings in reincarnation are ended.
He keeps the True Name enshrined within his heart.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh marai man maare haumai jai samaiaa ||5||
verses.translation: He dies in the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and conquers his mind; stilling his egotism, he merges in the Lord. ||5||
Coming and going, the people of the world are wasting away.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਥਿਰੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: bin satigur thir koi na hoiee ||
verses.translation: Without the True Guru, no one finds permanence and stability.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar jot sabadh sukh vasiaa jotee jot milaiaa ||6||
verses.translation: The Shabad shines its Light deep within the self, and one dwells in peace; one's light merges into the Light. ||6||
The five demons think of evil and corruption.
The expanse is the manifestation of emotional attachment to Maya.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਤਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਵਸਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: satigur seve taa mukat hovai pa(n)ch dhoot vas aaiaa ||7||
verses.translation: Serving the True Guru, one is liberated, and the five demons are put under his control. ||7||
Without the Guru, there is only the darkness of attachment.
Over and over, time and time again, they are drowned.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਸਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: satigur bheTe sach dhiraRaae sach naam man bhaiaa ||8||
verses.translation: Meeting the True Guru, Truth is implanted within, and the True Name becomes pleasing to the mind. ||8||
True is His Door, and True is His Court, His Royal Darbaar.
The true ones serve Him, through the Beloved Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਚੀ ਧੁਨਿ ਸਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਸਚੇ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: sachee dhun sache gun gaavaa sache maeh samaiaa ||9||
verses.translation: Singing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord, in the true melody, I am immersed and absorbed in Truth. ||9||
Deep within the home of the self, one finds the home of the Lord.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one easily, intuitively finds it.

verses.original: ਓਥੈ ਸੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: othai sog vijog na viaapai sahaje sahaj samaiaa ||10||
verses.translation: There, one is not afflicted with sorrow or separation; merge into the Celestial Lord with intuitive ease. ||10||
The evil people live in the love of duality.
They wander around, totally attached and thirsty.

verses.original: ਕੁਸੰਗਤਿ ਬਹਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਦੁਖੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: kusa(n)gat baheh sadhaa dhukh paaveh dhukho dhukh kamaiaa ||11||
verses.translation: They sit in evil gatherings, and suffer in pain forever; they earn pain, nothing but pain. ||11||
Without the True Guru, there is no Sangat, no Congregation.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਪਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: bin sabadhe paar na paae koiee ||
verses.translation: Without the Shabad, no one can cross over to the other side.

verses.original: ਸਹਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: sahaje gun raveh dhin raatee jotee jot milaiaa ||12||
verses.translation: One who intuitively chants God's Glorious Praises day and night - his light merges into the Light. ||12||
The body is the tree; the bird of the soul dwells within it.
It drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar, resting in the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਉਡਹਿ ਨ ਮੂਲੇ ਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: auddeh na moole na aaveh na jaahee nij ghar vaasaa paiaa ||13||
verses.translation: It never flies away, and it does not come or go; it dwells within the home of its own self. ||13||
Purify the body, and contemplate the Shabad.
Remove the poisonous drug of emotional attachment, and eradicate doubt.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: aape kirapaa kare sukhadhaataa aape mel milaiaa ||14||
verses.translation: The Giver of peace Himself bestows His Mercy, and unites us in Union with Himself. ||14||

verses.original: ਸਦ ਹੀ ਨੇੜੈ ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: sadh hee neRai dhoor na jaanahu ||
verses.translation: He is always near at hand; He is never far away.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, realize that He is very near.

verses.original: ਬਿਗਸੈ ਕਮਲੁ ਕਿਰਣਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੈ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਾਇਆ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: bigasai kamal kiran paragaasai paragaT kar dhekhaiaa ||15||
verses.translation: Your heart-lotus shall blossom forth, and the ray of God's Divine Light shall illuminate your heart; He shall be revealed to You. ||15||
The True Lord is Himself the Creator.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਲੇ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: aape maar jeevaale avar na koiee ||
verses.translation: He Himself kills, and gives life; there is no other at all.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੬॥੨॥੨੪॥
verses.translit: naanak naam milai vaddiaaiee aap gavai sukh paiaa ||16||2||24||
verses.translation: O Nanak, through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, glorious greatness is obtained. Eradicating self-conceit, peace is found. ||16||2||24||
Maaroo, Solahas, Fourth Mehla:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
The Lord Lord Himself is the One who exalts and embellishes.
Do not consider any other work.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਵਸੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sach vasai ghaT a(n)tar sahaje sach samaiee he ||1||
verses.translation: The True Lord abides deep within the heart of the Gurmukh, who intuitively merges in the True Lord. ||1||
The True Lord dwells within the minds of all.
By Guru's Grace, they are intuitively absorbed in Him.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur gur karat sadhaa sukh paiaa gur charanee chit laiee he ||2||
verses.translation: Calling out, ""Guru, Guru"", I have found eternal peace; my consciousness is focused on the Guru's feet. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੈ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੈ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
verses.translit: satigur hai giaan satigur hai poojaa ||
verses.translation: The True Guru is spiritual wisdom; the True Guru is worship and adoration.
I serve the True Guru, and no other.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਭਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: satigur te naam ratan dhan paiaa satigur kee sevaa bhaiee he ||3||
verses.translation: From the True Guru, I have obtained the wealth, the jewel of the Naam. Service to the True Guru is pleasing to me. ||3||
Without the True Guru, those who are attached to duality
come and go, and wander in reincarnation; these unfortunate ones die.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak tin kee fir gat hovai j gurmukh raheh saranaiee he ||4||
verses.translation: O Nanak, even after they are emancipated, those who become Gurmukh remain in the Guru's Sanctuary. ||4||
The love of the Gurmukh is forever true.
I beg for the invaluable Naam, the Name of the Lord, from the Guru.

verses.original: ਹੋਹੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: hoh dhiaal kirapaa kar har jeeau rakh levahu gur saranaiee he ||5||
verses.translation: O Dear Lord, please be kind, and grant Your Grace; please keep me in the Guru's Sanctuary. ||5||
The True Guru trickles the Ambrosial Nectar into my mouth.
My Tenth Gate has been opened and revealed.

verses.original: ਤਹ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਵਜਹਿ ਧੁਨਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: teh anahadh sabadh vajeh dhun baanee sahaje sahaj samaiee he ||6||
verses.translation: The unstruck sound current of the Shabad vibrates and resounds there, with the melody of the Guru's Bani; one is easily, intuitively absorbed in the Lord. ||6||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਕਰਤੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jin kau karatai dhur likh paiee ||
verses.translation: Those who are so pre-ordained by the Creator,
pass their nights and days calling on the Guru.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੋ ਸੀਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: bin satigur ko seejhai naahee gur charanee chit laiee he ||7||
verses.translation: Without the True Guru, no one understands; focus your consciousness on the Guru's Feet. ||7||
The Lord Himself blesses those with whom He is pleased.
The Gurmukh receives the wealth of the Naam.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: aape kirapaa kare naam dhevai naanak naam samaiee he ||8||
verses.translation: When the Lord grants His Grace, He bestows the Naam; Nanak is immersed and absorbed in the Naam. ||8||
The jewel of spiritual wisdom is revealed within the mind.
The wealth of the Naam is easily, intuitively received.

verses.original: ਏਹ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: eh vaddiaaiee gur te paiee satigur kau sadh bal jaiee he ||9||
verses.translation: This glorious greatness is obtained from the Guru; I am forever a sacrifice to the True Guru. ||9||
With the rising of the sun, the darkness of the night is dispelled.
Spiritual ignorance is eradicated, by the priceless jewel of the Guru.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: satigur giaan ratan at bhaaree karam milai sukh paiee he ||10||
verses.translation: The True Guru is the fantastically valuable jewel of spiritual wisdom; blessed by God's Mercy, peace is found. ||10||
The Gurmukh obtains the Naam, and his good reputation increases.
In all four ages he is considered to be pure and good.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: naame naam rate sukh paiaa naam rahiaa liv laiee he ||11||
verses.translation: Imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he finds peace. He remains lovingly focused on the Naam. ||11||
The Gurmukh receives the Naam.
In intuitive peace he wakes, and in intuitive peace he sleeps.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: gurmukh naam samai samaavai naanak naam dhiaaiee he ||12||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh is immersed and absorbed in the Naam; Nanak meditates on the Naam. ||12||
The Ambrosial Nectar of the Guru's Bani is in the mouth of the devotees.
The Gurmukhs chant and repeat the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤ ਸਦਾ ਮਨੁ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: har har karat sadhaa man bigasai har charanee man laiee he ||13||
verses.translation: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, their minds forever blossom forth; they focus their minds on the Lord's Feet. ||13||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: ham moorakh agiaan giaan kichh naahee ||
verses.translation: I am foolish and ignorant; I have no wisdom at all.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਮਝ ਪੜੀ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: satigur te samajh paRee man maahee ||
verses.translation: From the True Guru, I have obtained understanding in my mind.

verses.original: ਹੋਹੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: hoh dhiaal kirapaa kar har jeeau satigur kee sevaa laiee he ||14||
verses.translation: O Dear Lord, please be kind to me, and grant Your Grace; let me be committed to serving the True Guru. ||14||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਏਕੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: jin satigur jaataa tin ek pachhaataa ||
verses.translation: Those who know the True Guru realize the One Lord.
The Giver of peace is all-pervading, permeating everywhere.

verses.original: ਆਤਮੁ ਚੀਨਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: aatam cheen param padh paiaa sevaa surat samaiee he ||15||
verses.translation: Understanding my own soul, I have obtained the Supreme Status; my awareness is immersed in selfless service. ||15||
Those who are blessed with glorious greatness by the Primal Lord God
are lovingly focused on the True Guru, who dwells within their minds.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੧॥
verses.translit: aap miliaa jagajeevan dhaataa naanak a(n)k samaiee he ||16||1||
verses.translation: The Giver of life to the world Himself meets them; O Nanak, they are absorbed in His Being. ||16||1||
Maaroo, Fourth Mehla:
The Lord is inaccessible and unfathomable; He is eternal and imperishable.
He dwells in the heart, and is all-pervading, permeating everywhere.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਸਰੇਵਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tis bin avar na koiee dhaataa har tiseh sarevahu praanee he ||1||
verses.translation: There is no other Giver except Him; worship the Lord, O mortals. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਰਾਖੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਣਹਾਰਾ ॥ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸਾਕਸਿ ਮਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kau raakhai har raakhanahaaraa || taa kau koi na saakas maaraa ||
verses.translation: No one can kill anyone who is saved by the Savior Lord.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਐਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਊਤਮ ਬਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: so aaisaa har sevahu sa(n)tahu jaa kee uootam baanee he ||2||
verses.translation: So serve such a Lord, O Saints, whose Bani is exalted and sublime. ||2||
When it seems that a place is empty and void,
there, the Creator Lord is permeating and pervading.

verses.original: ਸੂਕੇ ਤੇ ਫੁਨਿ ਹਰਿਆ ਕੀਤੋਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sooke te fun hariaa keeton har dhiaavahu choj viddaanee he ||3||
verses.translation: He causes the dried-up branch to blossom forth in greenery again; so meditate on the Lord - wondrous are His ways! ||3||
The One who knows the anguish of all beings
unto that Lord and Master, I am a sacrifice.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਜਨ ਕਰਿ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਜੋ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: tis aagai jan kar bena(n)tee jo sarab sukhaa kaa dhaanee he ||4||
verses.translation: Offer your prayers to the One who is the Giver of all peace and joy. ||4||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜੀਐ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: jo jeeaai kee saar na jaanai ||
verses.translation: But one who does not know the state of the soul

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਕਹੀਐ ਅਜਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: tis siau kichh na kaheeaai ajaanai ||
verses.translation: do not say anything to such an ignorant person.

verses.original: ਮੂਰਖ ਸਿਉ ਨਹ ਲੂਝੁ ਪਰਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: moorakh siau neh loojh paraanee har japeeaai padh nirabaanee he ||5||
verses.translation: Do not argue with fools, O mortals. Meditate on the Lord, in the state of Nirvaanaa. ||5||

verses.original: ਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਚਿੰਤ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਹੈ ਕਰਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: naa kar chi(n)t chi(n)taa hai karate ||
verses.translation: Don't worry - let the Creator take care of it.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਦੇਵੈ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਜੰਤਾ ਸਭਤੈ ॥
verses.translit: har dhevai jal thal ja(n)taa sabhatai ||
verses.translation: The Lord gives to all creatures in the water and on the land.

verses.original: ਅਚਿੰਤ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਥਰ ਕੀਟ ਪਖਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: achi(n)t dhaan dhei prabh meraa vich paathar keeT pakhaanee he ||6||
verses.translation: My God bestows His blessings without being asked, even to worms in soil and stones. ||6||

verses.original: ਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਆਸ ਮੀਤ ਸੁਤ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: naa kar aas meet sut bhaiee ||
verses.translation: Do not place your hopes in friends, children and siblings.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਆਸ ਕਿਸੈ ਸਾਹ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ਕੀ ਪਰਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: naa kar aas kisai saeh biauhaar kee paraiee ||
verses.translation: Do not place your hopes in kings or the business of others.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਬੇਲੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਸਾਰੰਗਪਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: bin har naavai ko belee naahee har japeeaai saara(n)gapaanee he ||7||
verses.translation: Without the Lord's Name, no one will be your helper; so meditate on the Lord, the Lord of the world. ||7||
Night and day, chant the Naam.
All your hopes and desires shall be fulfilled.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਭਵ ਖੰਡਨੁ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਹਜੇ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: jan naanak naam japahu bhav kha(n)ddan sukh sahaje rain vihaanee he ||8||
verses.translation: O servant Nanak, chant the Naam, the Name of the Destroyer of fear, and your life-night shall pass in intuitive peace and poise. ||8||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jin har seviaa tin sukh paiaa ||
verses.translation: Those who serve the Lord find peace.
They are intuitively absorbed in the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੈ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਜਾਇ ਪੂਛਹੁ ਵੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: jo saran parai tis kee pat raakhai jai poochhahu vedh puraanee he ||9||
verses.translation: The Lord preserves the honor of those who seek His Sanctuary; go and consult the Vedas and the Puraanas. ||9||

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਏ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: jis har sevaa laae soiee jan laagai ||
verses.translation: That humble being is attached to the Lord's service, whom the Lord so attaches.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਭਰਮ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh bharam bhau bhaagai ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, doubt and fear are dispelled.

verses.original: ਵਿਚੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਜਿਉ ਕਮਲੁ ਰਹੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: viche gireh sadhaa rahai udhaasee jiau kamal rahai vich paanee he ||10||
verses.translation: In his own home, he remains unattached, like the lotus flower in the water. ||10||

verses.original: ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਸੇਵਾ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: vich haumai sevaa thai na paae ||
verses.translation: One who serves in egotism is not accepted or approved.
Such a person is born, only to die again, and come and go in reincarnation.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਤਪੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਾਈ ਸੇਵਾ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: so tap pooraa saiee sevaa jo har mere man bhaanee he ||11||
verses.translation: Perfect is that penance and that service, which is pleasing to the Mind of my Lord. ||11||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਆਖਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
verses.translit: hau kiaa gun tere aakhaa suaamee ||
verses.translation: What Glorious Virtues of Yours should I chant, O my Lord and Master?
You are the Inner-knower, the Searcher of all souls.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਮਾਗਉ ਦਾਨੁ ਤੁਝੈ ਪਹਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: hau maagau dhaan tujhai peh karate har anadhin naam vakhaanee he ||12||
verses.translation: I beg for blessings from You, O Creator Lord; I repeat Your Name night and day. ||12||

verses.original: ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਜੋਰੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ਬੋਲਣ ਕਾ ॥
verses.translit: kis hee jor aha(n)kaar bolan kaa ||
verses.translation: Some speak in egotistical power.

verses.original: ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਜੋਰੁ ਦੀਬਾਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ॥
verses.translit: kis hee jor dheebaan maiaa kaa ||
verses.translation: Some have the power of authority and Maya.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਟੇਕ ਧਰ ਅਵਰ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਤੂ ਕਰਤੇ ਰਾਖੁ ਮੈ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: mai har bin Tek dhar avar na kaiee too karate raakh mai nimaanee he ||13||
verses.translation: I have no other Support at all, except the Lord. O Creator Lord, please save me, meek and dishonored. ||13||
You bless the meek and dishonored with honor, as it pleases You, O Lord.

verses.original: ਹੋਰ ਕੇਤੀ ਝਖਿ ਝਖਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: hor ketee jhakh jhakh aavai jaavai ||
verses.translation: Many others argue in conflict, coming and going in reincarnation.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕਾ ਪਖੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੂ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਊਪਰਿ ਗਲ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: jin kaa pakh kareh too suaamee tin kee uoopar gal tudh aanee he ||14||
verses.translation: Those people, whose side You take, O Lord and Master, are elevated and successful. ||14||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam jinee sadhaa dhiaaiaa ||
verses.translation: Those who meditate forever on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har,

verses.original: ਤਿਨੀ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: tinee gur parasaadh param padh paiaa ||
verses.translation: by Guru's Grace, obtain the supreme status.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਪਛੋਤਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: jin har seviaa tin sukh paiaa bin sevaa pachhotaanee he ||15||
verses.translation: Those who serve the Lord find peace; without serving Him, they regret and repent. ||15||

verses.original: ਤੂ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਗੰਨਾਥੁ ॥
verses.translit: too sabh meh varateh har jaga(n)naath ||
verses.translation: You are pervading all, O Lord of the world.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹਾਥੁ ॥
verses.translit: so har japai jis gur masatak haath ||
verses.translation: He alone meditates on the Lord, upon whose forehead the Guru places His hand.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪੀ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਦਸਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੨॥
verses.translit: har kee saran piaa har jaapee jan naanak dhaas dhasaanee he ||16||2||
verses.translation: Entering the Sanctuary of the Lord, I meditate on the Lord; servant Nanak is the slave of His slaves. ||16||2||
Maaroo, Solahas, Fifth Mehla:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
He infused His power into the earth.
He suspends the heavens upon the feet of His Command.

verses.original: ਅਗਨਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਈਧਨ ਮਹਿ ਬਾਧੀ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਭਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: agan upai ieedhan meh baadhee so prabh raakhai bhaiee he ||1||
verses.translation: He created fire and locked it into wood. That God protects all, O Siblings of Destiny. ||1||
He gives nourishment to all beings and creatures.
He Himself is the all-powerful Creator, the Cause of causes.

verses.original: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਨਹਾਰਾ ਸੋਈ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਹਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: khin meh thaap uthaapanahaaraa soiee teraa sahaiee he ||2||
verses.translation: In an instant, He establishes and disestablishes; He is your help and support. ||2||
He cherished you in your mother's womb.
With every breath and morsel of food, He is with you, and takes care of you.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਪੀਐ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਵਡੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sadhaa japeeaai so preetam vaddee jis vaddiaaiee he ||3||
verses.translation: Forever and ever, meditate on that Beloved; Great is His glorious greatness! ||3||
The sultans and nobles are reduced to dust in an instant.
God cherishes the poor, and makes them into rulers.

verses.original: ਗਰਬ ਨਿਵਾਰਣ ਸਰਬ ਸਧਾਰਣ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: garab nivaaran sarab sadhaaran kichh keemat kahee na jaiee he ||4||
verses.translation: He is the Destroyer of egotistical pride, the Support of all. His value cannot be estimated. ||4||
He alone is honorable, and he alone is wealthy,
within whose mind the Lord God abides.

verses.original: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪ ਭਾਈ ਜਿਨਿ ਇਹ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: maat pitaa sut ba(n)dhap bhaiee jin ieh sirasaT upaiee he ||5||
verses.translation: He alone is my mother, father, child, relative and sibling, who created this Universe. ||5||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਏ ਸਰਣਾ ਭਉ ਨਹੀ ਕਰਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: prabh aae saranaa bhau nahee karanaa ||
verses.translation: I have come to God's Sanctuary, and so I fear nothing.
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I am sure to be saved.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕਰਮ ਅਰਾਧੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਦੇ ਸਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: man bach karam araadhe karataa tis naahee kadhe sajaiee he ||6||
verses.translation: One who adores the Creator in thought, word and deed, shall never be punished. ||6||

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਵਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: gun nidhaan man tan meh raviaa ||
verses.translation: One whose mind and body are permeated with the Lord, the treasure of virtue,

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕੀ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਭਵਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: janam maran kee jon na bhaviaa ||
verses.translation: does not wander in birth, death and reincarnation.

verses.original: ਦੂਖ ਬਿਨਾਸ ਕੀਆ ਸੁਖਿ ਡੇਰਾ ਜਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਰਹੇ ਆਘਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: dhookh binaas keeaa sukh dderaa jaa tirapat rahe aaghaiee he ||7||
verses.translation: Pain vanishes and peace prevails, when one is satisfied and fulfilled. ||7||
My Lord and Master is my best friend.
The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, is in all places and interspaces.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਗਣਤ ਮਿਟਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: simar simar pooran paramesur chi(n)taa ganat miTaiee he ||8||
verses.translation: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on the Perfect Transcendent Lord, I am rid of all anxieties and calculations. ||8||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੋਟਿ ਲਖ ਬਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam koT lakh baahaa ||
verses.translation: One who has the Name of the Lord has hundreds of thousands and millions of arms.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਧਨੁ ਤਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: har jas keeratan sa(n)g dhan taahaa ||
verses.translation: The wealth of the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises is with him.

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨ ਖੜਗੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦੀਨਾ ਦੂਤ ਮਾਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਧਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: giaan khaRag kar kirapaa dheenaa dhoot maare kar dhaiee he ||9||
verses.translation: In His Mercy, God has blessed me with the sword of spiritual wisdom; I have attacked and killed the demons. ||9||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਜਾਪੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa jaap japahu jap japane ||
verses.translation: Chant the Chant of the Lord, the Chant of Chants.
Be a winner of the game of life and come to abide in your true home.

verses.original: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਨਰਕ ਨ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: lakh chauraaseeh narak na dhekhahu rasak rasak gun gaiee he ||10||
verses.translation: You shall not see the 8.4 million types of hell; sing His Glorious Praises and remain saturated with loving devotion||10||
He is the Savior of worlds and galaxies.
He is lofty, unfathomable, inaccessible and infinite.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨੀ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਧਿਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: jis no kirapaa kare prabh apanee so jan tiseh dhiaaiee he ||11||
verses.translation: That humble being, unto whom God grants His Grace, meditates on Him. ||11||
God has broken my bonds, and claimed me as His own.
In His Mercy, He has made me the slave of His home.

verses.original: ਅਨਹਦ ਰੁਣ ਝੁਣਕਾਰੁ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: anahadh run jhunakaar sahaj dhun saachee kaar kamaiee he ||12||
verses.translation: The unstruck celestial sound current resounds and vibrates, when one performs acts of true service. ||12||
O God, I have enshrined faith in You within my mind.
My egotistical intellect has been driven out.

verses.original: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਨੈ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਸੋਭ ਸੁਹਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: a(n)geekaar keeaa prabh apanai jag meh sobh suhaiee he ||13||
verses.translation: God has made me His own, and now I have a glorious reputation in this world. ||13||
Proclaim His Glorious Victory, and meditate on the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਈਸੈ ॥
verses.translit: bal bal jaiee prabh apune ieesai ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to my Lord God.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਏਕਾ ਜਗਤਿ ਸਬਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: tis bin dhoojaa avar na dheesai ekaa jagat sabaiee he ||14||
verses.translation: I do not see any other except Him. The One Lord pervades the whole world. ||14||
True, True, True is God.
By Guru's Grace, my mind is attuned to Him forever.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਜਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਏਕੰਕਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: simar simar jeeveh jan tere eka(n)kaar samaiee he ||15||
verses.translation: Your humble servants live by meditating, meditating in remembrance on You, merging in You, O One Universal Creator. ||15||
The Dear Lord is the Beloved of His humble devotees.
My Lord and Master is the Savior of all.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਸਭ ਇਛਾ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੧॥
verses.translit: simar naam pu(n)nee sabh ichhaa jan naanak paij rakhaiee he ||16||1||
verses.translation: Meditating in remembrance on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, all desires are fulfilled. He has saved the honor of servant Nanak. ||16||1||
Maaroo, Solahas, Fifth Mehla:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
The body-bride is attached to the Yogi, the husband-soul.
She is involved with him, enjoying pleasure and delights.

verses.original: ਕਿਰਤ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਭਏ ਇਕਤ੍ਰਾ ਕਰਤੇ ਭੋਗ ਬਿਲਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kirat sa(n)jogee bhe ikatraa karate bhog bilaasaa he ||1||
verses.translation: As a consequence of past actions, they have come together, enjoying pleasurable play. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਧਨ ਤਤੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: jo pir karai su dhan tat maanai ||
verses.translation: Whatever the husband does, the bride willingly accepts.
The husband adorns his bride, and keeps her with himself.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਏਕਤ੍ਰ ਵਸਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਦੇ ਧਨਹਿ ਦਿਲਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: mil ekatr vaseh dhin raatee priau dhe dhaneh dhilaasaa he ||2||
verses.translation: Joining together, they live in harmony day and night; the husband comforts his wife. ||2||

verses.original: ਧਨ ਮਾਗੈ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: dhan maagai priau bahu bidh dhaavai ||
verses.translation: When the bride asks, the husband runs around in all sorts of ways.
Whatever he finds, he brings to show his bride.

verses.original: ਏਕ ਵਸਤੁ ਕਉ ਪਹੁਚਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਧਨ ਰਹਤੀ ਭੂਖ ਪਿਆਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ek vasat kau pahuch na saakai dhan rahatee bhookh piaasaa he ||3||
verses.translation: But there is one thing he cannot reach, and so his bride remains hungry and thirsty. ||3||

verses.original: ਧਨ ਕਰੈ ਬਿਨਉ ਦੋਊ ਕਰ ਜੋਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: dhan karai binau dhouoo kar jorai ||
verses.translation: With her palms pressed together, the bride offers her prayer,

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪਰਦੇਸਿ ਨ ਜਾਹੁ ਵਸਹੁ ਘਰਿ ਮੋਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: pria paradhes na jaahu vasahu ghar morai ||
verses.translation: "O my beloved, do not leave me and go to foreign lands; please stay here with me.

verses.original: ਐਸਾ ਬਣਜੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਭੂਖ ਪਿਆਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: aaisaa banaj karahu gireh bheetar jit utarai bhookh piaasaa he ||4||
verses.translation: Do such business within our home, that my hunger and thirst may be relieved.""||4||
All sorts of religious rituals are performed in this age,

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਸੁਖੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਲਾਧਾ ॥
verses.translit: bin har ras sukh til nahee laadhaa ||
verses.translation: but without the sublime essence of the Lord, not an iota of peace is found.

verses.original: ਭਈ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਸੰਗੇ ਤਉ ਧਨ ਪਿਰ ਅਨੰਦ ਉਲਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: bhiee kirapaa naanak satasa(n)ge tau dhan pir ana(n)dh ulaasaa he ||5||
verses.translation: When the Lord becomes Merciful, O Nanak, then in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, the bride and the husband enjoy ecstasy and bliss. ||5||
The body-bride is blind, and the groom is clever and wise.
The creation was created of the five elements.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਵਖਰ ਕਉ ਤੁਮ ਆਏ ਹਹੁ ਸੋ ਪਾਇਓ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: jis vakhar kau tum aae hahu so paio satigur paasaa he ||6||
verses.translation: That merchandise, for which you have come into the world, is received only from the True Guru. ||6||

verses.original: ਧਨ ਕਹੈ ਤੂ ਵਸੁ ਮੈ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: dhan kahai too vas mai naale ||
verses.translation: The body-bride says, ""Please live with me,
O my beloved, peaceful, young lord.

verses.original: ਤੁਝੈ ਬਿਨਾ ਹਉ ਕਿਤ ਹੀ ਨ ਲੇਖੈ ਵਚਨੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਜਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: tujhai binaa hau kit hee na lekhai vachan dheh chhodd na jaasaa he ||7||
verses.translation: Without you, I am of no account. Please give me your word, that you will not leave me"". ||7||
The soul-husband says, ""I am the slave of my Commander.

verses.original: ਓਹੁ ਭਾਰੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਾਣਿ ਨ ਛੰਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: oh bhaaro Thaakur jis kaan na chha(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: He is my Great Lord and Master, who is fearless and independent.

verses.original: ਜਿਚਰੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਿਚਰੁ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਹਣਾ ਜਾ ਸਦੇ ਤ ਊਠਿ ਸਿਧਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: jichar raakhai tichar tum sa(n)g rahanaa jaa sadhe ta uooTh sidhaasaa he ||8||
verses.translation: As long as He wills, I will remain with you. When He summons me, I shall arise and depart.""||8||

verses.original: ਜਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਬਚਨ ਕਹੇ ਧਨ ਸਾਚੇ ॥
verses.translit: jau pria bachan kahe dhan saache ||
verses.translation: The husband speaks words of Truth to the bride,

verses.original: ਧਨ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਸਮਝੈ ਚੰਚਲਿ ਕਾਚੇ ॥
verses.translit: dhan kachhoo na samajhai cha(n)chal kaache ||
verses.translation: but the bride is restless and inexperienced, and she does not understand anything.

verses.original: ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਪਿਰ ਹੀ ਸੰਗੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਓਹੁ ਬਾਤ ਜਾਨੈ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: bahur bahur pir hee sa(n)g maagai oh baat jaanai kar haasaa he ||9||
verses.translation: Again and again, she begs her husband to stay; she thinks that he is just joking when he answers her. ||9||
The Order comes, and the husband-soul is called.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਧਨ ਪੁਛੀ ਨ ਮਤਾ ਪਕਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: naa dhan puchhee na mataa pakaiaa ||
verses.translation: He does not consult with his bride, and does not ask her opinion.

verses.original: ਊਠਿ ਸਿਧਾਇਓ ਛੂਟਰਿ ਮਾਟੀ ਦੇਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਥਨ ਮੋਹਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: uooTh sidhaio chhooTar maaTee dhekh naanak mithan mohaasaa he ||10||
verses.translation: He gets up and marches off, and the discarded body-bride mingles with dust. O Nanak, behold the illusion of emotional attachment and hope. ||10||

verses.original: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਲੋਭੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: re man lobhee sun man mere ||
verses.translation: O greedy mind - listen, O my mind!
Serve the True Guru day and night forever.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਚਿ ਮੂਏ ਸਾਕਤ ਨਿਗੁਰੇ ਗਲਿ ਜਮ ਫਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: bin satigur pach mooe saakat nigure gal jam faasaa he ||11||
verses.translation: Without the True Guru, the faithless cynics rot away and die. The noose of Death is around the necks of those who have no guru. ||11||
The self-willed manmukh comes, and the self-willed manmukh goes.
The manmukh suffers beatings again and again.

verses.original: ਜਿਤਨੇ ਨਰਕ ਸੇ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਭੋਗੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲੇਪੁ ਨ ਮਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: jitane narak se manmukh bhogai gurmukh lep na maasaa he ||12||
verses.translation: The manmukh endures as many hells as there are; the Gurmukh is not even touched by them. ||12||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਇ ਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh soi j har jeeau bhaiaa ||
verses.translation: He alone is Gurmukh, who is pleasing to the Dear Lord.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਕਉਣੁ ਮਿਟਾਵੈ ਜਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਪਹਿਰਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: tis kaun miTaavai j prabh pahiraiaa ||
verses.translation: Who can destroy anyone who is robed in honor by the Lord?

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਕਰੇ ਆਨੰਦੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਰਪਾਉ ਪਇਆ ਗਲਿ ਖਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: sadhaa ana(n)dh kare aana(n)dhee jis sirapaau piaa gal khaasaa he ||13||
verses.translation: The blissful one is forever in bliss; he is dressed in robes of honor. ||13||
I am a sacrifice to the Perfect True Guru.

verses.original: ਸਰਣਿ ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇ ਬਚਨ ਕੇ ਸੂਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: saran ke dhaate bachan ke soore ||
verses.translation: He is the Giver of Sanctuary, the Heroic Warrior who keeps His Word.

verses.original: ਐਸਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਨ ਕਤ ਹੀ ਜਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: aaisaa prabh miliaa sukhadhaataa vichhuR na kat hee jaasaa he ||14||
verses.translation: Such is the Lord God, the Giver of peace, whom I have met; He shall never leave me or go anywhere else. ||14||

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: gun nidhaan kichh keem na paiee ||
verses.translation: He is the treasure of virtue; His value cannot be estimated.

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT poor rahio sabh Thaiee ||
verses.translation: He is perfectly permeating each and every heart, prevailing everywhere.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਹਉ ਰੇਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਜੋ ਦਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥੧॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak saran dheen dhukh bha(n)jan hau ren tere jo dhaasaa he ||15||1||2||
verses.translation: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Destroyer of the pains of the poor; I am the dust of the feet of Your slaves. ||15||1||2||
Maaroo, Solahas, Fifth Mehla:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
My Blissful Lord is forever in bliss.

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਸਿਰ ਸਿਰਹਿ ਨਿਬੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT pooran sir sireh niberaa ||
verses.translation: He fills each and every heart, and judges each and everyone.

verses.original: ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਕੈ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਦੂਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sir saahaa kai sachaa saahib avar naahee ko dhoojaa he ||1||
verses.translation: The True Lord and Master is above the heads of all kings; there is none other than Him. ||1||
He is joyful, blissful and merciful.
God's Light is manifest everywhere.

verses.original: ਰੂਪ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਆਪਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: roop kare kar vekhai vigasai aape hee aap poojaa he ||2||
verses.translation: He creates forms, and gazing upon them, He enjoys them; He Himself worships Himself. ||2||
He contemplates His own creative power.
The True Lord Himself creates the expanse of the Universe.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਖੇਲ ਖਿਲਾਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਆਪੇ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਭੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aape khel khilaavai dhin raatee aape sun sun bheejaa he ||3||
verses.translation: He Himself stages the play, day and night; He Himself listens, and hearing, rejoices. ||3||
True is His throne, and True is His kingdom.
True is the treasure of the True Banker.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸਚੁ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਸਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਵਰਤੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: aape sach dhaario sabh saachaa sache sach varateejaa he ||4||
verses.translation: He Himself is True, and true is all that He has established. True is the prevailing Order of the True Lord. ||4||
True is the justice of the True Lord.
Your place is forever True, O God.

verses.original: ਸਚੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸੁਖੁ ਕੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: sachee kudharat sachee baanee sach saahib sukh keejaa he ||5||
verses.translation: True is Your Creative Power, and True is the Word of Your Bani. True is the peace which You give, O my Lord and Master. ||5||
You alone are the greatest king.
By the Hukam of Your Command, O True Lord, our affairs are fulfilled.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਆਪਿ ਪਤੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar baahar sabh kichh jaanai aape hee aap pateejaa he ||6||
verses.translation: Inwardly and outwardly, You know everything; You Yourself are pleased with Yourself. ||6||

verses.original: ਤੂ ਵਡ ਰਸੀਆ ਤੂ ਵਡ ਭੋਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: too vadd raseeaa too vadd bhogee ||
verses.translation: You are the great party-goer, You are the great enjoyer.
You are detached in Nirvaanaa, You are the Yogi.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਘਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਅਮਿਉ ਤੇਰੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: sarab sookh sahaj ghar terai amiau teree dhirasaTeejaa he ||7||
verses.translation: All celestial comforts are in Your home; Your Glance of Grace rains Nectar. ||7||
You alone give Your gifts.
You grant Your gifts unto all the beings of the world.

verses.original: ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਪੂਰ ਭੰਡਾਰੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਰਹੇ ਆਘੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: toT na aavai poor bha(n)ddaarai tirapat rahe aagheejaa he ||8||
verses.translation: Your treasures are overflowing, and are never exhausted; through them, we remain satisfied and fulfilled. ||8||
The Siddhas, seekers and forest-dwellers beg from You.
The celibates and abstainers, and those who abide in peace beg from You.

verses.original: ਇਕੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਸਗਲ ਹੈ ਜਾਚਿਕ ਦੇਹਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: eik dhaataar sagal hai jaachik dheh dhaan sirasaTeejaa he ||9||
verses.translation: You alone are the Great Giver; all are beggars of You. You bless all the world with Your gifts. ||9||
Your devotees worship You with infinite love.
In an instant, You establish and disestablish.

verses.original: ਭਾਰੋ ਤੋਲੁ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਭਗਤੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: bhaaro tol bea(n)t suaamee hukam ma(n)n bhagateejaa he ||10||
verses.translation: Your weight is so heavy, O my infinite Lord and Master. Your devotees surrender to the Hukam of Your Command. ||10||

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਸੋਈ ਤੁਧੁ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: jis dheh dharas soiee tudh jaanai ||
verses.translation: They alone know You, whom You bless with Your Glance of Grace.

verses.original: ਓਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: oh gur kai sabadh sadhaa ra(n)g maanai ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they enjoy Your Love forever.

verses.original: ਚਤੁਰੁ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਸਿਆਣਾ ਸੋਈ ਜੋ ਮਨਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਭਾਵੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: chatur saroop siaanaa soiee jo man terai bhaaveejaa he ||11||
verses.translation: They alone are clever, handsome and wise, who are pleasing to Your Mind. ||11||
One who keeps You in his consciousness, becomes carefree and independent.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਸੋ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis cheet aaveh so saachaa saahaa ||
verses.translation: One who keeps You in his consciousness, is the true king.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਉ ਕੇਹਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਕਹਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: jis cheet aaveh tis bhau kehaa avar kahaa kichh keejaa he ||12||
verses.translation: One who keeps You in his consciousness - what does he have to fear? And what else does he need to do? ||12||
Thirst and desire are quenched, and one's inner being is cooled and soothed.
The True Guru has mended the broken one.

verses.original: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਾਗੀ ਅਮਿਉ ਝੋਲਿ ਝੋਲਿ ਪੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: surat sabadh ridh a(n)tar jaagee amiau jhol jhol peejaa he ||13||
verses.translation: Awareness of the Word of the Shabad has awakened within my heart. Shaking it and vibrating it, I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||13||

verses.original: ਮਰੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਦ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਜੀਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: marai naahee sadh sadh hee jeevai ||
verses.translation: I shall not die; I shall live forever and ever.
I have become immortal; I am eternal and imperishable.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਆਵੈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਜਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਭਰਮੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: naa ko aavai naa ko jaavai gur dhoor keeaa bharameejaa he ||14||
verses.translation: I do not come, and I do not go. The Guru has driven out my doubts. ||14||
Perfect is the Word of the Perfect Guru.
One who is attached to the Perfect Lord, is immersed in the Perfect Lord.

verses.original: ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਇਆ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਰੰਗਾ ਘਟੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੋਲੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: chaRai savaiaa nit nit ra(n)gaa ghaTai naahee toleejaa he ||15||
verses.translation: His love increases day by day, and when it is weighed, it does not decrease. ||15||
When the gold is made one hundred percent pure,
its color is true to the jeweller's eye.

verses.original: ਪਰਖਿ ਖਜਾਨੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਰਾਫੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਾਈਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥
