verses.translit: parakh khajaanai paiaa saraafee fir naahee taieejaa he ||16||
verses.translation: Assaying it, it is placed in the treasury by God the Jeweller, and it is not melted down again. ||16||
Your Naam is Ambrosial Nectar, O my Lord and Master.
Nanak, Your slave, is forever a sacrifice to You.

verses.original: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੭॥੧॥੩॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tasa(n)g mahaa sukh paiaa dhekh dharasan ih man bheejaa he ||17||1||3||
verses.translation: In the Society of the Saints, I have found great peace; gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, this mind is pleased and satisfied. ||17||1||3||
Maaroo, Fifth Mehla, Solhas:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
The Guru is the Lord of the World, the Guru is the Master of the Universe.
The Guru is merciful, and always forgiving.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਸਤ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਅਸਥਾਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur saasat simirat khaT karamaa gur pavitr asathaanaa he ||1||
verses.translation: The Guru is the Shaastras, the Simritees and the six rituals. The Guru is the Holy Shrine. ||1||
Meditating in remembrance on the Guru, all the sins are erased.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਜਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਫਾਸਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: gur simarat jam sa(n)g na faaseh ||
verses.translation: Meditating in remembrance on the Guru, one is not strangled by the noose of Death.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਾਟੇ ਅਪਮਾਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur simarat man niramal hovai gur kaaTe apamaanaa he ||2||
verses.translation: Meditating in remembrance on the Guru, the mind becomes immaculate; the Guru eliminates egotistical pride. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਨਰਕਿ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gur kaa sevak narak na jaae ||
verses.translation: The Guru's servant is not consigned to hell.
The Guru's servant meditates on the Supreme Lord God.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਦਾ ਨਿਤ ਜੀਅ ਦਾਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gur kaa sevak saadhasa(n)g paae gur karadhaa nit jeea dhaanaa he ||3||
verses.translation: The Guru's servant joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; the Guru ever gives the life of the soul. ||3||
At the Gurdwara, the Guru's Gate, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises are sung.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਭਣੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: satigur bheT har jas mukh bhaneeaai ||
verses.translation: Meeting with the True Guru, one chants the Lord's Praises.

verses.original: ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਮਿਟਾਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਦੇਵੈ ਮਾਨਾਂ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: kal kales miTaae satigur har dharageh dhevai maanaa(n) he ||4||
verses.translation: The True Guru eradicates sorrow and suffering, and bestows honor in the Court of the Lord. ||4||
The Guru has revealed the inaccessible and unfathomable Lord.
The True Guru returns to the Path, those who have wandered away.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਭਗਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਰ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੑਾਇਆ ਗਿਆਨਾਂ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: gur sevak kau bighan na bhagatee har poor dhiraR(h)aiaa giaanaa(n) he ||5||
verses.translation: No obstacles stand in the way of devotion to the Lord, for one who serves the Guru. The Guru implants perfect spiritual wisdom. ||5||
The Guru has revealed the Lord everywhere.
The Lord of the Universe is permeating and pervading the water and the land.

verses.original: ਊਚ ਊਨ ਸਭ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਨਾਂ ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: uooch uoon sabh ek samaanaa(n) man laagaa sahaj dhiaanaa he ||6||
verses.translation: The high and the low are all the same to Him. Focus your mind's meditation intuitively on Him. ||6||
Meeting with the Guru, all thirst is quenched.
Meeting with the Guru, one is not watched by Maya.

verses.original: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਦੀਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀ ਪਾਨਾਂ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: sat sa(n)tokh dheeaa gur poorai naam a(n)mrit pee paanaa(n) he ||7||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru bestows truth and contentment; I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||7||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਭ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: gur kee baanee sabh maeh samaanee ||
verses.translation: The Word of the Guru's Bani is contained in all.
He Himself hears it, and He Himself repeats it.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਪੀ ਤੇਈ ਸਭਿ ਨਿਸਤ੍ਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਥਾਨਾਂ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: jin jin japee teiee sabh nisatre tin paiaa nihachal thaanaa(n) he ||8||
verses.translation: Those who meditate on it, are all emancipated; they attain the eternal and unchanging home. ||8||
The Glory of the True Guru is known only to the True Guru.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਆਪਣ ਭਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: jo kichh kare su aapan bhaanai ||
verses.translation: Whatever He does, is according to the Pleasure of His Will.

verses.original: ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਰਿ ਜਾਚਹਿ ਜਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨਾਂ ਹੇ ॥੯॥੧॥੪॥
verses.translit: saadhoo dhoor jaacheh jan tere naanak sadh kurabaanaa(n) he ||9||1||4||
verses.translation: Your humble servants beg for the dust of the feet of the Holy; Nanak is forever a sacrifice to You. ||9||1||4||
Maaroo, Solahas, Fifth Mehla:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
The Primal, Immaculate Lord God is formless.
The Detached Lord is Himself prevailing in all.

verses.original: ਵਰਨੁ ਜਾਤਿ ਚਿਹਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ਸਭ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: varan jaat chihan nahee koiee sabh hukame sirasaT upaidhaa ||1||
verses.translation: He has no race or social class, no identifying mark. By the Hukam of His Will, He created the entire universe. ||1||
Out of all the 8.4 million species of beings,
God blessed mankind with glory.

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਪਉੜੀ ਤੇ ਜੋ ਨਰੁ ਚੂਕੈ ਸੋ ਆਇ ਜਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: eis pauRee te jo nar chookai so aai jai dhukh paidhaa ||2||
verses.translation: That human who misses this chance, shall suffer the pains of coming and going in reincarnation. ||2||
What should I say, to one who has been created.
The Gurmukh receives the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਸੋਈ ਭੂਲੈ ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਿਸਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jis aap bhulaae soiee bhoolai so boojhai jiseh bujhaidhaa ||3||
verses.translation: He alone is confused, whom the Lord Himself confuses. He alone understands, whom the Lord inspires to understand. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਕਾ ਨਗਰੁ ਇਹੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: harakh sog kaa nagar ih keeaa ||
verses.translation: This body has been made the village of joy and sorrow.
They alone are emancipated, who seek the Sanctuary of the True Guru.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਹਾ ਗੁਣਾ ਤੇ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਾਰਾ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: tirahaa gunaa te rahai niraaraa so gurmukh sobhaa paidhaa ||4||
verses.translation: One who remains untouched by the three qualities, the three gunas - such a Gurmukh is blessed with glory. ||4||

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਕਰਮ ਕੀਏ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ॥ ਜੋ ਕੀਜੈ ਸੋ ਬੰਧਨੁ ਪੈਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: anik karam ke'ee bahutere || jo keejai so ba(n)dhan paire ||
verses.translation: You can do anything, but whatever you do, only serves to tie your feet.

verses.original: ਕੁਰੁਤਾ ਬੀਜੁ ਬੀਜੇ ਨਹੀ ਜੰਮੈ ਸਭੁ ਲਾਹਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਗਵਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: kurutaa beej beeje nahee ja(n)mai sabh laahaa mool gavaidhaa ||5||
verses.translation: The seed which is planted out of season does not sprout, and all one's capital and profits are lost. ||5||
In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises are most sublime and exalted.
Become Gurmukh, chant and focus your meditation.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਜਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: aap tarai sagale kul taare har dharageh pat siau jaidhaa ||6||
verses.translation: You shall save yourself, and save all your generations as well. You shall go to the Court of the Lord with honor. ||6||
All the continents, nether worlds, islands and worlds

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਕਾਲੈ ਵਸਿ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kaalai vas aap prabh keeaa ||
verses.translation: God Himself has made them all subject to death.

verses.original: ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਏਕੁ ਆਪਿ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਸੋ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਜੋ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: nihachal ek aap abinaasee so nihachal jo tiseh dhiaaidhaa ||7||
verses.translation: The One Imperishable Lord Himself is unmoving and unchanging. Meditating on Him, one becomes unchanging. ||7||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਜੇਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa sevak so har jehaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord's servant becomes like the Lord.
Do not think that, because of his human body, he is different.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਤਰੰਗ ਉਠਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਸਲਲੈ ਸਲਲ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: jiau jal tara(n)g uTheh bahu bhaatee fir salalai salal samaidhaa ||8||
verses.translation: The waves of the water rise up in various ways, and then the water merges again in water. ||8||
A beggar begs for charity at His Door.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: jaa prabh bhaavai taa kirapaa dhaarai ||
verses.translation: When God pleases, He takes pity on him.

verses.original: ਦੇਹੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਠਹਰਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: dheh dharas jit man tirapataasai har keeratan man Thaharaidhaa ||9||
verses.translation: Please bless me with the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, to satisfy my mind, O Lord. Through the Kirtan of Your Praises, my mind is held steady. ||9||

verses.original: ਰੂੜੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਕਿਤੈ ਵਸਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: rooRo Thaakur kitai vas na aavai ||
verses.translation: The Beauteous Lord and Master is not controlled in any way.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ ਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਆ ਸੰਤਾ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: har so kichh kare j har kiaa sa(n)taa bhaavai ||
verses.translation: The Lord does that which pleases the Saints of the Lord.

verses.original: ਕੀਤਾ ਲੋੜਨਿ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਾਇਨਿ ਦਰਿ ਫੇਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: keetaa loRan soiee karain dhar fer na koiee paidhaa ||10||
verses.translation: He does whatever they wish to be done; nothing blocks their way at His Door. ||10||

verses.original: ਜਿਥੈ ਅਉਘਟੁ ਆਇ ਬਨਤੁ ਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: jithai aaughaT aai banat hai praanee ||
verses.translation: Wherever the mortal is confronted with difficulty,
there he should meditate on the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਜਿਥੈ ਪੁਤ੍ਰੁ ਕਲਤ੍ਰੁ ਨ ਬੇਲੀ ਕੋਈ ਤਿਥੈ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਛਡਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: jithai putr kalatr na belee koiee tithai har aap chhaddaidhaa ||11||
verses.translation: Where there are no children, spouse or friends, there the Lord Himself comes to the rescue. ||11||
The Great Lord and Master is inaccessible and unfathomable.
How can anyone meet with God, the self-suficient One?

verses.original: ਕਾਟਿ ਸਿਲਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ਸੋ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: kaaT silak jis maarag paae so vich sa(n)gat vaasaa paidhaa ||12||
verses.translation: Those who have had the noose cut away from around their necks, whom God has set back upon the Path, obtain a place in the Sangat, the Congregation. ||12||
One who realizes the Hukam of the Lord's Command is said to be His servant.
He endures both bad and good equally.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ਤ ਏਕੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: haumai jai ta eko boojhai so gurmukh sahaj samaidhaa ||13||
verses.translation: When egotism is silenced, then one comes to know the One Lord. Such a Gurmukh intuitively merges in the Lord. ||13||
The devotees of the Lord dwell forever in peace.
With a child-like, innocent nature, they remain detached, turning away from the world.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਰੰਗ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤੀ ਜਿਉ ਪਿਤਾ ਪੂਤੁ ਲਾਡਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: anik ra(n)g kareh bahu bhaatee jiau pitaa poot laaddaidhaa ||14||
verses.translation: They enjoy various pleasures in many ways; God caresses them, like a father caressing his son. ||14||
He is inaccessible and unfathomable; His value cannot be estimated.
We meet Him, only when He causes us to meet.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਭਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਜਿਨ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: gurmukh pragaT bhiaa tin jan kau jin dhur masatak lekh likhaidhaa ||15||
verses.translation: The Lord is revealed to those humble Gurmukhs, who have such pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon their foreheads. ||15||
You Yourself are the Creator Lord, the Cause of causes.
You created the Universe, and You support the whole earth.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਲਾਜ ਰਖਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੧॥੫॥
verses.translit: jan naanak saran piaa har dhuaarai har bhaavai laaj rakhaidhaa ||16||1||5||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of Your Door, O Lord; if it is Your Will, please preserve his honor. ||16||1||5||
Maaroo, Solahas, Fifth Mehla:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Whatever is seen is You, O One Lord.
What the ears hear is the Word of Your Bani.

verses.original: ਦੂਜੀ ਅਵਰ ਨ ਜਾਪਸਿ ਕਾਈ ਸਗਲ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਧਾਰਣਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhoojee avar na jaapas kaiee sagal tumaaree dhaaranaa ||1||
verses.translation: There is nothing else to be seen at all. You give support to all. ||1||
You Yourself are conscious of Your Creation.
You Yourself established Yourself, O God.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਰਚਿਓਨੁ ਪਸਾਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸਾਰਣਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aap upai rachion pasaaraa aape ghaT ghaT saaranaa ||2||
verses.translation: Creating Yourself, You formed the expanse of the Universe; You Yourself cherish and sustain each and every heart. ||2||
You created some to hold great and royal courts.
Some turn away from the world in renunciation, and some maintain their households.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਭੂਖੇ ਇਕਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਏ ਸਭਸੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਪਾਰਣਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: eik bhookhe ik tirapat aghaae sabhasai teraa paaranaa ||3||
verses.translation: Some are hungry and some are satisfied and satiated, but all lean on Your Support. ||3||
The True Lord Himself is True, True, True.
He is woven into the essence of His devotees, through and through.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਆਪੇ ਹੈ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਪਸਾਰਣਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: aape gupat aape hai paragaT apanaa aap pasaaranaa ||4||
verses.translation: He Himself is hidden, and He Himself is revealed. He Himself spreads Himself out. ||4||
Forever, forever and ever, He shall always exist.
He is lofty, inaccessible, unfathomable and infinite.

verses.original: ਊਣੇ ਭਰੇ ਭਰੇ ਭਰਿ ਊਣੇ ਏਹਿ ਚਲਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੇ ਕਾਰਣਾ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: uoone bhare bhare bhar uoone eh chalat suaamee ke kaaranaa ||5||
verses.translation: He fills the empty, and empties out the filled; such are the plays and dramas of my Lord and Master. ||5||
With my mouth, I praise my True Lord King.
With my eyes, I behold the inaccessible and unfathomable Lord.

verses.original: ਕਰਨੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਗਲ ਉਧਾਰਣਾ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: karanee sun sun man tan hariaa mere saahib sagal udhaaranaa ||6||
verses.translation: Listening, listening with my ears, my mind and body are rejuvenated; my Lord and Master saves all. ||6||
He created the creation, and gazes upon what He has created.
All beings and creatures meditate on Him.

verses.original: ਅਪਣੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਨਦਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਣਾ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: apanee kudharat aape jaanai nadharee nadhar nihaalanaa ||7||
verses.translation: He Himself knows His creative power; He blesses with His Glance of Grace. ||7||

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਜਹ ਬੈਸਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਸੇ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t sabhaa jeh baiseh prabh paase ||
verses.translation: Where the Saints gather together and sit, God dwells close at hand.
They abide in bliss and joy, beholding the Lord's wondrous play.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਤਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਚਿਤਾਰਣਾ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: gun gaaveh anahadh dhun baanee teh naanak dhaas chitaaranaa ||8||
verses.translation: They sing the Glories of the Lord, and the unstruck sound current of His Bani; O Nanak, His slaves remain conscious of Him. ||8||
Coming and going is all Your wondrous play.
Creating the Creation, You gaze upon Your infinite play.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਉਪਾਵਣਹਾਰਾ ਅਪਣਾ ਕੀਆ ਪਾਲਣਾ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: aap upaae upaavanahaaraa apanaa keeaa paalanaa ||9||
verses.translation: Creating the Creation, You Yourself cherish and nurture it. ||9||
Listening, listening to Your Glory, I live.
Forever and ever, I am a sacrifice to You.

verses.original: ਦੁਇ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਸਿਮਰਉ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਣਾ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: dhui kar joR simarau dhin raatee mere suaamee agam apaaranaa ||10||
verses.translation: With my palms pressed together, I meditate in remembrance on You, day and night, O my inaccessible, infinite Lord and Master. ||10||
Other than You, who else should I praise?
I meditate on the One and Only Lord within my mind.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੂਝਿ ਜਨ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ਇਹ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਘਾਲਣਾ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: hukam boojh jan bhe nihaalaa ieh bhagataa kee ghaalanaa ||11||
verses.translation: Realizing the Hukam of Your Will, Your humble servants are enraptured; this is the achievement of Your devotees. ||11||
Following the Guru's Teachings, I meditate on the True Lord within my mind.
Following the Guru's Teachings, I am immersed in the Lord's Love.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਤੁਟਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਇਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਪਰਜਾਲਣਾ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: gur upadhes tuTeh sabh ba(n)dhan ih bharam moh parajaalanaa ||12||
verses.translation: Following the Guru's Teachings, all bonds are broken, and this doubt and emotional attachment are burnt away. ||12||
Wherever He keeps me, is my place of rest.
Whatever naturally happens, I accept that as good.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਸੇ ਬੈਰ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਬੈਰੀ ਸਭੁ ਏਕੋ ਹੈ ਭਾਲਣਾ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: binase bair naahee ko bairee sabh eko hai bhaalanaa ||13||
verses.translation: Hatred is gone - I have no hatred at all; I see the One Lord in all. ||13||
Fear has been removed, and darkness has been dispelled.
The all-powerful, primal, detached Lord God has been revealed.

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਪਏ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਘਾਲਣਾ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: aap chhodd pe saranaiee jis kaa saa tis ghaalanaa ||14||
verses.translation: Forsaking self-conceit, I have entered His Sanctuary, and I work for Him. ||14||
Rare are those few, very blessed people, who come into the world,
and meditate on their Lord and Master, twenty-four hours a day.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਰ ਸਧਾਰਣਾ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: tis jan kai sa(n)g tarai sabh koiee so paravaar sadhaaranaa ||15||
verses.translation: Associating with such humble people, all are saved, and their families are saved as well. ||15||
This is the blessing which I have received from my Lord and Master.
Twenty-four hours a day, with my palms pressed together, I meditate on Him.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲੈ ਉਚਾਰਣਾ ॥੧੬॥੧॥੬॥
verses.translit: naam japee naam sahaj samaavaa naam naanak milai uchaaranaa ||16||1||6||
verses.translation: I chant the Naam, and through the Naam, I intuitively merge into the Lord; O Nanak, may I be blessed with the Naam, and ever repeat it. ||16||1||6||
Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:
Do not be fooled by appearances, you fool.
This is a false attachment to the expanse of an illusion.

verses.original: ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਕੋਈ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jag meh koiee rahan na paae nihachal ek naarainaa ||1||
verses.translation: No one can remain in this world; only the One Lord is permanent and unchanging. ||1||
Seek the Sanctuary of the Perfect Guru.
He shall eradicate all emotional attachment, sorrow and doubt.

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦ ਗਾਇਣਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: eko ma(n)tr dhiraRaae aaukhadh sach naam ridh gainaa ||2||
verses.translation: He shall administer the medicine, the Mantra of the One Name. Sing the True Name within your heart. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੈ ਕਉ ਤਰਸਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis naamai kau taraseh bahu dhevaa ||
verses.translation: So many gods yearn for the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਭਗਤ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਕਰਦੇ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: sagal bhagat jaa kee karadhe sevaa ||
verses.translation: All the devotees serve Him.

verses.original: ਅਨਾਥਾ ਨਾਥੁ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਸੋ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਣਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: anaathaa naath dheen dhukh bha(n)jan so gur poore te painaa ||3||
verses.translation: He is the Master of the masterless, the Destroyer of the pains of the poor. His Name is obtained from the Perfect Guru. ||3||
I cannot conceive of any other door.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਧਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
verses.translit: tirabhavan dhaavai taa kichhoo na boojhai ||
verses.translation: One who wanders through the three worlds, understands nothing.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਹੁ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ਨਾਮ ਜਿਸੁ ਇਹੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਣਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: satigur saahu bha(n)ddaar naam jis ih ratan tisai te painaa ||4||
verses.translation: The True Guru is the banker, with the treasure of the Naam. This jewel is obtained from Him. ||4||
The dust of His feet purifies.

verses.original: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਦੇਵ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮੀਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: sur nar dhev na paaveh meetaa ||
verses.translation: Even the angelic beings and gods cannot obtain it, O friend.

verses.original: ਸਤਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਭੇਟਤ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਇਣਾ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: sat purakh satigur paramesar jis bheTat paar parainaa ||5||
verses.translation: The True Guru is the True Primal Being, the Transcendent Lord God; meeting with Him, one is carried across to the other side. ||5||
O my beloved mind, if you wish for the 'tree of life';
if you wish for Kaamadhayna, the wish-fulfilling cow to adorn your court;

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਮਾਇ ਰਸਾਇਣਾ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: tirapat sa(n)tokh sevaa gur poore naam kamai rasainaa ||6||
verses.translation: if you wish to be satisfied and contented, then serve the Perfect Guru, and practice the Naam, the source of nectar. ||6||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਪੰਚ ਧਾਤੂ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh mareh pa(n)ch dhaatoo ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the five thieves of desire are conquered.
In the Fear of the Supreme Lord God, you shall become immaculate and pure.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਸੁ ਜਬ ਭੇਟੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਤਾ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਪਰਸਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਣਾ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: paaras jab bheTai gur pooraa taa paaras paras dhikhainaa ||7||
verses.translation: When one meets the Perfect Guru, the Philosopher's Stone, His touch reveals the Lord, the Philosopher's Stone. ||7||
Myriads of heavens do not equal the Lord's Name.
The spiritually wise forsake mere liberation.

verses.original: ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਾਇਣਾ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: eka(n)kaar satigur te paieeaai hau bal bal gur dharasainaa ||8||
verses.translation: The One Universal Creator Lord is found through the True Guru. I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan. ||8||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: gur kee sev na jaanai koiee ||
verses.translation: No one knows how to serve the Guru.
The Guru is the unfathomable, Supreme Lord God.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਾਇ ਲਏ ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਡਭਾਗ ਮਥਾਇਣਾ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: jis no lai le so sevak jis vaddabhaag mathainaa ||9||
verses.translation: He alone is the Guru's servant, whom the Guru Himself links to His service, and upon whose forehead such blessed destiny is inscribed. ||9||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਬੇਦ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: gur kee mahimaa bedh na jaaneh ||
verses.translation: Even the Vedas do not know the Guru's Glory.
They narrate only a tiny bit of what is heard.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲਾਇਣਾ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: paarabraham apara(n)par satigur jis simarat man seetalainaa ||10||
verses.translation: The True Guru is the Supreme Lord God, the Incomparable One; meditating in remembrance on Him, the mind is cooled and soothed. ||10||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੋਇ ਸੁਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kee soi sunee man jeevai ||
verses.translation: Hearing of Him, the mind comes to life.
When He dwells within the heart, one becomes peaceful and cool.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਅਲਾਏ ਤਾ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਮ ਕੈ ਪੰਥਿ ਨ ਪਾਇਣਾ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: gur mukhahu alaae taa sobhaa paae tis jam kai pa(n)th na painaa ||11||
verses.translation: Chanting the Guru's Name with the mouth, one obtains glory, and does not have to walk on the Path of Death. ||11||
I have entered the Sanctuary of the Saints,
and placed before them my soul, my breath of life and wealth.

verses.original: ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਕਾਈ ਤੁਮ ਕਰਹੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਿਰਮਾਇਣਾ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: sevaa surat na jaanaa kaiee tum karahu dhiaa kiramainaa ||12||
verses.translation: I know nothing about service and awareness; please take pity upon this worm. ||12||
I am unworthy; please merge me into Yourself.
Please bless me with Your Grace, and link me to Your service.

verses.original: ਪਖਾ ਫੇਰਉ ਪੀਸਉ ਸੰਤ ਆਗੈ ਚਰਣ ਧੋਇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਣਾ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: pakhaa ferau peesau sa(n)t aagai charan dhoi sukh painaa ||13||
verses.translation: I wave the fan, and grind the corn for the Saints; washing their feet, I find peace. ||13||
After wandering around at so many doors, I have come to Yours, O Lord.
By Your Grace, I have entered Your Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਤਹ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਏਹੁ ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਵਾਇਣਾ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sadhaa sa(n)teh sa(n)g raakhahu eh naam dhaan dhevainaa ||14||
verses.translation: Forever and ever, keep me in the Company of the Saints; please bless me with this Gift of Your Name. ||14||
My World-Lord has become merciful,
and I have obtained the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of the Perfect True Guru.

verses.original: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਸਦਾ ਆਨੰਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਦਸਾਇਣਾ ॥੧੫॥੨॥੭॥
verses.translit: sookh sahaj sadhaa aana(n)dhaa naanak dhaas dhasainaa ||15||2||7||
verses.translation: I have found eternal peace, poise and bliss; Nanak is the slave of Your slaves. ||15||2||7||
Maaroo, Solahas, Fifth Mehla:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
The earth and the Akaashic ethers meditate in remembrance.
The moon and the sun meditate in remembrance on You, O treasure of virtue.

verses.original: ਪਉਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਸਗਲ ਉਪਾਰਜਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: paun paanee baisa(n)tar simareh simarai sagal upaarajanaa ||1||
verses.translation: Air, water and fire meditate in remembrance. All creation meditates in remembrance. ||1||
All the continents, islands and worlds meditate in remembrance.
The nether worlds and spheres meditate in remembrance on that True Lord.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਖਾਣੀ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਨਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: simareh khaanee simareh baanee simareh sagale har janaa ||2||
verses.translation: The sources of creation and speech meditate in remembrance; all the Lord's humble servants meditate in remembrance. ||2||
Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva meditate in remembrance.
The three hundred thirty million gods meditate in remembrance.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਜਖੵਿ ਦੈਤ ਸਭਿ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਅਗਨਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਜਸੁ ਗਨਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: simareh jakhiye dhait sabh simareh aganat na jaiee jas ganaa ||3||
verses.translation: The titans and demons all meditate in remembrance; Your Praises are uncountable - they cannot be counted. ||3||
All the beasts, birds and demons meditate in remembrance.
The forests, mountains and hermits meditate in remembrance.

verses.original: ਲਤਾ ਬਲੀ ਸਾਖ ਸਭ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਭ ਮਨਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: lataa balee saakh sabh simareh rav rahiaa suaamee sabh manaa ||4||
verses.translation: All the vines and branches meditate in remembrance; O my Lord and Master, You are permeating and pervading all minds. ||4||
All beings, both subtle and gross, meditate in remembrance.
The Siddhas and seekers meditate in remembrance on the Lord's Mantra.

verses.original: ਗੁਪਤ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਗਲ ਭਵਨ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਨਾ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: gupat pragaT simareh prabh mere sagal bhavan kaa prabh dhanaa ||5||
verses.translation: Both the visible and the invisible meditate in remembrance on my God; God is the Master of all worlds. ||5||
Men and women, throughout the four stages of life, meditate in remembrance on You.
All social classes and souls of all races meditate in remembrance on You.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਚਤੁਰ ਸਭਿ ਬੇਤੇ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਰੈਣੀ ਅਰੁ ਦਿਨਾ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: simareh gunee chatur sabh bete simareh rainee ar dhinaa ||6||
verses.translation: All the virtuous, clever and wise people meditate in remembrance; night and day meditate in remembrance. ||6||
Hours, minutes and seconds meditate in remembrance.
Death and life, and thoughts of purification, meditate in remembrance.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸਉਣ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਸੰਜੋਗਾ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖੀਐ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨਾ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: simareh saun saasatr sa(n)jogaa alakh na lakheeaai ik khinaa ||7||
verses.translation: The Shaastras, with their lucky signs and joinings, meditate in remembrance; the invisible cannot be seen, even for an instant. ||7||
The Lord and Master is the Doer, the Cause of causes.
He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of all hearts.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਸੋ ਜਿਨਾ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa jis bhagatee laavahu janam padhaarath so jinaa ||8||
verses.translation: That person, whom You bless with Your Grace, and link to Your devotional service, wins this invaluable human life. ||8||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਵੂਠਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai man vooThaa prabh apanaa ||
verses.translation: He, within whose mind God dwells,

verses.original: ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: poorai karam gur kaa jap japanaa ||
verses.translation: has perfect karma, and chants the Chant of the Guru.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਜੋਨੀ ਭਰਮਿ ਰੁਨਾ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: sarab nira(n)tar so prabh jaataa bahuR na jonee bharam runaa ||9||
verses.translation: One who realizes God pervading deep within all, does not wander crying in reincarnation again. ||9||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ॥ ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur kaa sabadh vasai man jaa kai || dhookh dharadh bhram taa kaa bhaagai ||
verses.translation: Pain, sorrow and doubt run away from that one, within whose mind the Word of the Guru's Shabad abides.

verses.original: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਅਨਹਦ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਾ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: sookh sahaj aana(n)dh naam ras anahadh baanee sahaj dhunaa ||10||
verses.translation: Intuitive peace, poise and bliss come from the sublime essence of the Naam; the unstruck sound current of the Guru's Bani intuitively vibrates and resounds. ||10||
He alone is wealthy, who meditates on God.
He alone is honorable, who joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਵੂਠਾ ਸੋ ਪੂਰ ਕਰੰਮਾ ਨਾ ਛਿਨਾ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: paarabraham jaa kai man vooThaa so poor kara(n)maa naa chhinaa ||11||
verses.translation: That person, within whose mind the Supreme Lord God abides, has perfect karma, and becomes famous. ||11||
The Lord and Master is pervading the water, land and sky.
There is no other said to be so.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨਿ ਕਾਟਿਓ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਸਗਲਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਏਕ ਬਿਨਾ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: gur giaan a(n)jan kaaTio bhram sagalaa avar na dheesai ek binaa ||12||
verses.translation: The ointment of the Guru's spiritual wisdom has eradicated all doubts; except the One Lord, I do not see any other at all. ||12||
The Lord's Court is the highest of the high.

verses.original: ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: kahan na jaiee a(n)t na paaraa ||
verses.translation: His limit and extent cannot be described.

verses.original: ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਅਥਾਹ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਤੁਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਕਿਆ ਮਿਨਾ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: gahir ga(n)bheer athaeh suaamee atul na jaiee kiaa minaa ||13||
verses.translation: The Lord and Master is profoundly deep, unfathomable and unweighable; how can He be measured? ||13||
You are the Creator; all is created by You.

verses.original: ਤੁਝੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਬੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: tujh bin avar na koiee beeaa ||
verses.translation: Without You, there is no other at all.

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਮਧਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤੂਹੈ ਸਗਲ ਪਸਾਰਾ ਤੁਮ ਤਨਾ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: aadh madh a(n)t prabh toohai sagal pasaaraa tum tanaa ||14||
verses.translation: You alone, God, are in the beginning, the middle and the end. You are the root of the entire expanse. ||14||
The Messenger of Death does not even approach that person
who sings the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਜੋ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਨਾ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: sagal manorath taa ke pooran jo sravanee prabh kaa jas sunaa ||15||
verses.translation: All desires are fulfilled, for one who listens with his ears to the Praises of God. ||15||

verses.original: ਤੂ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੇਰਾ ॥ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: too sabhanaa kaa sabh ko teraa || saache saahib gahir ga(n)bheeraa ||
verses.translation: You belong to all, and all belong to You, O my true, deep and profound Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਈ ਜਨ ਊਤਮ ਜੋ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੁਮ ਮਨਾ ॥੧੬॥੧॥੮॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak seiee jan uootam jo bhaaveh suaamee tum manaa ||16||1||8||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, those humble beings are exalted, who are pleasing to Your Mind, O my Lord and Master. ||16||1||8||
Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:
God is the almighty Giver of all peace and joy.
Be merciful to me, that I may meditate in remembrance on Your Name.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਭੇਖਾਰੀ ਜਨੁ ਬਾਂਛੈ ਜਾਚੰਗਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har dhaataa jeea ja(n)t bhekhaaree jan baa(n)chhai jaacha(n)ganaa ||1||
verses.translation: The Lord is the Great Giver; all beings and creatures are beggars; His humble servants yearn to beg from Him. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਾਗਉ ਜਨ ਧੂਰਿ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: maagau jan dhoor param gat paavau ||
verses.translation: I beg for the dust of the feet of the humble, that I may be blessed with the supreme status,
and the filth of countless lifetimes may be erased.

verses.original: ਦੀਰਘ ਰੋਗ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਉਖਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲਿ ਰਾਪੈ ਮੰਗਨਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dheeragh rog miTeh har aaukhadh har niramal raapai ma(n)ganaa ||2||
verses.translation: The chronic diseases are cured by the medicine of the Lord's Name; I beg to be imbued with the Immaculate Lord. ||2||
With my ears, I listen to the Pure Praises of my Lord and Master.
With the Support of the One Lord, I have abandoned corruption, sexuality and desire.

verses.original: ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਪਾਇ ਲਗਉ ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੰਗਨਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: niv niv pai lagau dhaas tere kar sukirat naahee sa(n)ganaa ||3||
verses.translation: I humbly bow and fall at the feet of Your slaves; I do not hesitate to do good deeds. ||3||
O Lord, with my tongue I sing Your Glorious Praises.
The sins which I have committed are erased.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਵੈ ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਤਜਿ ਤੰਗਨਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: simar simar suaamee man jeevai pa(n)ch dhoot taj ta(n)ganaa ||4||
verses.translation: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on my Lord and Master, my mind lives; I am rid of the five oppressive demons. ||4||
Meditating on Your lotus feet, I have come aboard Your boat.
Joining the Society of the Saints, I cross over the world-ocean.

verses.original: ਅਰਚਾ ਬੰਦਨ ਹਰਿ ਸਮਤ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਨੰਗਨਾ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: arachaa ba(n)dhan har samat nivaasee baahuR jon na na(n)ganaa ||5||
verses.translation: My flower-offering and worship is to realize that the Lord is dwelling alike in all; I shall not be reincarnated naked again. ||5||

verses.original: ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੋ ਕਰਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਗੋੁਪਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhaas dhaasan ko kar leh guopaalaa ||
verses.translation: Please make me the slave of Your slaves, O Lord of the world.
You are the treasure of Grace, merciful to the meek.

verses.original: ਸਖਾ ਸਹਾਈ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਮਿਲੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਭੰਗਨਾ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: sakhaa sahaiee pooran paramesur mil kadhe na hovee bha(n)ganaa ||6||
verses.translation: Meet with your companion and helper, the Perfect Transcendent Lord God; you shall never be separated from Him again. ||6||

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਧਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਆਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: man tan arap dharee har aagai ||
verses.translation: I dedicate my mind and body, and place them in offering before the Lord.
Asleep for countless lifetimes, I have awakened.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਾ ਸੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਕੁ ਹਤਿ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਹੰਤਨਾ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: jis kaa saa soiee pratipaalak hat tiaagee haumai ha(n)tanaa ||7||
verses.translation: He, to whom I belong, is my cherisher and nurturer. I have killed and discarded my murderous self-conceit. ||7||
The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, is pervading the water and the land.
The undeceivable Lord and Master is permeating each and every heart.

verses.original: ਭਰਮ ਭੀਤਿ ਖੋਈ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਏਕੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਰਬੰਗਨਾ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: bharam bheet khoiee gur poorai ek raviaa saraba(n)ganaa ||8||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru has demolished the wall of doubt, and now I see the One Lord pervading everywhere. ||8||

verses.original: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਖਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ॥
verses.translit: jat kat pekhau prabh sukh saagar ||
verses.translation: Wherever I look, there I see God, the ocean of peace.
The Lord's treasure is never exhausted; He is the storehouse of jewels.

verses.original: ਅਗਹ ਅਗਾਹ ਕਿਛੁ ਮਿਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਿਰਪੰਗਨਾ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: ageh agaeh kichh mit nahee paieeaai so boojhai jis kirapa(n)ganaa ||9||
verses.translation: He cannot be seized; He is inaccessible, and His limits cannot be found. He is realized when the Lord bestows His Grace. ||9||
My heart is cooled, and my mind and body are calmed and soothed.
The craving for birth and death is quenched.

verses.original: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਕਾਢਿ ਲੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਅਮਿਓ ਧਾਰਿ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੰਗਨਾ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: kar geh kaadd le'ee prabh apunai amio dhaar dhirasaTa(n)ganaa ||10||
verses.translation: Grasping hold of my hand, He has lifted me up and out; He has blessed me with His Ambrosial Glance of Grace. ||10||
The One and Only Lord is permeating and pervading everywhere.
There is none other than Him at all.

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਮਧਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਬੁਝੀ ਭਰਮੰਗਨਾ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: aadh madh a(n)t prabh raviaa tirasan bujhee bharama(n)ganaa ||11||
verses.translation: God permeates the beginning, the middle and the end; He has subdued my desires and doubts. ||11||
The Guru is the Transcendent Lord, the Guru is the Lord of the Universe.
The Guru is the Creator, the Guru is forever forgiving.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪਿ ਜਪਤ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗਿਆਨ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਸੰਤ ਸੰਗਨਾ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: gur jap jaap japat fal paiaa giaan dheepak sa(n)t sa(n)ganaa ||12||
verses.translation: Meditating, chanting the Guru's Chant, I have obtained the fruits and rewards; in the Company of the Saints, I have been blessed with the lamp of spiritual wisdom. ||12||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਪੇਖਾ ਸੋ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
verses.translit: jo pekhaa so sabh kichh suaamee ||
verses.translation: Whatever I see, is my Lord and Master God.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਸੁਨਣਾ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: jo sunanaa so prabh kee baanee ||
verses.translation: Whatever I hear, is the Bani of God's Word.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਕੀਨੋ ਸੋ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਕਰਾਇਓ ਸਰਣਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਸੰਤਹ ਤਨਾ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: jo keeno so tumeh karaio saran sahaiee sa(n)teh tanaa ||13||
verses.translation: Whatever I do, You make me do; You are the Sanctuary, the help and support of the Saints, Your children. ||13||
The beggar begs, and worships You in adoration.
You are the Purifier of the sinners, O Perfectly Holy Lord God.

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਦਾਨੁ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਆਨ ਮੰਗਨ ਨਿਹਕਿੰਚਨਾ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: eko dhaan sarab sukh gun nidh aan ma(n)gan nihaki(n)chanaa ||14||
verses.translation: Please bless me with this one gift, O treasure of all bliss and virtue; I do not ask for anything else. ||14||
God is the Creator of the body-vessel.
In the Society of the Saints, the dye is produced.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੋਇ ਬਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਜੀਠੈ ਰੰਗਨਾ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: niramal soi banee har baanee man naam majeeThai ra(n)ganaa ||15||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Lord's Bani, one's reputation becomes immaculate, and the mind is colored by the dye of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||15||
The sixteen powers, absolute perfection and fruitful rewards are obtained,
when the Lord and Master of infinite power is revealed.

verses.original: ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਖ ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਭੁੰਚਨਾ ॥੧੬॥੨॥੯॥
verses.translit: anadh binodh har naam sukh naanak a(n)mirat ras har bhu(n)chanaa ||16||2||9||
verses.translation: The Lord's Name is Nanak's bliss, play and peace; he drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord. ||16||2||9||
Maaroo, Solhas, Fifth Mehla:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
You are my Lord and Master; You have made me Your servant.
My soul and body are all gifts from You.

verses.original: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਸਭੁ ਤੂਹੈ ਤੂਹੈ ਹੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਅਸਾੜਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: karan karaavan sabh toohai toohai hai naahee kichh asaaRaa ||1||
verses.translation: You are the Creator, the Cause of causes; nothing belongs to me. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੁਮਹਿ ਪਠਾਏ ਤਾ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: tumeh paThaae taa jag meh aae ||
verses.translation: When You sent me, I came into the world.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਸੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jo tudh bhaanaa se karam kamaae ||
verses.translation: Whatever is pleasing to Your Will, I do.

verses.original: ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਆ ਤਾ ਭੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਾੜਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tujh te baahar kichhoo na hoaa taa bhee naahee kichh kaaRaa ||2||
verses.translation: Without You, nothing is done, so I am not anxious at all. ||2||
In the world hereafter, the Hukam of Your Command is heard.
In this world, I chant Your Praises, Lord.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਲੇਖ ਅਲੇਖੈ ਆਪੇ ਤੁਮ ਸਿਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਝਾੜਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aape lekh alekhai aape tum siau naahee kichh jhaaRaa ||3||
verses.translation: You Yourself write the account, and You Yourself erase it; no one can argue with You. ||3||
You are our father; we are all Your children.
We play as You cause us to play.

verses.original: ਉਝੜ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਕੀਨਾ ਚਲੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਵੇਪਾੜਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: aujhaR maarag sabh tum hee keenaa chalai naahee ko vepaaRaa ||4||
verses.translation: The wilderness and the path are all made by You. No one can take the wrong path. ||4||
Some remain seated within their homes.
Some wander across the country and through foreign lands.

verses.original: ਇਕ ਹੀ ਕਉ ਘਾਸੁ ਇਕ ਹੀ ਕਉ ਰਾਜਾ ਇਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਿਆ ਕੂੜਾ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: eik hee kau ghaas ik hee kau raajaa in meh kaheeaai kiaa kooRaa ||5||
verses.translation: Some are grass-cutters, and some are kings. Who among these can be called false? ||5||

verses.original: ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਮੁਕਤੀ ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਨਰਕਾ ॥
verses.translit: kavan su mukatee kavan su narakaa ||
verses.translation: Who is liberated, and who will land in hell?
Who is worldly, and who is a devotee?

verses.original: ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਦਾਨਾ ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਹੋਛਾ ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਸੁਰਤਾ ਕਵਨੁ ਜੜਾ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: kavan su dhaanaa kavanu su hochhaa kavan su surataa kavan jaRaa ||6||
verses.translation: Who is wise, and who is shallow? Who is aware, and who is ignorant? ||6||
By the Hukam of the Lord's Command, one is liberated, and by His Hukam, one falls into hell.
By His Hukam, one is worldly, and by His Hukam, one is a devotee.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਹੋਛਾ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਦਾਨਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਵਰੁ ਧੜਾ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: hukame hochhaa hukame dhaanaa dhoojaa naahee avar dhaRaa ||7||
verses.translation: By His Hukam, one is shallow, and by His Hukam, one is wise. There is no other side except His. ||7||
You made the ocean vast and huge.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਖੜੇ ਰਸਾਤਲਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਗਾਵਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: eik khaRe rasaatal kar manmukh gaavaaraa ||
verses.translation: You made some into foolish self-willed manmukhs, and dragged them into hell.

verses.original: ਇਕਨਾ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਵਹਿ ਆਪੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨ ਕਾ ਸਚੁ ਬੇੜਾ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: eikanaa paar la(n)ghaaveh aape satigur jin kaa sach beRaa ||8||
verses.translation: Some are carried across, in the ship of Truth of the True Guru. ||8||
You issue Your Command for this amazing thing, death.
You create all beings and creatures, and absorb them back into Yourself.

verses.original: ਵੇਖੈ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਸਭਿ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣੇ ਰਚਨੁ ਕੀਨਾ ਇਕੁ ਆਖਾੜਾ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: vekhai vigasai sabh ra(n)g maane rachan keenaa ik aakhaaRaa ||9||
verses.translation: You gaze in delight upon the one arena of the world, and enjoy all the pleasures. ||9||
Great is the Lord and Master, and Great is His Name.
He is the Great Giver; Great is His place.

verses.original: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਅਤੋਲਾ ਹੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਹਾੜਾ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: agam agochar bea(n)t atolaa hai naahee kichh aahaaRaa ||10||
verses.translation: He is inaccessible and unfathomable, infinite and unweighable. He cannot be measureed. ||10||
No one else knows His value.
Only You Yourself, O Immaculate Lord, are equal to Yourself.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਸੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਆਪਿ ਧਿਆਨੀ ਆਪਿ ਸਤਵੰਤਾ ਅਤਿ ਗਾੜਾ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: aap su giaanee aap dhiaanee aap satava(n)taa at gaaRaa ||11||
verses.translation: You Yourself are the spiritual teacher, You Yourself are the One who meditates. You Yourself are the great and immense Being of Truth. ||11||
For so many days, You remained invisible.
For so many days, You were absorbed in silent absorption.

verses.original: ਕੇਤੜਿਆ ਦਿਨ ਧੁੰਧੂਕਾਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਪਰਗਟੜਾ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: ketaRiaa dhin dhu(n)dhookaaraa aape karataa paragaTaRaa ||12||
verses.translation: For so many days, there was only pitch darkness, and then the Creator revealed Himself. ||12||
You Yourself are called the God of Supreme Power.
You Yourself are the hero, exerting Your regal power.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸਿਵ ਵਰਤਾਈਅਨੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਠਾਰੁ ਗੜਾ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: aape siv varataieean a(n)tar aape seetal Thaar gaRaa ||13||
verses.translation: You Yourself spread peace within; You are cool and icy calm. ||13||
One whom You bless and make Gurmukh
the Naam abides within him, and the unstruck sound current vibrates for him.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਠਕੁਰਾਈ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਾ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: tis hee sukh tis hee Thakuraiee tiseh na aavai jam neRaa ||14||
verses.translation: He is peaceful, and he is the master of all; the Messenger of Death does not even approach him. ||14||
His value cannot be described on paper.
Says Nanak, the Lord of the world is infinite.

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਮਧਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ਹਾਥਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਕੈ ਨੇਬੇੜਾ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: aadh madh a(n)t prabh soiee haath tisai kai nebeRaa ||15||
verses.translation: In the beginning, in the middle and in the end, God exists. Judgement is in His Hands alone. ||15||
No one is equal to Him.

verses.original: ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਬੁਤੈ ਜਬਾਬੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: kis hee butai jabaab na hoiee ||
verses.translation: No one can stand up against Him by any means.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਚੋਜ ਖੜਾ ॥੧੬॥੧॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: naanak kaa prabh aape aape kar kar vekhai choj khaRaa ||16||1||10||
verses.translation: Nanak's God is Himself all-in-all. He creates and stages and watches His wondrous plays. ||16||1||10||
Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:
The Supreme Lord God is imperishable, the Transcendent Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.
He is the Slayer of demons, our Supreme Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਰਿਖੀਕੇਸ ਗੋਵਰਧਨ ਧਾਰੀ ਮੁਰਲੀ ਮਨੋਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: rikheekes govaradhan dhaaree muralee manohar har ra(n)gaa ||1||
verses.translation: The Supreme Rishi, the Master of the sensory organs, the uplifter of mountains, the joyful Lord playing His enticing flute. ||1||
The Enticer of Hearts, the Lord of wealth, Krishna, the Enemy of ego.
The Lord of the Universe, the Dear Lord, the Destroyer of demons.

verses.original: ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਵਾਸੀ ਹੈ ਸੰਗਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jagajeevan abinaasee Thaakur ghaT ghaT vaasee hai sa(n)gaa ||2||
verses.translation: The Life of the World, our eternal and ever-stable Lord and Master dwells within each and every heart, and is always with us. ||2||
The Support of the Earth, the man-lion, the Supreme Lord God.
The Protector who tears apart demons with His teeth, the Upholder of the earth.

verses.original: ਬਾਵਨ ਰੂਪੁ ਕੀਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਸੇਤੀ ਹੈ ਚੰਗਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: baavan roop keeaa tudh karate sabh hee setee hai cha(n)gaa ||3||
verses.translation: O Creator, You assumed the form of the pygmy to humble the demons; You are the Lord God of all. ||3||

verses.original: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਾਮਚੰਦ ਜਿਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sree raamacha(n)dh jis roop na rekhiaa ||
verses.translation: You are the Great Raam Chand, who has no form or feature.
Adorned with flowers, holding the chakra in Your hand, Your form is incomparably beautiful.

verses.original: ਸਹਸ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਹੈ ਸਹਸਾ ਇਕੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਭ ਹੈ ਮੰਗਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: sahas netr moorat hai sahasaa ik dhaataa sabh hai ma(n)gaa ||4||
verses.translation: You have thousands of eyes, and thousands of forms. You alone are the Giver, and all are beggars of You. ||4||
You are the Lover of Your devotees, the Master of the masterless.
The Lord and Master of the milk-maids, You are the companion of all.

verses.original: ਬਾਸੁਦੇਵ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਦਾਤੇ ਬਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਗੁਣ ਅੰਗਾ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: baasudhev nira(n)jan dhaate baran na saakau gun a(n)gaa ||5||
verses.translation: O Lord, Immacuate Great Giver, I cannot describe even an iota of Your Glorious Virtues. ||5||
Liberator, Enticing Lord, Lord of Lakshmi, Supreme Lord God.
Savior of Dropadi's honor.

verses.original: ਕਮਲਾਕੰਤ ਕਰਹਿ ਕੰਤੂਹਲ ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦੀ ਨਿਹਸੰਗਾ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: kamalaaka(n)t kareh ka(n)toohal anadh binodhee nihasa(n)gaa ||6||
verses.translation: Lord of Maya, miracle-worker, absorbed in delightful play, unattached. ||6||
The Blessed Vision of His Darshan is fruitful and rewarding; He is not born, He is self-existent.

verses.original: ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਦੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਖਉ ॥
verses.translit: akaal moorat jis kadhe naahee khau ||
verses.translation: His form is undying; it is never destroyed.

verses.original: ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਅਬਿਗਤ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਹੈ ਲਗਾ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: abinaasee abigat agochar sabh kichh tujh hee hai lagaa ||7||
verses.translation: O imperishable, eternal, unfathomable Lord, everything is attached to You. ||7||
The Lover of greatness, who dwells in heaven.
By the Pleasure of His Will, He took incarnation as the great fish and the tortoise.

verses.original: ਕੇਸਵ ਚਲਤ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਿਰਾਲੇ ਕੀਤਾ ਲੋੜਹਿ ਸੋ ਹੋਇਗਾ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: kesav chalat kareh niraale keetaa loReh so hoigaa ||8||
verses.translation: The Lord of beauteous hair, the Worker of miraculous deeds, whatever He wishes, comes to pass. ||8||
He is beyond need of any sustenance, free of hate and all-pervading.
He has staged His play; He is called the four-armed Lord.

verses.original: ਸਾਵਲ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਰੂਪ ਬਣਾਵਹਿ ਬੇਣੁ ਸੁਨਤ ਸਭ ਮੋਹੈਗਾ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: saaval su(n)dhar roop banaaveh ben sunat sabh mohaigaa ||9||
verses.translation: He assumed the beautiful form of the blue-skinned Krishna; hearing His flute, all are fascinated and enticed. ||9||
He is adorned with garlands of flowers, with lotus eyes.
His ear-rings, crown and flute are so beautiful.

verses.original: ਸੰਖ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਗਦਾ ਹੈ ਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਾ ਸਾਰਥੀ ਸਤਸੰਗਾ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: sa(n)kh chakar gadhaa hai dhaaree mahaa saarathee satasa(n)gaa ||10||
verses.translation: He carries the conch, the chakra and the war club; He is the Great Charioteer, who stays with His Saints. ||10||
The Lord of yellow robes, the Master of the three worlds.
The Lord of the Universe, the Lord of the world; with my mouth, I chant His Name.

verses.original: ਸਾਰਿੰਗਧਰ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਬੀਠੁਲਾ ਮੈ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਸਰਬੰਗਾ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: saari(n)gadhar bhagavaan beeThulaa mai ganat na aavai saraba(n)gaa ||11||
verses.translation: The Archer who draws the bow, the Beloved Lord God; I cannot count all His limbs. ||11||
He is said to be free of anguish, and absolutely immaculate.
The Lord of prosperity, pervading the water, the land and the sky.

verses.original: ਮਿਰਤ ਲੋਕ ਪਇਆਲ ਸਮੀਪਤ ਅਸਥਿਰ ਥਾਨੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਹੈ ਅਭਗਾ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: mirat lok piaal sameepat asathir thaan jis hai abhagaa ||12||
verses.translation: He is near this world and the nether regions of the underworld; His Place is permanent, ever-stable and imperishable. ||12||
The Purifier of sinners, the Destroyer of pain and fear.
The Eliminator of egotism, the Eradicator of coming and going.

verses.original: ਭਗਤੀ ਤੋਖਿਤ ਦੀਨ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਾ ਗੁਣੇ ਨ ਕਿਤ ਹੀ ਹੈ ਭਿਗਾ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: bhagatee tokhit dheen kirapaalaa gune na kit hee hai bhigaa ||13||
verses.translation: He is pleased with devotional worship, and merciful to the meek; He cannot be appeased by any other qualities. ||13||
The Formless Lord is undeceivable and unchanging.
He is the Embodiment of Light; through Him, the whole world blossoms forth.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਆਪਹੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਾਵੈਗਾ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: so milai jis aap milaae aapahu koi na paavaigaa ||14||
verses.translation: He alone unites with Him, whom He unites with Himself. No one can attain the Lord by himself. ||14||
He Himself is the milk-maid, and He Himself is Krishna.
He Himself grazes the cows in the forest.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਵਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਖਪਾਵਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਲੇਪੁ ਨਹੀ ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਰੰਗਾ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: aap upaaveh aap khapaaveh tudh lep nahee ik til ra(n)gaa ||15||
verses.translation: You Yourself create, and You Yourself destroy. Not even a particle of filth attaches to You. ||15||
Which of Your Glorious Virtues can I chant with my one tongue?

verses.original: ਸਹਸ ਫਨੀ ਸੇਖ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: sahas fanee sekh a(n)t na jaanai ||
verses.translation: Even the thousand-headed serpent does not know Your limit.

verses.original: ਨਵਤਨ ਨਾਮ ਜਪੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਇਕੁ ਗੁਣੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਹਿ ਸੰਗਾ ॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: navatan naam japai dhin raatee ik gun naahee prabh keh sa(n)gaa ||16||
verses.translation: One may chant new names for You day and night, but even so, O God, no one can describe even one of Your Glorious Virtues. ||16||
I have grasped the Support, and entered the Sanctuary of the Lord, the Father of the world.

verses.original: ਭੈ ਭਇਆਨਕ ਜਮਦੂਤ ਦੁਤਰ ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bhai bhiaanak jamadhoot dhutar hai maiaa ||
verses.translation: The Messenger of Death is terrifying and horrendous, and sea of Maya is impassable.

verses.original: ਹੋਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਇਛਾ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੰਗਾ ॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: hoh kirapaal ichhaa kar raakhahu saadh sa(n)tan kai sa(n)g sa(n)gaa ||17||
verses.translation: Please be merciful, Lord, and save me, if it is Your Will; please lead me to join with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||17||
All that is seen is an illusion.

verses.original: ਇਕੁ ਮਾਗਉ ਦਾਨੁ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਸੰਤ ਰੇਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: eik maagau dhaan gobidh sa(n)t renaa ||
verses.translation: I beg for this one gift, for the dust of the feet of the Saints, O Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਾਇ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਵਉ ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਵੈਗਾ ॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: masatak lai param padh paavau jis praapat so paavaigaa ||18||
verses.translation: Applying it to my forehead, I obtain the supreme status; he alone obtains it, unto whom You give it. ||18||
Those, unto whom the Lord, the Giver of peace, grants His Mercy,

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਣ ਲੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਪਰਾਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: tin saadhoo charan lai ridhai paraate ||
verses.translation: grasp the feet of the Holy, and weave them into their hearts.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਮਨਿ ਵਾਜੰਗਾ ॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: sagal naam nidhaan tin paiaa anahadh sabadh man vaaja(n)gaa ||19||
verses.translation: They obtain all the wealth of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the unstruck sound current of the Shabad vibrates and resounds within their minds. ||19||
With my tongue I chant the Names given to You.
'Sat Naam' is Your perfect, primal Name.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤ ਪਏ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਦੇਹੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਗਾ ॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak bhagat pe saranaiee dheh dharas man ra(n)g lagaa ||20||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, Your devotees have entered Your Sanctuary. Please bestow the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; their minds are filled with love for You. ||20||
You alone know Your state and extent.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਕਥਹਿ ਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: too aape katheh tai aap vakhaaneh ||
verses.translation: You Yourself speak, and You Yourself describe it.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੋ ਕਰੀਅਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਦਾਸਾ ਰਾਖੁ ਸੰਗਾ ॥੨੧॥੨॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaas dhaasan ko kareeahu har bhaavai dhaasaa raakh sa(n)gaa ||21||2||11||
verses.translation: Please make Nanak the slave of Your slaves, O Lord; as it pleases Your Will, please keep him with Your slaves. ||21||2||11||
Maaroo, Fifth Mehla:
O slave of the inaccessible Lord God Allah,
forsake thoughts of worldly entanglements.

verses.original: ਹੋਇ ਪੈ ਖਾਕ ਫਕੀਰ ਮੁਸਾਫਰੁ ਇਹੁ ਦਰਵੇਸੁ ਕਬੂਲੁ ਦਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: hoi pai khaak fakeer musaafar ih dharaves kabool dharaa ||1||
verses.translation: Become the dust of the feet of the humble fakeers, and consider yourself a traveller on this journey. O saintly dervish, you shall be approved in the Court of the Lord. ||1||
Let Truth be your prayer, and faith your prayer-mat.
Subdue your desires, and overcome your hopes.

verses.original: ਦੇਹ ਮਸੀਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਉਲਾਣਾ ਕਲਮ ਖੁਦਾਈ ਪਾਕੁ ਖਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dheh maseet man maulaanaa kalam khudhaiee paak kharaa ||2||
verses.translation: Let your body be the mosque, and your mind the priest. Let true purity be God's Word for you. ||2||
Let your practice be to live the spiritual life.
Let your spiritual cleansing be to renounce the world and seek God.

verses.original: ਮਾਰਫਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਹੁ ਅਬਦਾਲਾ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਹਕੀਕਤਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਨ ਮਰਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: maarafat man maarahu abadhaalaa milahu hakeekat jit fir na maraa ||3||
verses.translation: Let control of the mind be your spiritual wisdom, O holy man; meeting with God, you shall never die again. ||3||
Practice within your heart the teachings of the Koran and the Bible;
restrain the ten sensory organs from straying into evil.

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਮਰਦ ਸਿਦਕਿ ਲੇ ਬਾਧਹੁ ਖੈਰਿ ਸਬੂਰੀ ਕਬੂਲ ਪਰਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch maradh sidhak le baadhahu khair sabooree kabool paraa ||4||
verses.translation: Tie up the five demons of desire with faith, charity and contentment, and you shall be acceptable. ||4||
Let compassion be your Mecca, and the dust of the feet of the holy your fast.
Let Paradise be your practice of the Prophet's Word.

verses.original: ਹੂਰ ਨੂਰ ਮੁਸਕੁ ਖੁਦਾਇਆ ਬੰਦਗੀ ਅਲਹ ਆਲਾ ਹੁਜਰਾ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: hoor noor musak khudhaiaa ba(n)dhagee aleh aalaa hujaraa ||5||
verses.translation: God is the beauty, the light and the fragrance. Meditation on Allah is the secluded meditation chamber. ||5||
